# CMA metric catalog

Generated from [catalog.json](catalog.json) by `web/scripts/metrics-doc.mjs`; never edited by hand (`verify:metrics` fails when this file is stale). One section per figure the Workspace shows, grouped by surface, page and figure: the definition, the formula as the code computes it, the sources with their cadence, the time rules, the settings, who may see it, an independent verification query and the audit status. The audit's findings are in [AUDIT-2026-10-23.md](AUDIT-2026-10-23.md); the catalog is shown on Configuration → Metrics.

544 figures. Statuses: verified 440 · discrepancy 18 · ambiguous 35 · prerequisite_missing 58 · cadence_unconfirmed 68.

## Welcome

### /

#### `welcome.clock.state`

**Not clocked in / Clocked in / Your workday has ended** on / · Day state (Niet ingeklokt / Ingeklokt / Je werkdag is beëindigd)

Whether the person has a workday today and whether it is still open: the badge on the Clock in card (no day), the open-day card, or the ended-day card.

**Formula as computed**

```
no row in cma.workday for (user, today in the user's zone) => 'Not clocked in' card; workday.status = 'open' => 'Clocked in' badge; status = 'ended' => 'Your workday has ended'. status itself is derived by cma.refresh_workday(): ended iff exactly one effective end event exists.
```

**Unit** text · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | status, business_date, user_id, timezone | CMA | the Workspace's own write paths: POST /api/v1/me/day/start → cma.open_workday(), POST /api/v1/me/day/end → cma.end_workday(), POST /api/v1/team/days/{userId}/{date}/corrections → cma.correct_workday(); the scheduler job cma-close-forgotten-workdays → cma.close_forgotten_workdays() (system end); the legacy import cma.load_import_batch() (0008d, one-off) | immediately on each click; the sweep hourly (docs/scheduler/deploy.sh; the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo); import one-off |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS on cma.workday plus the transaction's app.tenant_id (withTenant)
- own rows only: user_id = cma.current_user_id(), never a parameter
- business_date = today in the caller's zone (dateKeyInZone)

**Time** Today = the calendar date of now() in the caller's zone (me.timeZone, cma.user_timezone chain); the day's own zone is snapshotted at open. Clock-in before workday.window_start is refused (CMA04, 'the workday starts at HH:MI'); the card then shows that time.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_start` | 00:00 | 07:00 |

**Who may see it** `workday.own`

**Refresh** on page load (server render); router.refresh() after Clock in

**Computed in** `cma.workday_summary` (0008d); `cma.open_workday` (0008b); `cma.refresh_workday` (0003); `DayBlock` in src/app/page.tsx; `ClockInCard` in src/components/ClockInCard.tsx; `getWorkday` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select w.status, w.started_at, w.ended_at from cma.workday w where w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.user_id = :user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio. The query also takes the person's id (:user_id).

**Documented in** features.md §1, Workday and time tracking; api.md, Welcome and Clock in; data-model/0001-0005b.md, Time model (0002); decisions.md 7 Oct 2026 (Clock in is an action, never a visit)

**Notes**

A visit opens nothing (decision 7 Oct 2026): rendering reads the day, only POST /api/v1/me/day/start opens one, and only for a person whose time is kept (cma.time_is_kept, 0003d). The refusal before the window start carries the database's own HH:MI (workdayStartsAt in live.ts parses the one passed-through text); no time is typed in code. :user_id in verify_sql: the person's id, since the page always reads the caller's own day.

#### `welcome.clock.status`

**(current status name with its colour dot)** on / · Current status

The work status the person is in right now, named from the tenant's own list, with the colour of its group (productive, other work, pause).

**Formula as computed**

```
current_status_id = the status of the last effective start/status event of the day (workday_summary); name as stored. Colour group = agentGroupOf(flags): is_working && is_productive => productive (green), is_working => otherWork (deep blue), else pause (light blue); whether a pause is paid is never shown to agents.
```

**Unit** text · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.time_event` | kind, status_id, occurred_at, recorded_at | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/me/status → cma.set_status(); POST /api/v1/me/day/start → cma.open_workday() (the default status); corrections → cma.correct_workday() | immediately on each click |
| `cma.work_status` | key, name, is_working, is_productive | CMA | migration seed cma.seed_default_work_statuses(); tenant list in seed 02 (Pulse4all: Available - Sales default); later the Statuses configuration screen | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus tenant-filtered view faces
- own day only (user_id = cma.current_user_id())
- effective events only: not superseded by a correction, voids excluded

**Time** The last effective start/status event by occurred_at, then recorded_at; shown only while the day is open.

**Who may see it** `workday.own`

**Refresh** on page load; router.refresh() after a status change

**Computed in** `cma.workday_summary` (0008d); `DayBlock` in src/app/page.tsx; `agentGroupOf` in src/lib/dashboard.ts; `readDay` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select ws.key, ws.name, ws.is_working, ws.is_productive from cma.time_event e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = e.status_id where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.user_id = :user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date and e.kind in ('start','status') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id) order by e.occurred_at desc, e.recorded_at desc limit 1
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio. The query also takes the person's id (:user_id).

**Documented in** api.md, Welcome and Clock in; api.md, Status and clock; decisions.md 7 Oct 2026 (statusName as stored; four groups from flags)

**Notes**

A status retired while the person is in it shows its stored name without a colour dot (no flags on the wire for it; page.tsx:156). Groups come from flags, never key or name (audit rule 14 holds: Pulse4all's list is seed data). Same group rule as My day and the Dashboard (one definition in lib/dashboard.ts).

#### `welcome.clock.clocked_in_at`

**Clocked in at** on / · Clocked in at (Ingeklokt om)

The time the person's workday started today.

**Formula as computed**

```
workday.started_at = min(occurred_at) of the day's effective start event (refresh_workday); formatted hh:mm in the viewer's zone (fmtTime(startedAt, me.timeZone)).
```

**Unit** time_of_day · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | started_at | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/me/day/start → cma.open_workday(); a corrected start via cma.correct_workday() | immediately on each click |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus app.tenant_id
- own day only
- today in the caller's zone

**Time** started_at is an instant; shown in the viewer's zone (the day's snapshot zone is the same person's, so they differ only after a zone change).

**Who may see it** `workday.own`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.refresh_workday` (0003); `DayBlock` in src/app/page.tsx; `fmtTime` in src/lib/time.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select min(e.occurred_at) from cma.time_event e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.user_id = :user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date and e.kind = 'start' and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio. The query also takes the person's id (:user_id).

**Documented in** api.md, Welcome and Clock in; features.md §1

**Notes**

Shown on both the open-day and the ended-day card. Same figure as My day's 'Started at'.

#### `welcome.clock.worked_so_far`

**worked so far** on / · Time worked so far (tot nu toe gewerkt)

How long the person has worked today: time in working statuses only, pauses excluded, up to now (or up to the day's window end).

**Formula as computed**

```
workedSeconds = clock.closedSeconds + (now - runningSince when the current status is working), where now is capped at dayEndsAt (the window end); minutes = floor(seconds/60), shown as Xh YYm. closedSeconds = sum of closed or capped interval seconds where status.is_working; runningSince = start of the open, non-capped interval while its status is working (readDay, postgres.ts:77-102).
```

**Unit** minutes · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.time_event` | kind, status_id, occurred_at, recorded_at, supersedes_event_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write paths (open_workday, set_status, end_workday, correct_workday); the scheduler job cma-close-forgotten-workdays (system end); the legacy import (0008d) | immediately on each click; the sweep hourly (docs/scheduler/deploy.sh); import one-off |
| `cma.work_status` | is_working | CMA | migration seed + tenant seed 02; later the Statuses screen | on configuration change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | key, value | CMA | cma.set_tenant_setting() (Configuration), seed 02 for Pulse4all | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus tenant-filtered faces
- own day only
- statuses with is_working only (the clock pauses on breaks)
- interval seconds stop at the day's window end

**Time** Rendered with the server's now; the running stretch is capped at dayEndsAt = cma.business_day_end(business_date, day zone) = the tenant's workday.window_end on the day's date.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_end` | 24:00 | 22:00 |

**Who may see it** `workday.own`

**Refresh** on page load; the Welcome card does not tick (the My day clock does)

**Computed in** `cma.time_interval` (0008b); `cma.business_day_end` (0008b); `workedSeconds` in src/lib/live.ts; `DayBlock` in src/app/page.tsx; `readDay` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),
iv as (select w.user_id, w.business_date, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at as from_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as to_at, ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone) as day_end from eff e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where w.user_id = :user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date)
select floor(sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at))))) filter (where ws.is_working) / 60)::bigint as worked_minutes
from iv join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = iv.status_id where iv.kind in ('start','status')
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio. The query also takes the person's id (:user_id).

**Documented in** api.md, Status and clock; decisions.md 6 Oct 2026 (the clock counts is_working only); data-model/0008.md, Workday window (0008b)

**Notes**

The clock counts the same seconds the database counts (verify equality to the minute; the page floors to whole minutes with fmtMinutes). The window end is read live from the tenant's settings, not snapshotted per day — see the window-retroactivity finding. Which hours the agent sees (working vs paid) was decided 7 Oct 2026: working time (open-decisions.md keeps the related money-column wording open).

#### `welcome.clock.clocked_out_at`

**Clocked out at** on / · Clocked out at (Uitgeklokt om)

The time the ended day was clocked out, on the ended-day card.

**Formula as computed**

```
workday.ended_at = max(occurred_at) of the day's effective end event (at most one, refresh_workday); hh:mm in the viewer's zone; empty while null (defensive — the card only shows for status 'ended', where ended_at is not null by check constraint).
```

**Unit** time_of_day · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | ended_at, status | CMA | POST /api/v1/me/day/end → cma.end_workday(); the scheduler job cma-close-forgotten-workdays → cma.close_forgotten_workdays(); corrections → cma.correct_workday(); the legacy import (0008d) | immediately on each click; the sweep hourly (docs/scheduler/deploy.sh); import one-off |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus app.tenant_id
- own day only
- today in the caller's zone

**Time** ended_at is an instant; shown in the viewer's zone. A system end set by the sweep is the shift end, the auto-close time or the day's last event, never after the window end.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.auto_close_grace_minutes` | 120 | 60 |
| `workday.auto_close_at` | 24:00 | 17:00 |

**Who may see it** `workday.own`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.refresh_workday` (0003); `cma.close_forgotten_workdays` (0008b); `DayBlock` in src/app/page.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select max(e.occurred_at) from cma.time_event e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.user_id = :user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date and e.kind = 'end' and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio. The query also takes the person's id (:user_id).

**Documented in** api.md, Welcome and Clock in; data-model/0008.md, Workday window (0008b); decisions.md 12 Oct 2026 (the forgotten-day close)

**Notes**

An end entered by the scheduler or a correction is visible as such on Team hours (chips) and in the day's history, not on this card.

#### `welcome.needs_attention.days_not_clocked_out`

**{n} days in the last 31 days were not clocked out** on / · {n} days in the last 31 days were not clocked out ({n} dagen in de laatste 31 dagen zijn niet uitgeklokt)

Across the team: workdays of the last 31 days that still need a correction because nobody clocked out.

**Formula as computed**

```
count of cma.team_hours(today-31, today-1, null) day rows where needs_correction: the day is open past the tenant's workday.window_end on its business date, OR it holds a system 'end' time event (auto-closed by the forgotten-day job). Today excluded (TODO_DAYS=31, range [today-31, today-1] in the viewer's zone). Badge green at 0, amber otherwise; the line links to /team/hours?range=month&needs=correction.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_day · **Status** discrepancy

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | business_date, status, timezone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: clock in/out (cma.open_workday/close_workday); the scheduler job cma-close-forgotten-workdays closes forgotten days with a system end event | live writes; the forgotten-day close hourly (docs/scheduler/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.time_event` | kind, source | CMA | clock events and corrections; system events from the scheduler | live writes |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | key, value | CMA | Configuration (workday.window_end) | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id() (cma.team_hours checks workday.team)
- every person (userId null)
- business dates [today-31, today-1] in the viewer's zone; today excluded

**Time** Business dates of the workdays; 'open past the window end' uses cma.business_day_time(business_date, day's zone, workday.window_end); now = page load.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_end` | 24:00 | 22:00 |

**Who may see it** `workday.team`

**Refresh** on page load (the Welcome page does not poll)

**Computed in** `cma.team_hours` (0003); `cma.workday_summary_all` (0008b); `attentionLines` in src/lib/follow-up.ts; `default` in src/app/page.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select coalesce(ts.value, st.default_value) as window_end from cma.setting st left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = st.key where st.key = 'workday.window_end') select count(*) from cma.workday w cross join s where w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.business_date between :from and :to and ((w.status = 'open' and now() > cma.business_day_time(w.business_date, w.timezone, s.window_end::time)) or exists (select 1 from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id and e.workday_id = w.id and e.kind = 'end' and e.source = 'system'))
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** features.md §5 and §9 (Needs attention; the link to the days to correct, IT audit 17 Oct 2026); data-model/0001-0005b.md (team_hours), 0008.md (workday window, 0008b)

**Notes**

verify_sql approximates workday_summary_all's needs_correction (it reads time_event rather than time_event_effective_all for the system end; a corrected-away system end differs). DISCREPANCY: the count (last 31 days, needs_correction only) does not match what its link shows (/team/hours?range=month = the CALENDAR month, filtered to isCapped OR needsCorrection) — see finding. The label says 'not clocked out' while needs_correction includes system-auto-closed days; the hint chain on Team hours explains them as 'to correct'.

## Live board

### /live/board

#### `live.people.group`

**Status** on /live/board · Status (Status)

Which of six groups each person on the board is in right now: Productive, Other work, Paid pause, Unpaid pause (from the current status's flags, the same rule as the Dashboard), Clocked out (today's day ended) or Not clocked in (no day today). Shown as the row's colour dot and used for the tiles, the row order and the group filter.

**Formula as computed**

```
liveGroupOf(person): no day -> notClockedIn; day.status = 'ended' or no current status -> clockedOut; else groupOf(flags): isWorking ? (isProductive ? productive : otherWork) : (isPaid ? paidPause : unpaidPause). Flags come from cma.team_now() (the day's current status as stored); rows sorted by group in LIVE_GROUPS order, then name, then id (no ranking).
```

**Unit** flag · **Grain** now, per_person · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | user_id, business_date, status, started_at, ended_at, timezone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/me/day/start → cma.open_workday(), /me/status, /me/day/end; corrections via cma.correct_workday(); the scheduler's forgotten-day close (cma.close_forgotten_workdays, 0005a/0008b) | event-driven (each clock action); the page re-reads every 10 s while the tab is visible |
| `cma.time_event` | workday_id, kind, status_id, occurred_at, supersedes_event_id | CMA | the same write paths; read through the views cma.time_interval / cma.workday_summary (0002, recut by 0008b) | event-driven; re-read every 10 s |
| `cma.work_status` | is_working, is_productive, is_paid, status | CMA | tenant configuration: cma.upsert_work_status() (0005a) / seed cma.seed_default_work_statuses() | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS on tenant_id plus the function's where u.tenant_id = cma.current_tenant_id()
- people whose time is kept only (cma.time_is_kept)
- today only: the workday on cma.business_date(now(), the person's own zone); earlier open days belong to Welcome/Team hours, not the board

**Time** today = the business date in each person's own zone; now = the server's now() at read time; the workday window (0008b) caps counted time at cma.business_day_end(date, zone)

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** on page load; LiveRefresh re-reads the whole page (router.refresh) every 10 s while the tab is visible, paused hidden, once more on return

**Computed in** `cma.team_now` (0003e); `liveGroupOf` in src/lib/live.ts; `groupOf` in src/lib/dashboard.ts; `liveRows` in src/lib/live.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with kept as (select u.id as user_id, cma.user_timezone(u.id) as tz from cma.app_user u where u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cma.time_is_kept(u.id)), day as (select k.user_id, w.id as workday_id, w.status as day_status from kept k left join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.user_id = k.user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone k.tz)::date), cur as (select d.user_id, d.day_status, (select e.status_id from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.workday_id = d.workday_id and e.kind in ('start','status') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event v where v.tenant_id = :tenant_id and v.supersedes_event_id = e.id) order by e.occurred_at desc, e.recorded_at desc limit 1) as status_id from day d) select c.user_id, case when c.day_status is null then 'notClockedIn' when c.day_status = 'ended' or c.status_id is null then 'clockedOut' when s.is_working and s.is_productive then 'productive' when s.is_working then 'otherWork' when s.is_paid then 'paidPause' else 'unpaidPause' end as grp from cur c left join cma.work_status s on s.tenant_id = :tenant_id and s.id = c.status_id order by 1
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Live board (increment b); api.md, GET /api/v1/team/now; data-model/0001-0005b.md, Team now (0003e); features.md §9, Live; decisions.md 7 Oct 2026 (groups from flags, never a key or name)

**Notes**

The grouping never reads a status key or name (lib/live.ts header comment). An inactive status a day still runs in keeps its stored flags and gets the Inactive badge (LiveBoard.tsx:212). The row shows the status name, or the group label when the day ended. No customer data: staff only (rule 15 ok).

#### `live.tiles.group_count`

**Productive / Other work / Paid pause / Unpaid pause** on /live/board · Productive / Other work / Paid pause / Unpaid pause (Productief / Ander werk / Betaalde pauze / Onbetaalde pauze)

How many people are in each flag group right now. One tile per group that at least one ACTIVE status of the tenant belongs to (Pulse4all has no Paid pause tile); a tile is also a filter.

**Formula as computed**

```
count of liveRows whose liveGroupOf(person) = the tile's group, over ALL rows (before any group/employer/team filter). Tiles shown: LIVE_GROUPS filtered to groupOf(flags) over the tenant's active statuses (cma.work_status where status = 'active'), plus always clockedOut and notClockedIn.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now, per_group · **Status** discrepancy

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | user_id, business_date, status | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: /api/v1/me/day/* → cma.open_workday() etc.; scheduler close (0005a) | event-driven; the page re-reads every 10 s while visible |
| `cma.time_event` | workday_id, kind, status_id, occurred_at | CMA | the same write paths, via cma.time_interval / cma.workday_summary | event-driven; re-read every 10 s |
| `cma.work_status` | is_working, is_productive, is_paid, status, sort_order | CMA | tenant configuration (cma.upsert_work_status, 0005a); getTeamNow reads the active flags in the same transaction (postgres.ts:1432) | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.team_now()'s tenant filter; the statusFlags read runs under the same tenant transaction
- people whose time is kept only
- counts are over all rows, deliberately before the client-side group/employer/team filters (code comment lib/live.ts tiles())
- tiles only for groups with at least one active status, plus Clocked out and Not clocked in always

**Time** now = the server read; today in each person's own zone

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** on page load; re-read every 10 s while the tab is visible (LiveRefresh)

**Computed in** `cma.team_now` (0003e); `tiles` in src/lib/live.ts; `liveGroupOf` in src/lib/live.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with kept as (select u.id as user_id, cma.user_timezone(u.id) as tz from cma.app_user u where u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cma.time_is_kept(u.id)), cur as (select k.user_id, w.status as day_status, (select e.status_id from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.workday_id = w.id and e.kind in ('start','status') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event v where v.tenant_id = :tenant_id and v.supersedes_event_id = e.id) order by e.occurred_at desc, e.recorded_at desc limit 1) as status_id from kept k left join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.user_id = k.user_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone k.tz)::date) select case when c.day_status is null then 'notClockedIn' when c.day_status = 'ended' or c.status_id is null then 'clockedOut' when s.is_working and s.is_productive then 'productive' when s.is_working then 'otherWork' when s.is_paid then 'paidPause' else 'unpaidPause' end as grp, count(*) from cur c left join cma.work_status s on s.tenant_id = :tenant_id and s.id = c.status_id group by 1 order by 1
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Live board (increment b); data-model/0001-0005b.md, Team now (0003e); features.md §9, Live

**Notes**

Edge (finding): the present set comes from ACTIVE statuses only, but a person can still be on the clock in a retired status; if its group has no active status left, the row shows and no tile counts it, so the tile sum can be less than the people shown. Zero state: a group with an active status but nobody in it shows 0; a group with no active status shows no tile at all (intended, lib/live.ts:54-58). The counts stay the whole-board counts while a filter is on (intended).

#### `live.people.since`

**Since** on /live/board · Since (Sinds)

How long the person has been in their current status, ticking by the second.

**Formula as computed**

```
secondsSince(statusSince, now) = max(0, floor((now - statusSince)/1000)), formatted h:mm:ss or m:ss (fmtSeconds). statusSince = cma.team_now().status_since = max(from_at) of the day's open, uncapped interval (any status). Blank once the day ended (status_since null) and on the server render before the client clock starts.
```

**Unit** seconds · **Grain** now, per_person · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.time_event` | workday_id, kind, status_id, occurred_at | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/me/status → cma.set_status(), /me/day/start; read via cma.time_interval | event-driven; the row re-reads every 10 s, the tick is client-side every second |

**Filters**

- tenant: as the board
- the open (not capped) interval only: null while nothing runs or past the workday window

**Time** ticks on the browser's clock (Date.now, floored to whole seconds) against the server's instant; never negative

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Computed in** `cma.team_now` (0003e); `secondsSince` in src/lib/live.ts; `fmtSeconds` in src/lib/live.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select e.user_id, extract(epoch from (now() - max(e.occurred_at)))::int as since_seconds from cma.time_event e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id and w.status = 'open' and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date and now() <= cma.business_day_end(w.business_date, w.timezone) where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event v where v.tenant_id = :tenant_id and v.supersedes_event_id = e.id) group by e.user_id
```

**Notes**

cma.team_now() deliberately returns the instant, never the elapsed figure, so two reads of an unchanged team are byte-equal and the screen ticks on its own. Blank ('' not 0) before the first client tick and for an ended day — correct empty state.

#### `live.people.worked_so_far`

**Worked so far** on /live/board · Worked so far (Tot nu gewerkt)

The seconds the person has worked today (working statuses only, pauses excluded), ticking on screen like the clock on My day.

**Formula as computed**

```
workedSeconds(clock, now) = closedSeconds + (runningSince ? secondsSince(runningSince, now) : 0). closedSeconds = sum of interval seconds where the interval's status is_working and (not open or capped); runningSince = start of the open working, uncapped stretch. The database counts an open stretch only to the workday window's end (cma.business_day_end, 0008b); an ended day has nothing running, so its figure stands still.
```

**Unit** seconds · **Grain** now, per_person · **Status** discrepancy

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.time_event` | workday_id, kind, status_id, occurred_at, supersedes_event_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write paths (clock in, status, clock out, corrections), read via the view cma.time_interval (0002, recut 0008b) | event-driven; the server inputs re-read every 10 s, the tick is client-side every second |
| `cma.work_status` | is_working | CMA | tenant configuration (0005a); the flags of a status with time behind it are frozen | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: as the board
- is_working stretches only (pauses excluded)
- an open stretch capped at the workday window's end by the database

**Time** ticks on the browser's clock; the server inputs count to least(now(), cma.business_day_end) in the day's own zone

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** server inputs every 10 s; the figure ticks client-side every second; before the client clock starts the closed part alone is shown

**Computed in** `cma.team_now` (0003e); `cma.time_interval` (0008b); `workedSeconds` in src/lib/live.ts; `fmtSeconds` in src/lib/live.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with ev as (select e.workday_id, e.user_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as next_at, cma.business_day_end(w.business_date, w.timezone) as day_end from cma.time_event e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id and w.business_date = (now() at time zone w.timezone)::date where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event v where v.tenant_id = :tenant_id and v.supersedes_event_id = e.id)) select ev.user_id, sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (coalesce(ev.next_at, least(now(), ev.day_end)) - ev.occurred_at)))))::bigint as worked_seconds from ev join cma.work_status s on s.tenant_id = :tenant_id and s.id = ev.status_id and s.is_working where ev.kind in ('start','status') group by ev.user_id order by 1
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Live board (increment b); api.md, Status and clock; data-model/0008.md, Workday window (0008b)

**Notes**

Cross-page nuance (finding): workedSeconds() supports a dayEndsAt cap and My day passes it, but LiveBoard.tsx:93 calls it without one (deliberate per the lib comment: 'the Live board passes none and shows what its read returned'). Between two 10 s polls the board can therefore tick up to ~10 s past the workday window's end and snap back on the next read. The verify_sql reproduces the database's capped count; the on-screen figure adds the client tick since the read.

#### `live.people.shift_today`

**Shift today** on /live/board · Shift today (Dienst vandaag)

What the published roster plans for the person today: the shift as 09:00–17:30, the absence's name, 'No shift' (a published week covers the person but the cell is empty), or 'Not published' (no published roster covers the person today).

**Formula as computed**

```
cma.roster_today(): per person whose time is kept, today's entry from cma.roster_published_entry (entries recorded on or before the week's latest publication and not ended before it; a draft week contributes nothing; the latest publication wins across overlapping rosters), with is_published = a published roster week covers today and, for a team roster, the person was a member at publication. Label: cellLabel (start–end sliced to hh:mm) or absence name; !isPublished -> 'Not published'; isPublished and kind null -> 'No shift'.
```

**Unit** text · **Grain** now, per_person · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.roster_entry` | user_id, business_date, kind, start_time, end_time, absence_type_id, recorded_at, valid_to | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: PUT /api/v1/roster/weeks/{monday}/cells → cma.roster_set_entry() (versioned rows) | event-driven (planner edits); the board re-reads every 10 s |

**Filters**

- published entries only, as of each week's latest publication (the planner's unpublished edits never show here)
- people whose time is kept only
- team-roster coverage counts membership at publication time

**Time** today = business date in the person's own zone; shift times are local times in the person's zone, 00:00–24:00, never across midnight (decision, 7 Oct 2026)

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** on page load; re-read every 10 s while the tab is visible

**Computed in** `cma.roster_today` (0005); `cma.roster_published_entry` (0005); `LiveBoardPage` in src/app/live/board/page.tsx; `cellLabel` in src/lib/roster.ts

```sql
select distinct on (e.user_id) e.user_id, e.kind, e.start_time, e.end_time, a.name as absence_name from cma.roster_entry e join cma.roster_week w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.roster_week_id and w.status = 'published' and e.recorded_at <= w.published_at and (e.valid_to is null or e.valid_to > w.published_at) left join cma.absence_type a on a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.id = e.absence_type_id where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.business_date = (now() at time zone cma.user_timezone(e.user_id))::date order by e.user_id, w.published_at desc
```

#### `live.people.adherence_flag`

**Late / Left early / Expected / Absent / Not planned** on /live/board · Late / Left early / Expected / Absent / Not planned (Te laat / Eerder weg / Verwacht / Afwezig / Niet gepland)

The badge next to today's shift comparing the plan with the actual clock, with the tenant's tolerance: Late (clocked in after the planned start plus tolerance), Left early (clocked out before the planned end minus tolerance), Expected (the start has passed, nobody clocked in), Absent (an absence planned, not on the clock), Not planned (on the clock without a planned shift). On time is computed but never shown as a badge.

**Formula as computed**

```
adherence(planned, actual, date, person zone, nowMs, tol): no plan -> startedAt ? unplanned : null; plan is absence -> startedAt ? unplanned : absent; no actual start -> now > plannedStart + tol*60000 ? expected : null; endedAt < plannedEnd - tol -> leftEarly; startedAt > plannedStart + tol -> late; else onTime. plannedInstant resolves the local hh:mm on the date in the person's zone (earlier instant on the repeated autumn hour; 24:00 = next day 00:00). nowMs is the server render's clock, refreshed every 10 s.
```

**Unit** flag · **Grain** now, per_person · **Status** ambiguous

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.roster_entry` | kind, start_time, end_time, business_date | CMA | planner writes via cma.roster_set_entry(); read through cma.roster_today() (published only) | event-driven; re-read every 10 s |
| `cma.workday` | started_at, ended_at | CMA | the Workspace's own clock writes, via cma.team_now() | event-driven; re-read every 10 s |
| `cma.setting` | key, default_value | CMA | catalog row seeded by db/23_roster.sql; tenant override via PUT /api/v1/configuration/settings → cma.set_tenant_setting() | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: both reads are tenant-filtered functions
- published shift only (a draft never flags anyone)
- no flag while there is nothing to say: before the start plus tolerance, or on time

**Time** planned instants resolved in the person's zone (lib/corrections instantsForLocal; DST: the earlier instant when a time occurs twice, verified by verify:roster across the autumn change); now = the server render, at most 10 s old

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `roster.adherence_tolerance_minutes` | 5 (db/23_roster.sql) | 5 (seed 02 sets no override; the catalog default) |

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** computed on each server render; the page re-reads every 10 s while visible, so a flag can appear up to 10 s late; it does not tick client-side

**Computed in** `cma.roster_today` (0005); `cma.team_now` (0003e); `adherence` in src/lib/roster.ts; `plannedInstant` in src/lib/roster.ts; `LiveBoardPage` in src/app/live/board/page.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select distinct on (e.user_id) e.user_id, e.kind, e.start_time, e.end_time, ((e.business_date::text || ' ' || case when e.start_time = '24:00' then '00:00' else coalesce(e.start_time::text,'') end)::timestamp at time zone wd.timezone) as planned_start_at, ((e.business_date + case when e.end_time = '24:00' then 1 else 0 end)::text || ' ' || case when e.end_time = '24:00' then '00:00' else coalesce(e.end_time::text,'') end)::timestamp at time zone wd.timezone as planned_end_at, wd.started_at, wd.ended_at from cma.roster_entry e join cma.roster_week w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.roster_week_id and w.status = 'published' and e.recorded_at <= w.published_at and (e.valid_to is null or e.valid_to > w.published_at) left join cma.workday wd on wd.tenant_id = :tenant_id and wd.user_id = e.user_id and wd.business_date = e.business_date where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.business_date = (now() at time zone cma.user_timezone(e.user_id))::date order by e.user_id, w.published_at desc
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Roster planner, print view and My schedule (0005): the Live board's shift line; data-model/0001-0005b.md, Roster (0005), Setting; decisions.md 8 Oct 2026: the flags are derived in the web from the plan and the clock, never stored; features.md §9, Live

**Notes**

The flag is computed in the WEB (src/lib/roster.ts adherence), not in SQL — computed_in.sql lists only the two input reads, and verify_sql is the closest check: it returns the planned instants and the actual clock so the flag can be re-derived by hand with the tolerance; a faithful SQL recomputation would have to re-implement the zone/DST rule of instantsForLocal. Precedence nuance (finding): leftEarly is tested before late, so a person both late and early shows only Left early; no doc states this. 'Absent' with a clock-in shows 'Not planned' (unplanned). The page falls back to 5 when the setting row is missing from the read (page.tsx:63), duplicating the catalog default in code. DST note: at the spring gap a planned time that does not exist yields null instants and no flag (instantsForLocal returns no instant).

#### `live.inbound.offered`

**Inbound** on /live/board · Inbound (Inkomend)

Inbound calls received today on the organisation's counted lines, whatever their outcome.

**Formula as computed**

```
offered = count(telephony calls with direction='inbound', source_deleted_at null, started_at set, on a counted line (coalesce(telephony_number.is_counted, true) — a line not in the catalog counts), started in [tenant midnight, next midnight) in the tenant's zone). 0008f stores no calls of uncounted lines, so the is_counted filter is belt and braces.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.inbound_today_of (cma.current_tenant_id())
- direction = inbound; source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- today window on started_at in the tenant's zone (not on the business date)

**Time** Today = calls started in [tenant midnight, next midnight) in the tenant's zone (cma.inbound_today_of); waiting is relative to the database's now(); the business date each call would get on the report is its line's market zone instead (cross-page note)

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** On page load; the page re-reads itself every 10 s while the tab is visible (LiveRefresh); GET /api/v1/telephony/inbound-now computes on request from live tables (no snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.inbound_today` (0008i); `cma.inbound_today_of` (0008i); `cma.inbound_calls_of` (0008i); `inboundTileValue` in src/lib/live.ts; `getInboundNow` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.service_level_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.service_level_seconds'))::int) as sl, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'))::int) as wm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c as (select tc.answered_at, tc.source_system, greatest(0, extract(epoch from tc.answered_at - tc.started_at)) as answer_s, (tc.answered_at is null and tc.ended_at is null and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(mins => s.wm)) as waiting, coalesce(nullif(btrim(tc.missed_reason), ''), 'unknown') as code, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, extract(hour from tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::int as bhour, tc.started_at, s.sl, s.wm, s.tz from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)) select count(*) as offered from c where c.started_at >= (now() at time zone c.tz)::date::timestamp at time zone c.tz and c.started_at < ((now() at time zone c.tz)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone c.tz
```

**Fixture check** Ran against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and matched the page's own function for the last 30 days (7).

**Documented in** features.md §5 and api.md §Live board, Inbound today and the missed calls (0008i); kpis.md §9; api.md, GET /api/v1/telephony/inbound-now; data-model/0008.md, Inbound service and callbacks (0008i)

**Notes**

Cross-page: this tile windows calls by started_at in the TENANT'S zone (since its midnight), while Reports → Inbound grouped by day puts each call on its business date in the LINE'S market zone, so for a line in another zone today's row there can differ from this tile (intentional and stated in the hint 'in the organisation's time zone' / the report's intro; see findings). Measures themselves are the same code path (cma.inbound_calls_of + identical aggregates). Tenant without telephony: the whole row is replaced by 'No telephony connected', never 0; with telephony and no calls, 0 is shown. InboundLive.tsx line 48 (label copy.live.inboundOffered).

#### `live.inbound.unanswered_share`

**Unanswered** on /live/board · Unanswered (Niet aangenomen)

Unanswered inbound calls today as a share of the calls that already have an outcome (a waiting call has none yet).

**Formula as computed**

```
unanswered = count(not answered and not waiting); waiting = not answered, not ended, started within telephony.waiting_max_minutes. share = round1(100 * unanswered / (answered + unanswered)); null (a dash) when answered + unanswered = 0. Computed in TS (unansweredPct) from the API's answered and unanswered counts.
```

#### `live.inbound.service_level`

**Service level** on /live/board · Service level (Servicelevel)

Share of today's inbound calls answered within the tenant's service-level seconds, over the calls whose reason counts.

**Formula as computed**

```
numerator = count(answered and answer_seconds <= telephony.service_level_seconds) — at most, so exactly N seconds is within; answer_seconds = answered_at − started_at (menu and ringing included, as Aircall reports). denominator = count(answered) + count(unanswered whose missed reason has counts_in_service_level, default true for a code without a catalog row; reason 'unknown' when missing); waiting calls excluded. pct = round1(100 * num / den); null (dash) when den = 0.
```

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.service_level_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.service_level_seconds'))::int) as sl, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'))::int) as wm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c as (select tc.answered_at, tc.source_system, greatest(0, extract(epoch from tc.answered_at - tc.started_at)) as answer_s, (tc.answered_at is null and tc.ended_at is null and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(mins => s.wm)) as waiting, coalesce(nullif(btrim(tc.missed_reason), ''), 'unknown') as code, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, extract(hour from tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::int as bhour, tc.started_at, s.sl, s.wm, s.tz from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)) select count(*) filter (where c.waiting) as waiting_now from c where c.started_at >= now() - make_interval(mins => c.wm)
```

#### `live.inbound.longest_waiting`

**Longest waiting** on /live/board · Longest waiting (Langst wachtend)

How long the call waiting longest has been waiting so far.

**Formula as computed**

```
longest_waiting_seconds = floor(epoch(now() − min(started_at) over the waiting calls of live.inbound.waiting_now)), floored at 0; null when nobody waits — the tile then shows the words 'Nobody waiting', never 0 or a dash.
```

#### `live.missed.listed`

**Missed, not called back** on /live/board · Missed, not called back (Gemist, niet teruggebeld)

One row per caller whose latest missed call of the lookback was not followed by any call to them or answered call from them.

**Formula as computed**

```
rows = per counterpart_hash the latest (started_at desc, id desc) missed inbound call with needs_callback, within telephony.callback_lookback_days, having no later callback (see filters); ordered oldest first, then source_id. Columns Line (line name, else 'Unknown line'), Market (code, 'unknown' shown as 'Unknown market'), Reason (catalog label, the code itself without a row, 'Unknown' for code unknown) are identity columns from the same row.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now, per_caller · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |
| `cma.telephony_missed_reason` | source_system, code, label, counts_in_service_level, needs_callback | CMA | seed 02 (six Aircall codes), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Sources → cma.set_telephony_missed_reason(); never deleted | on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.callback_lookback_days, telephony.waiting_max_minutes | CMA | seed 02, then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.missed_callbacks_of; the hash matched inside one tenant only, never returned
- missed = inbound, not deleted, counted line, unanswered and not waiting, started within telephony.callback_lookback_days of now()
- listed = per caller (counterpart_hash) the LATEST missed call whose reason needs_callback (catalog, default true), with no later callback

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.callback_lookback_days'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.callback_lookback_days'))::int) as lb, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'))::int) as wm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), f as (select tc.id, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, tc.started_at, tc.counterpart_hash as h, coalesce(m.code, 'unknown') as market, coalesce(mr.needs_callback, true) as nc from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market left join cma.telephony_missed_reason mr on mr.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and mr.source_system = tc.source_system and mr.code = coalesce(nullif(btrim(tc.missed_reason), ''), 'unknown') where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(days => s.lb) and tc.answered_at is null and not (tc.ended_at is null and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(mins => s.wm))), l as (select distinct on (h) * from f where nc and h is not null order by h, started_at desc, id desc), k as (select l.*, (select max(o.started_at) from cma.telephony_call o where o.tenant_id = :tenant_id and o.counterpart_hash = l.h and o.source_deleted_at is null and (o.direction = 'outbound' or (o.direction = 'inbound' and o.answered_at is not null)) and o.started_at > l.started_at) as nxt, (select max(o.started_at) from cma.telephony_call o where o.tenant_id = :tenant_id and o.counterpart_hash = l.h and o.source_deleted_at is null and (o.direction = 'outbound' or (o.direction = 'inbound' and o.answered_at is not null)) and o.started_at < l.started_at) as prev from l)select k.source_id, k.market, k.started_at as missed_at, (select count(*) from f where f.h = k.h and (k.prev is null or f.started_at > k.prev)) as missed_count, greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from now() - k.started_at)))::int as waiting_seconds, cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(k.market, 'unknown'), k.started_at, now()) as waiting_business_seconds from k where k.nxt is null order by k.started_at, k.source_id
```

#### `live.missed.waiting`

**Waiting** on /live/board · Waiting (Wacht)

How long the missed caller has been waiting for a callback, in office time of the line's market.

**Formula as computed**

```
waiting_business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, market, started_at, now()) — office hours and holidays of the line's market; null for a line without a market (market 'unknown'), the screen then shows the elapsed time since the call in Muted with a 'since the call' title. Shown as business minutes (floor(seconds/60), fmtBusinessMinutes). When business seconds = 0 while elapsed > 0 the cell says 'Closed' (Muted) with the elapsed time in its title instead of '0 min' (IT audit 17 Oct 2026; callbackWaiting in lib/live.ts).
```

- callback = any later outbound call to the caller (connected or not) OR any later answered inbound call from them, on any telephony connection of the tenant, not deleted
- calls without a hash are never listed (counted apart as anonymous)
- office time of the LINE'S market (never the tenant's zone); a line without a market gets elapsed time, not business time

**Time** Office time per the line's market's hours and holidays; now() is the database's clock

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.callback_lookback_days` | 3 | 3 (seed 02) |
| `telephony.waiting_max_minutes` | 30 | 30 (seed 02) |

**Who may see it** `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** On page load; the page re-reads itself every 10 s while the tab is visible (LiveRefresh); GET /api/v1/telephony/inbound-now computes on request from live tables (no snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.missed_callbacks` (0008i); `cma.missed_callbacks_of` (0008i); `cma.inbound_calls_of` (0008i); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `callbackWaiting` in src/lib/live.ts; `MissedCallbacks` in src/components/InboundLive.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.callback_lookback_days'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.callback_lookback_days'))::int) as lb, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'))::int) as wm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), f as (select tc.id, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, tc.started_at, tc.counterpart_hash as h, coalesce(m.code, 'unknown') as market, coalesce(mr.needs_callback, true) as nc from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market left join cma.telephony_missed_reason mr on mr.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and mr.source_system = tc.source_system and mr.code = coalesce(nullif(btrim(tc.missed_reason), ''), 'unknown') where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(days => s.lb) and tc.answered_at is null and not (tc.ended_at is null and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(mins => s.wm))), l as (select distinct on (h) * from f where nc and h is not null order by h, started_at desc, id desc), k as (select l.*, (select max(o.started_at) from cma.telephony_call o where o.tenant_id = :tenant_id and o.counterpart_hash = l.h and o.source_deleted_at is null and (o.direction = 'outbound' or (o.direction = 'inbound' and o.answered_at is not null)) and o.started_at > l.started_at) as nxt, (select max(o.started_at) from cma.telephony_call o where o.tenant_id = :tenant_id and o.counterpart_hash = l.h and o.source_deleted_at is null and (o.direction = 'outbound' or (o.direction = 'inbound' and o.answered_at is not null)) and o.started_at < l.started_at) as prev from l)select k.source_id, k.market, k.started_at as missed_at, (select count(*) from f where f.h = k.h and (k.prev is null or f.started_at > k.prev)) as missed_count, greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from now() - k.started_at)))::int as waiting_seconds, cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(k.market, 'unknown'), k.started_at, now()) as waiting_business_seconds from k where k.nxt is null order by k.started_at, k.source_id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 6 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** features.md §5 / api.md §Live board, Missed, not called back; kpis.md §9 (missed calls not yet called back); api.md, GET /api/v1/telephony/inbound-now; data-model/0008.md (0008i); decisions.md 14 Oct 2026 (called back; times missed; counterpart_hash third purpose)

**Notes**

verify_sql reuses the helper cma.business_seconds_of because the figure's own function is missed_callbacks_of, not the helper (allowed per the brief); an independent recomputation of office seconds would reimplement the whole market-hours model. Audit rule 7: a record without a market behaves as documented (elapsed time, muted). 'Closed' state covers rule 13 (a wrong 0).

#### `live.missed.times_missed`

**Times missed** on /live/board · Times missed (Keer gemist)

How often this caller was missed since their last callback, within the lookback.

**Formula as computed**

```
missed_count = count(the caller's missed calls in the lookback, EVERY reason (needs_callback or not), with started_at > the latest callback BEFORE the listed call; all of them when no earlier callback). Missed Monday, called back Monday, missed Tuesday = 1 (Martin, 14 Oct 2026).
```

## Dashboard

### /reports/dashboard

#### `dashboard.time.worked_minutes`

**Worked** on /reports/dashboard · Worked (Gewerkt)

Time clocked in a working status over the period, for the people shown: whole minutes per person per day, added up, exactly as Team hours adds them.

**Formula as computed**

```
workedMinutes = sum over person-days of floor(sum(seconds where is_working)/60), from cma.team_status_time rows grouped per (user, date) (dashboard.ts summarise/personDays). The hint shows 'Working statuses'; the info hint explains the Team hours equivalence.
```

**Unit** minutes · **Grain** period · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.time_event` | kind, status_id, occurred_at, recorded_at, supersedes_event_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write paths (open_workday, set_status, end_workday, correct_workday); the scheduler job cma-close-forgotten-workdays → cma.close_forgotten_workdays(); the legacy import cma.load_import_batch() (0008d) | immediately on each click; the sweep hourly (docs/scheduler/deploy.sh; the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo); import one-off |
| `cma.work_status` | is_working | CMA | migration seed + tenant seed 02 | on configuration change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | key, value | CMA | cma.set_tenant_setting(); seed 02 | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- tenant: the time_interval face per row's tenant plus RLS
- performance.team asserted inside cma.team_status_time (CMA06 → 403)
- period on business_date, at most 92 days (CMA04)
- the person filter narrows the rows client-side (one tenant-wide read)
- is_working statuses only
- counted time capped at the day's window end

**Time** Business dates in each day's own snapshot zone; period picked in the viewer's zone; open days run to now() and cap at workday.window_end.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_end` | 24:00 | 22:00 |

**Who may see it** `performance.team`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.team_status_time` (0003c); `cma.time_interval` (0008b); `summarise` in src/lib/dashboard.ts; `DashboardPage` in src/app/reports/dashboard/page.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),
iv as (select w.user_id, w.business_date, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at as from_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as to_at, ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone) as day_end from eff e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where w.business_date between :from and :to),
per_day as (select iv.user_id, iv.business_date, floor(coalesce(sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at))))) filter (where ws.is_working), 0) / 60)::bigint as m from iv join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = iv.status_id where iv.kind in ('start','status') group by iv.user_id, iv.business_date)
select sum(m) as worked_minutes from per_day
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Dashboard; data-model/0001-0005b.md, Time per status (0003c); decisions.md 7 Oct 2026 (whole minutes per person per day, as Team hours)

**Notes**

Rounding identical to Team hours and the hours CSV by construction (same stretches, floor per person-day, then sum; 0003c header: 'the working seconds of a day equal Team hours by construction'). verify_sql assumes no person filter; add user_id = :user_id to iv for one person.

#### `dashboard.time.productive_share`

**Productive** on /reports/dashboard · Productive (Productief)

The share of worked time spent in productive (customer-facing) statuses.

**Formula as computed**

```
share = productiveSeconds / workedSeconds on raw seconds (not floored minutes): productiveSeconds = sum(seconds where is_working and is_productive), workedSeconds = sum(seconds where is_working); null when workedSeconds = 0, rendered as a dash. Shown as whole percents; '< 1%' for a positive share under 0.5%. The hint names the productive time in minutes.
```

**Unit** share · **Grain** period · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.time_event` | kind, status_id, occurred_at | CMA | the Workspace's own write paths; the sweep; the legacy import | immediately on each click; the sweep hourly; import one-off |
| `cma.work_status` | is_working, is_productive | CMA | migration seed + tenant seed 02 | on configuration change |

**Filters**

- as dashboard.time.worked_minutes; the numerator additionally requires is_productive

**Time** As dashboard.time.worked_minutes.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_end` | 24:00 | 22:00 |

**Who may see it** `performance.team`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.team_status_time` (0003c); `summarise` in src/lib/dashboard.ts; `share` in src/lib/dashboard.ts; `fmtPercent` in src/lib/time.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),
iv as (select e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at as from_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as to_at, ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone) as day_end from eff e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where w.business_date between :from and :to)
select case when sum(s) filter (where ws.is_working) > 0 then (sum(s) filter (where ws.is_working and ws.is_productive))::numeric / (sum(s) filter (where ws.is_working)) end as productive_share
from (select iv.kind, iv.status_id, greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at)))) as s from iv where iv.kind in ('start','status')) x
join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = x.status_id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Dashboard; copy.ts hints.productive

**Notes**

Denominator is worked time, matching the label's definition (audit rule 5); zero worked time shows a dash, never 0% (rule 13). Raw seconds, not floored minutes — a deliberate precision choice that cannot disagree visibly with the minute tiles.

#### `dashboard.time.groups`

**Groups** on /reports/dashboard · Groups (legend) (Groepen)

The period's time per flag group: Productive, Other work, Paid pause, Unpaid pause — the legend above the charts.

```
groupOf(flags): is_working && is_productive → productive; is_working → otherWork; is_paid → paidPause; else unpaidPause. Seconds summed per group over the rows; shown as Xh YYm (floored minutes of each group's second total).
```

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),
iv as (select e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at as from_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as to_at, ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone) as day_end from eff e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where w.business_date between :from and :to)
select case when ws.is_working and ws.is_productive then 'productive' when ws.is_working then 'otherWork' when ws.is_paid then 'paidPause' else 'unpaidPause' end as grp,
 sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at)))))::bigint as seconds
```

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),
iv as (select w.business_date, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at as from_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as to_at, ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone) as day_end from eff e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where w.business_date between :from and :to)
select iv.business_date, case when ws.is_working and ws.is_productive then 'productive' when ws.is_working then 'otherWork' when ws.is_paid then 'paidPause' else 'unpaidPause' end as grp, sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at)))))::bigint as seconds
from iv join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = iv.status_id where iv.kind in ('start','status') group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 4 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Dashboard

**Notes**

A day without time shows a zero gap, not a skipped axis day (rule 13). Charts are plain SVG, no chart library (decision 7 Oct 2026).

#### `dashboard.time.per_person`

**Per person** on /reports/dashboard · Per person (Per persoon)

One stacked bar per person, by name: their clocked time split by group, with worked and paid minutes as on Team hours. No ranking.

```
byPerson(rows): per person groups summed from seconds; workedMinutes/paidMinutes = sum over that person's days of floor(day seconds/60) (personDays, the Team hours rule). Sorted by display name, then userId.
```

| `cma.work_status` | is_working, is_productive, is_paid | CMA | migration seed + tenant seed 02 | on configuration change |

- as dashboard.time.worked_minutes

**Time** As dashboard.time.worked_minutes.

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_end` | 24:00 | 22:00 |

**Who may see it** `performance.team`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.team_status_time` (0003c); `byPerson` in src/lib/dashboard.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),
iv as (select w.user_id, w.business_date, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at as from_at, lead(e.occurred_at) over (partition by e.workday_id order by e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at, e.id) as to_at, ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone) as day_end from eff e join cma.workday w on w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.id = e.workday_id where w.business_date between :from and :to),
per_day as (select iv.user_id, iv.business_date, floor(coalesce(sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at))))) filter (where ws.is_working), 0) / 60)::bigint as wm, floor(coalesce(sum(greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (least(coalesce(iv.to_at, now()), iv.day_end) - iv.from_at))))) filter (where ws.is_paid), 0) / 60)::bigint as pm from iv join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = iv.status_id where iv.kind in ('start','status') group by iv.user_id, iv.business_date)
select u.display_name, sum(pd.wm) as worked_minutes, sum(pd.pm) as paid_minutes from per_day pd join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = pd.user_id group by u.id, u.display_name order by u.display_name, u.id
```

#### `dashboard.time.capped_days_note`

**(warning notice)** on /reports/dashboard · Days not clocked out (note)

How many person-days in the period were not clocked out, so their time stops at the end of the day until someone corrects it in Team hours.

**Formula as computed**

```
cappedDays = count of person-days where any of the day's status rows has is_capped (an open stretch past the day's window end) (dashboard.ts summarise/personDays).
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.workday` | status, business_date, timezone | CMA | the Workspace's own write paths; the sweep closes such days, after which they leave this count | immediately on each click; the sweep hourly (docs/scheduler/deploy.sh) |

**Filters**

- as dashboard.time.worked_minutes

**Time** now() against each day's window end at page load.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `workday.window_end` | 24:00 | 22:00 |

**Who may see it** `performance.team`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.team_status_time` (0003c); `cma.time_interval` (0008b); `summarise` in src/lib/dashboard.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end')
select count(*) as capped_days from cma.workday w where w.tenant_id = :tenant_id and w.business_date between :from and :to and w.status = 'open' and now() > ((w.business_date + (select w_end from win)) at time zone w.timezone)
```

Counts still-open capped days only. A day the sweep already closed reads 'not clocked out' nowhere here, while Welcome's Needs attention counts it (needsCorrection) and Team hours flags it Needs a correction — three screens, two definitions of 'not clocked out'. See finding.


**Sources**

| `cma.connection_form` | is_counted, lead_condition, market | CMA | catalog hourly; configuration on Sources | hourly / on demand |

**Filters**

- page gate: performance.team only (page.tsx:34); the intake/speed/callbacks SQL functions would also accept reports.view, but this page never renders without performance.team
