                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d
  cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c
    on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                  and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                       or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts))))
  group by d.id),
m as (
  select d.*, fo.fo_at, s.target_s,
         case when fo.fo_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, fo.fo_at) end as bs,
         case when fo.fo_at is null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) end as bs_now,
         cma.next_business_noon_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at) as noon
  from d cross join s left join fo on fo.deal_id = d.id)
select m.business_date,
       count(*) as deals,
       count(m.fo_at) as called,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.bs))::numeric / 60, 1) as median_business_minutes,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end), 0), 1) as within_target_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end), 0), 1) as before_next_noon_pct,
       count(*) filter (where m.fo_at is null and not m.is_closed) as open_not_called
from m group by m.business_date order by m.business_date
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 20 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every call linked to a contact and a deal (kpis.md paragraph 11) (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)
- Aircall-HubSpot call link so the effective start is the telephony call's (data quality check `telephony_call_unlinked`)
- Lead deals carry a contact (speed to lead needs the contact's calls) (data quality check `deal_without_contact`)
- Country on the deal or its primary contact, so business time has a market (data quality check `market_not_in_catalog`)
- No test deals in the live pipeline

**Documented in** docs/night-2026-10-10/DESIGN.md paragraph 4.4; features.md paragraph 4 (Speed to lead); kpis.md paragraph 1; api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/speed-to-lead; api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/speed-to-lead/rows; data-model (lead metrics, 0007d); decisions.md 10 Oct 2026 (definition), 12 Oct 2026 (Self Serve not a lead pipeline), 15 Oct 2026 (p80 dropped)

**Notes**

db/40:157-186 (noon), :473-475 (flag), :828 (share). The KPI wording 'called before 12:00 the next working day' (kpis.md paragraph 1) is met; the comparison uses the call's instant against the market-local noon. Deals in market 'unknown' are excluded (noon null). As with within_target, a not-called deal flips null->false only when now() crosses noon, so the share of a running day firms up during the morning. One query recomputes the whole day-grouped summary (cma.business_seconds_of, next_business_noon_of, record_market_of and setting_of are 0007d helpers, not the figure's own functions); compare the column this entry names. Swap the final GROUP BY for market/agent/pipeline to verify the other groupings.

#### `speed_to_lead.open_not_called`

**Open, not called** on /reports/speed-to-lead · Open, not called (Open, niet gebeld)

Lead deals of the group still open with no outbound call yet - the leads the team can still act on.

**Formula as computed**

```
open_not_called = count(*) filter (where status = 'not_called_open'); status = 'not_called_open' when no first outbound call exists and coalesce(is_closed, false) = false; a closed deal without a call is 'not_called_closed' and counts in deals but not here.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_day, per_market, per_person, per_pipeline · **Status** verified

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() passed explicitly to cma.speed_to_lead_of, under row-level security; the SQL function checks reports.view or performance.team again (CMA06)
- deals only (record_type = 'deal'), not deleted (source_deleted_at is null)
- counted lead pipelines only: coalesce(connection_pipeline.is_counted, true) and coalesce(is_lead, true) - a pipeline not yet reviewed counts and is a lead pipeline (data-quality check pipeline_unreviewed); Sales Pipeline - Self Serve is un-leaded in prod (Decision log 12 Oct 2026)
- created on or after intake.start_date (tenant zone) and inside [:from, :to] as business dates in the tenant zone
- first call: CRM calls of the deal's connection, not deleted, currently associated with the deal or one of its contacts (primary contact plus current deal->contact associations), effective start (linked telephony call's started_at while the link is current and the call not deleted, else crm_call.occurred_at) >= created_at - speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes
- test deals: no filter - 'No test deals in the live pipeline' is a data prerequisite (kpis.md paragraph 11), not code; the only lever is the pipeline counted/lead switches

**Time** Business date = the deal's source_created_at in the tenant's zone (cma.report_range); business minutes counted in the deal's market's office hours (cma.business_hours of the market, else '*', holidays of the market and '*' excluded, each day placed in the market's zone); now = the query's now(); a running period simply ends at :to (no cut to time of day); max 92 days (CMA04)

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date,
         greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
         cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.target_minutes')::integer * 60 as target_s
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed,
         rm.code as market, (d.source_created_at at time zone s.zone)::date as business_date,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d
  cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c
    on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                  and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                       or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts))))
  group by d.id),
m as (
  select d.*, fo.fo_at, s.target_s,
         case when fo.fo_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, fo.fo_at) end as bs,
         case when fo.fo_at is null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) end as bs_now,
         cma.next_business_noon_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at) as noon
  from d cross join s left join fo on fo.deal_id = d.id)
select m.business_date,
       count(*) as deals,
       count(m.fo_at) as called,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.bs))::numeric / 60, 1) as median_business_minutes,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end), 0), 1) as within_target_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end), 0), 1) as before_next_noon_pct,
       count(*) filter (where m.fo_at is null and not m.is_closed) as open_not_called
from m group by m.business_date order by m.business_date
```

  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                  and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                       or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts))))
  group by d.id)
select count(*) as deals, count(fo.fo_at) as called,
       count(*) filter (where fo.fo_at is null and not d.is_closed) as open_not_called
from d left join fo on fo.deal_id = d.id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every call linked to a contact and a deal (kpis.md paragraph 11) (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)
- Aircall-HubSpot call link so the effective start is the telephony call's (data quality check `telephony_call_unlinked`)
- Lead deals carry a contact (speed to lead needs the contact's calls) (data quality check `deal_without_contact`)
- Country on the deal or its primary contact, so business time has a market (data quality check `market_not_in_catalog`)
- No test deals in the live pipeline

**Notes**

Pure TS sum over the database's groups; because every deal is in exactly one group, the totals equal the ungrouped counts. Correctly leaves medians and percentages out (they do not aggregate). The muted cell carries the explanation as title and sr-only text (page.tsx:131-141).

#### `speed_to_lead.open_list.waiting_business_minutes`

**Waiting** on /reports/speed-to-lead · Waiting (Wacht)

In the 'Open deals not called' list: how long the open, not-called deal has been waiting, in office minutes of its market, longest first.

**Formula as computed**

```
waiting_business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, market, created_at, now()) for rows with status 'not_called_open' (null for market 'unknown'). Screen: fmtBusinessMinutes(floor(waiting_business_seconds / 60)). List = rows filtered to not_called_open, ordered waiting desc (null last, as -1), then created_at, then deal_source_id (TS openNotCalled, src/lib/reports.ts:143-147).
```

**Unit** business_minutes · **Grain** per_record · **Status** verified

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date,
         greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed,
         rm.code as market,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone))
select d.source_id,
       cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) as waiting_business_seconds
from d
where not d.is_closed
  and not exists (
    select 1 from d x cross join s
    join cma.crm_call c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = x.connection_id
     and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
    left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
    left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
    where x.id = d.id
      and coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
      and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                  where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                    and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                    and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                         or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts)))))
order by waiting_business_seconds desc nulls last, d.source_created_at, d.source_id
```

### /reports/calls

#### `calls.total`

**Calls** on /reports/calls · Calls (Gesprekken)

```
calls = count(calls of the period); detail line '{conversations} conversations' (see calls.conversations); delta vs the previous period like for like.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, answered_at, ended_at, talk_seconds, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Previous period** Previous period like for like (0008j; decisions.md 14 Oct 2026): prev = [from − len, (period ended ? from − 1 : least(to, today) − len)] with len = to − from + 1, today = now() in the TENANT'S zone; when the period reaches today the previous span's last date counts only calls up to now's time of day in each call's own zone; the current period is never cut. History start (0008k): when prev.from < the business date of the tenant's earliest stored call (tenant-wide, ignoring the filters), the tile shows 'No history to compare yet' (the first date in its title) instead of any change; null history start (no calls) compares as usual. Delta text: ↑/↓ {pct} vs the (same point in the) previous period; 'from none' when previous = 0; 'Unchanged' when equal; Muted always (a volume's change is neither good nor bad).

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component); the API route computes on request from live tables (no snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.calls_overview` (0008zc); `cma.calls_overview_of` (0008zc); `cma.calls_figures_of` (0008zc); `cma.calls_of` (0008zc); `cma.telephony_history_start` (0008k); `getCallsOverview` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `DeltaLine` in src/components/CallsParts.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select count(*) as calls from c where c.bdate between :from and :to
```

#### `calls.avg_talk`

**Average talk time** on /reports/calls · Average talk time (Gemiddelde gesprekstijd)

Average talk time over the period's answered calls, in and out: answer to end, no ringing (Talk time); shorter than Aircall's own duration on purpose.

**Formula as computed**

```
talk_seconds = floor(epoch(ended_at − answered_at)), floored at 0 (generated column, 0007a) — null while unanswered or not ended. avg = round1(avg(talk_seconds) over every call with talk time, either direction); null (dash) without one. Delta compares the averages; 'Nothing to compare' when either side has no call with talk time.
```

**Unit** seconds · **Grain** period · **Status** cadence_unconfirmed, discrepancy

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, answered_at, ended_at, talk_seconds, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Previous period** Previous period like for like (0008j; decisions.md 14 Oct 2026): prev = [from − len, (period ended ? from − 1 : least(to, today) − len)] with len = to − from + 1, today = now() in the TENANT'S zone; when the period reaches today the previous span's last date counts only calls up to now's time of day in each call's own zone; the current period is never cut. History start (0008k): when prev.from < the business date of the tenant's earliest stored call (tenant-wide, ignoring the filters), the tile shows 'No history to compare yet' (the first date in its title) instead of any change; null history start (no calls) compares as usual. Delta text: ↑/↓ {pct} vs the (same point in the) previous period; 'from none' when previous = 0; 'Unchanged' when equal; Muted always (a volume's change is neither good nor bad).

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |

from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select round(avg(c.talk_seconds), 1) as talk_seconds_avg from c where c.bdate between :from and :to

#### `calls.chart`

**Calls per day / week / market / line** on /reports/calls · Calls per day (Gesprekken per dag)

The calls per group as stacked bars: inbound (Deep Blue) on outbound (Leaf Green); columns over days or weeks, horizontal bars for markets and lines.

**Formula as computed**

```
per group: inbound = count(direction inbound), outbound = count(direction outbound); day/week axes are filled with zero groups for every date (or ISO-week Monday) from `from` to min(to, today in the VIEWER'S zone) so the axis has no gaps (chartGroups); markets and lines as returned. Horizontal bars scale to the busiest group (callsBars); the column chart's axis is countAxis (steps of 1, 2 or 5 × 10^n, at most five).

'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or #### `calls.conversations`

**Conversations** on /reports/calls · Conversations (Gevoerde gesprekken)

Calls that became a conversation: a connected outbound or an answered inbound call with at least the tenant's threshold of talk time and no tag that means not reached or incorrect data (Conversation).

**Formula as computed**

```
conversations = count(is_conversation); cma.is_conversation: (is_connected_outbound or is_answered_inbound) and talk_seconds >= calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds and no current tag (telephony_call_tag.untagged_at null) whose telephony_tag.meaning is not_reached or incorrect_data (cma.tag_meaning_excludes_conversation, read by cma.call_not_reached_of; whatever the tag's is_counted); a call without a tag is decided by its talk time alone. Shown as the Calls tile's detail ('{conversations} conversations'), as the tag table's Conversations column per group and total, and as the denominator of every tag share.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_day, per_iso_week, per_market, per_line · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, answered_at, ended_at, talk_seconds, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |
| `cma.telephony_call_tag` | call_source_id, tag_ref, untagged_at | Aircall | with the call's own write (the call's whole current tag set, closed/opened by difference at versionAt): webhook read-back, reconcile and backfill via cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_tag` | tag_ref, name, is_counted, meaning | Aircall | GET /v1/tags via ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; a tag first seen on a call joins the catalog at the call write (counted by default); is_counted and meaning (cma.set_telephony_tag_meaning, 0008zc; configuration only, the ingest never writes it) set on Configuration → Sources, Tags | at most hourly per connection inside ingest-sweep (every minute, docs/ingest/deploy.sh); the meaning on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |
| `calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds` | 30 | 30 (db/100 carries the tenant's earlier attempts threshold over, addition 0008zc) |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component); the API route computes on request from live tables (no snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.calls_overview` (0008zc); `cma.calls_overview_of` (0008zc); `cma.calls_figures_of` (0008zc); `cma.calls_of` (0008zc); `cma.telephony_history_start` (0008k); `cma.is_conversation` (0008zc); `cma.call_not_reached_of` (0008zd); `cma.tag_meaning_excludes_conversation` (0008zd); `getCallsOverview` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select count(*) filter (where c.conv) as conversations from c where c.bdate between :from and :to
```

**Data prerequisites**

- A tag that means not reached set on Configuration → Sources, Tags (without one, Conversation counts on talk time alone; the Tags section says so)
- A tag that means incorrect data set on Configuration → Sources, Tags on the tags agents put on a wrong number or incorrect contact data (without one, such a call counts by its talk time alone)

#### `calls.untagged_share`

**Untagged** on /reports/calls · Untagged (Zonder tag)

Calls without any current tag, as a share of all the period's calls, missed calls included (Untagged).

**Formula as computed**

```
untagged = count(calls with no current tag: no telephony_call_tag row with untagged_at null — a tag that does NOT count still makes a call tagged); share = round1(100 * untagged / calls), null when calls = 0. Detail '{untagged} of {calls} calls'. Every call of the period counts, answered or missed, in either direction.
```

#### `calls.tag_bars`

**Conversations per tag, whole period** on /reports/calls · Conversations per tag, whole period (Gevoerde gesprekken per tag, hele periode)

The whole period's tags as horizontal bars: the conversations carrying each tag, the top twelve, the rest added up as Other.

**Formula as computed**

```
per current tag (ANY tag, counted or not): count of conversations (calls.conversations) carrying it (a conversation with two tags counts under each); bars sorted count desc, then name, then key; the first TOP_TAGS (12) on their own, the rest as 'Other ({n} tags)'; each bar shows count and share = count / period conversations (null-dash when 0); bar length relative to the longest. A tag that does not count is Neutral grey and marked '(does not count)'; counted tags Deep Blue, Other Light Blue.
```

**Data prerequisites**

- Every conversation tagged in Aircall (kpis.md §11; tagging discipline)
- A tag that means not reached set on Configuration → Sources, Tags (without one, Conversation counts on talk time alone; the Tags section says so)
- A tag that means incorrect data set on Configuration → Sources, Tags on the tags agents put on a wrong number or incorrect contact data (without one, such a call counts by its talk time alone)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Calls and Calls per agent (B16); kpis.md §7, §8; api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/calls; data-model/0008.md, Calls overview (0008j) and Telephony history start (0008k); decisions.md 14 Oct 2026 (talk time; connected threshold; like for like; volume deltas Muted; history start)

**Notes**

Tag identity = connection id ':' tag ref, so equal names on two connections stay apart. Sums across tags exceed conversations when calls carry several tags (stated in tagNote).

#### `calls.tags_by_group`

**Tags per day / week / market / line** on /reports/calls · Tags per day (Tags per dag)

The groups by tags: the whole period's top twelve tags as columns with the conversations carrying them, Other, then Untagged (the group's calls without a tag); counts with row shares.

**Formula as computed**

```
columns = the whole period's top 12 tags (as calls.tag_bars); per group line: conversations, then per column the conversations carrying that tag with share = count / the GROUP'S conversations (null-dash when 0); Other = the group's conversations on tags outside the top 12; Untagged = the group's calls without a current tag (cma.calls_figures_of's untagged) with share = untagged / the group's calls; the total row recomputes every cell over the whole period. Groups in the overview's order (lines by name).
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_group, per_tag · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, answered_at, ended_at, talk_seconds, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |
| `cma.telephony_call_tag` | call_source_id, tag_ref, untagged_at | Aircall | with the call's own write (the call's whole current tag set, closed/opened by difference at versionAt): webhook read-back, reconcile and backfill via cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_tag` | tag_ref, name, is_counted, meaning | Aircall | GET /v1/tags via ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; a tag first seen on a call joins the catalog at the call write (counted by default); is_counted and meaning (cma.set_telephony_tag_meaning, 0008zc; configuration only, the ingest never writes it) set on Configuration → Sources, Tags | at most hourly per connection inside ingest-sweep (every minute, docs/ingest/deploy.sh); the meaning on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days
- conversations only

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |
| `calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds` | 30 | 30 (db/100 carries the tenant's earlier attempts threshold over, addition 0008zc) |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component); the API route computes on request from live tables (no snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.calls_tag_use` (0008j); `cma.calls_tag_use_of` (0008zc); `cma.is_conversation` (0008zc); `cma.call_not_reached_of` (0008zd); `cma.tag_meaning_excludes_conversation` (0008zd); `cma.calls_figures_of` (0008zc); `tagTable` in src/lib/reports.ts; `TagTable` in src/components/CallsParts.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select c.bdate, ct.tag_ref, count(*) as conversations, null::bigint as untagged_calls from c join cma.telephony_call_tag ct on ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = c.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = c.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null where c.conv and c.bdate between :from and :to group by 1, 2 union all select c.bdate, null, null, count(*) filter (where not c.tagged) from c where c.bdate between :from and :to group by 1 order by 1, 2 nulls last
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against a local database built from db/00 to db/100 (addition 0008zc) with the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, one fixture tag set to mean not reached (24 October 2026), for 25 September to 24 October 2026 and returns 11 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every conversation tagged in Aircall (kpis.md §11; tagging discipline)
- A tag that means not reached set on Configuration → Sources, Tags (without one, Conversation counts on talk time alone; the Tags section says so)
- A tag that means incorrect data set on Configuration → Sources, Tags on the tags agents put on a wrong number or incorrect contact data (without one, such a call counts by its talk time alone)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Calls and Calls per agent (B16); kpis.md §7, §8; api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/calls; data-model/0008.md, Calls overview (0008j) and Telephony history start (0008k); decisions.md 14 Oct 2026 (talk time; connected threshold; like for like; volume deltas Muted; history start)

**Notes**

The tag use (cma.calls_tag_use_of) has no untagged row; the verify query returns the tag rows and, per date, one row with untagged_calls. Tag shares use each group's own conversations, the untagged share the group's calls (rule 5).

### /reports/calls-per-agent

Inbound calls the person answered in the period.

**Formula as computed**

```
answered_inbound = count(direction inbound and answered_at set) over the person's calls.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

| `cma.app_user_external_id` | system, external_id, user_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: the People screen links a person to their telephony user (system '<adapter>_user', 0008e) | on change |
| `cma.app_user` | id, display_name | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: People / invitations | on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction

'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null #### `calls_per_agent.outbound_calls`

**Outbound** on /reports/calls-per-agent · Outbound (Uitgaand)

Outbound calls the person made in the period, connected or not.

**Formula as computed**

```
outbound_calls = count(direction = 'outbound') over the person's calls.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, answered_at, ended_at, talk_seconds, user_ref, source_system, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |
| `cma.app_user_external_id` | system, external_id, user_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: the People screen links a person to their telephony user (system '<adapter>_user', 0008e) | on change |
| `cma.app_user` | id, display_name | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: People / invitations | on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days
- a person's calls = their ANSWERED inbound calls plus ALL their outbound calls (unanswered inbound calls belong to no person)
- person = the app_user linked to the call's telephony user via app_user_external_id (system '<source system>_user'); calls of unlinked users and calls without a user form the not-linked row

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |

**Who may see it** `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component); the API route computes on request from live tables (no snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.calls_per_person` (0008zc); `cma.calls_per_person_of` (0008zc); `cma.calls_people_of` (0008j); `cma.calls_of` (0008zc); `getCallsPerAgent` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `CallsPerAgentTable` in src/components/CallsPerAgentTable.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select coalesce(u.display_name, '<not linked>') as person, count(*) filter (where c.direction = 'outbound') as outbound_calls from c left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = c.source_system || '_user' and xi.external_id = c.user_ref left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id where c.bdate between :from and :to and (c.ain or c.direction = 'outbound') group by u.id, u.display_name order by u.display_name
```

**Fixture check** Ran against a local database built from db/00 to db/100 (addition 0008zc) with the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, one fixture tag set to mean not reached (24 October 2026), for 25 September to 24 October 2026 and matched the page's own function (3 row(s)).

**Data prerequisites**

- Every Aircall user linked to a person on People (kpis.md §11) (data quality check `telephony_user_without_person`)
- Every conversation tagged in Aircall

#### `calls_per_agent.connected`

connected = count(is_connected_outbound) over the person's calls; cma.is_connected: outbound and answered_at is not null, with telephony.connected_min_seconds above 0 also that much talk time. Voicemail answers too, so Connected is no Conversation.

#### `calls_per_agent.untagged`

**Untagged** on /reports/calls-per-agent · Untagged (Zonder tag)

The person's calls (answered inbound and outbound) without any current tag (Untagged).

**Formula as computed**

```
untagged = count(not is_tagged) over the person's answered inbound and outbound calls; a tag that does not count still makes a call tagged.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.telephony_call` | direction, started_at, answered_at, ended_at, talk_seconds, user_ref, source_system, source_deleted_at, number_ref | Aircall | Aircall webhook (one event per call change; VENDOR_SETUP §2.3) → ingest service POST /<adapter>/<key> (adapter aircall) → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() (0007a, skip rule 0008f); the Cloud Run job ingest-reconcile re-reads the look-back nightly and the manual backfill writes through the same function | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_number` | connection_id, number_ref, name, market, is_counted | Aircall | GET /v1/numbers → cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_catalog(), refreshed inside the Cloud Run job ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; is_counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_telephony_number()) | ingest-sweep every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh '* * * * *'); the catalog refresh inside it at most hourly per connection |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |
| `cma.app_user_external_id` | system, external_id, user_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: the People screen links a person to their telephony user (system '<adapter>_user', 0008e) | on change |
| `cma.app_user` | id, display_name | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: People / invitations | on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days
- a person's calls = their ANSWERED inbound calls plus ALL their outbound calls (unanswered inbound calls belong to no person)
- person = the app_user linked to the call's telephony user via app_user_external_id (system '<source system>_user'); calls of unlinked users and calls without a user form the not-linked row

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |

**Computed in** `cma.calls_per_person` (0008zc); `cma.calls_per_person_of` (0008zc); `cma.calls_people_of` (0008j); `cma.calls_of` (0008zc); `getCallsPerAgent` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `CallsPerAgentTable` in src/components/CallsPerAgentTable.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select coalesce(u.display_name, '<not linked>') as person, count(*) filter (where not c.tagged) as untagged from c left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = c.source_system || '_user' and xi.external_id = c.user_ref left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id where c.bdate between :from and :to and (c.ain or c.direction = 'outbound') group by u.id, u.display_name order by u.display_name
```

**Notes**

Rows sorted by name, never ranked (decisions.md 7 and 14 Oct 2026, Yordi); each figure carries an inline bar scaled to its column's largest over the people and the not-linked row (the total row has no bars). Staff names only, never a telephony user id, number or call id.

#### `calls_per_agent.conversations`

**Conversations ({n} conversations in all)** on /reports/calls-per-agent · Conversations ({n} conversations in all) (Gevoerde gesprekken ({n} gevoerde gesprekken in totaal))

The person's conversations (Conversation: a connected outbound or an answered inbound call with at least the threshold of talk time and no tag that means not reached or incorrect data); shown in the opened row's header ('{n} conversations in all') and returned per row.

**Formula as computed**

```
conversations = count(is_conversation) over the person's calls; cma.is_conversation: (is_connected_outbound or is_answered_inbound) and talk_seconds >= calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds and no current tag (telephony_call_tag.untagged_at null) whose telephony_tag.meaning is not_reached or incorrect_data (cma.tag_meaning_excludes_conversation, read by cma.call_not_reached_of; whatever the tag's is_counted); a call without a tag is decided by its talk time alone.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

#### `calls_per_agent.first_last_call`

**First and last call** on /reports/calls-per-agent · First and last call (Eerste en laatste gesprek)

The earliest and the latest time of day of a call of the person, over any day of the period.

**Formula as computed**

```
first_call_time = min(local time of day), last_call_time = max(...), over the person's calls (answered inbound + outbound), each call's time in ITS line's market zone; shown as HH:MM–HH:MM, a dash with no calls. Times of different days and zones mix (a min/max over times of day, not of one day).
```

#### `calls_per_agent.not_linked_users`

**Not linked ({n} telephony users)** on /reports/calls-per-agent · Not linked ({n} telephony users) (Niet gekoppeld ({n} telefoniegebruikers))

One row, last, with the calls of telephony users not linked to a person (and of calls without a user), and how many such users that is — never who.

**Formula as computed**

```
unlinked_users = count(distinct user_ref) over the not-linked calls (calls with user_ref null are IN the row's figures but not in the user count); every figure column computed over those calls as for a person. Links to Data quality for holders of reports.view or tenant.configure, otherwise an 'ask an administrator' line.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |

| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Markets | on change |
| `cma.app_user_external_id` | system, external_id, user_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: the People screen links a person to their telephony user (system '<adapter>_user', 0008e) | on change |
| `cma.app_user` | id, display_name | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: People / invitations | on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant of cma.calls_of
- source_deleted_at is null; started_at not null; either direction
- counted lines only (telephony_number.is_counted; a line not in the catalog counts)
- optional market filter (a code or 'unknown') and line filter (connection id ':' line ref), validated by cma.calls_filters_check; an invalid one is dropped with a notice
- business dates [from..to] in each call's line-market zone; range at most 92 days
- a person's calls = their ANSWERED inbound calls plus ALL their outbound calls (unanswered inbound calls belong to no person)
- person = the app_user linked to the call's telephony user via app_user_external_id (system '<source system>_user'); calls of unlinked users and calls without a user form the not-linked row
- calls whose telephony user has no app_user_external_id row, or that carry no user_ref

**Time** Each call's business date, ISO week (Monday of that date) and time of day in its line's market zone, else the tenant's (cma.calls_of); 'today' for the like-for-like cut is the database's now() in the tenant's zone (cma.calls_overview_of), while the page labels use the viewer's zone (me.timeZone)

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.connected_min_seconds'))::int) as cm, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds'))::int) as vm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c0 as (select tc.direction, tc.talk_seconds, tc.user_ref, tc.source_system, tc.connection_id, tc.source_id, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::time as ltime, (tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.answered_at is not null) as ain, (tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and (s.cm = 0 or coalesce(tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm, false))) as cout, s.vm, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select count(distinct c.user_ref) as unlinked_users, count(*) as calls from c left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = c.source_system || '_user' and xi.external_id = c.user_ref left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id where c.bdate between :from and :to and (c.ain or c.direction = 'outbound') and u.id is null
```

Staff names only, never a telephony user id, number or call id.

#### `calls_per_agent.total_row`

**Total** on /reports/calls-per-agent · Total (Totaal)

The total row: every column over every person-attributable call of the period (answered inbound + all outbound), computed by the database, not summed.

**Formula as computed**

```
the grouping-sets () row of cma.calls_per_person_of over the same call set; note it EXCLUDES unanswered inbound calls, so it is not the Calls report's total (different definition, by design: these are the calls a person can own). Connected, conversations and untagged as their columns.
```

#### `calls_per_agent.tag_split`

**Conversations per counted tag** on /reports/calls-per-agent · Conversations per counted tag (Gevoerde gesprekken per meetellende tag)

The opened row's drill-down: the person's conversations per COUNTED tag as small bars with count and share.

**Formula as computed**

```
per counted tag (telephony_tag.is_counted; a tag first seen on a call is counted by default): count of the person's conversations (calls_per_agent.conversations) carrying it, most used first (then name, then key); no untagged row (Untagged counts calls and has its own column). A conversation whose only tags do not count is in no bar. share = count / the person's conversations (null-dash at 0); bar length relative to the person's largest.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person, per_tag · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed
