ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null) as tagged, exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as not_reached from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)), c as (select c0.*, ((c0.ain or c0.cout) and coalesce(c0.talk_seconds >= c0.vm, false) and not c0.not_reached) as conv from c0) select coalesce(u.display_name, '<not linked>') as person, tg.name as tag, count(*) as conversations from c left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = c.source_system || '_user' and xi.external_id = c.user_ref left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id join cma.telephony_call_tag ct on ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = c.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = c.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tg.connection_id = c.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref and tg.is_counted where c.bdate between :from and :to and (c.ain or c.direction = 'outbound') and c.conv group by 1, 2 order by 1, 3 desc, 2

**Fixture check** The query runs against a local database built from db/00 to db/100 (addition 0008zc) with the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, one fixture tag set to mean not reached (24 October 2026), for 25 September to 24 October 2026 and returns 2 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every Aircall user linked to a person on People (kpis.md §11) (data quality check `telephony_user_without_person`)
- Every conversation tagged in Aircall
- A tag that means not reached set on Configuration → Sources, Tags (without one, Conversation counts on talk time alone; the Tags section says so)
- A tag that means incorrect data set on Configuration → Sources, Tags on the tags agents put on a wrong number or incorrect contact data (without one, such a call counts by its talk time alone)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Calls and Calls per agent (B16); kpis.md §7, §8, §11 (users linked; tagging); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/calls-per-agent; data-model/0008.md (0008j); decisions.md 14 Oct 2026 (per-person figures, Yordi; person's calls), 19 Oct 2026 (averages, not totals)

**Notes**

Counted-tags-only rule per decisions.md 14 Oct 2026 ('tags per agent show counted tags only'). Up/Down move between people; Enter toggles.

### /reports/email

#### `email.received`

**Received** on /reports/email · Received (Ontvangen)

Messages that came into a counted inbox and mailbox in the period, spam left out: the inbox conversations' incoming and forwarded messages. Replies logged in the CRM are never added here — they count apart as Logged replies (B17 R8: the same email can sit in an inbox too).

**Formula as computed**

```
received = count(email_message where source_kind = 'inbox_message' and direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and source_deleted_at is null and inbox, mailbox and channel counted (missing from the catalog counts) and thread not spam), on the business date in the email's market zone. Also per day/week × inbox and × mailbox for the two stacked-column charts (cma.email_received series dimensions day_inbox/day_account), and per inbox, mailbox, category and market in the tables.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_day, per_iso_week, per_inbox, per_mailbox, per_category, per_market · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.email_message` | source_kind, direction, status, occurred_at, actor_kind, owner_ref, origin, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, thread_source_id, category, source_deleted_at | HubSpot conversations | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-email (docs/ingest/deploy.sh) → GET /conversations/v3/conversations/threads?latestMessageTimestampAfter and threads/{id}/messages → cma.ingest_upsert_emails(); engagements via POST /crm/v3/objects/emails/search → the same function; nightly reconcile and backfill too | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh schedules ingest-poll-email '* * * * *'); the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |
| `cma.email_thread` | source_id, status, source_created_at, closed_at, is_spam, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, contact_source_id, ticket_source_id, category | HubSpot conversations | ingest-poll-email → cma.ingest_upsert_threads(); status-only changes via the open check (cursor email:open-check) and the nightly reconcile | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); the open check every email_open_check_minutes (connection setting, default 15; ingest/src/adapters/hubspot/usage.mjs) |
| `cma.connection_inbox` | source_inbox_id, name, is_counted, market | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog of ingest-poll-email (cursor email:catalogs) → cma.ingest_upsert_inboxes(); counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_inbox) | catalogs at most hourly per connection (ingest/src/adapters/hubspot/conversations.mjs); configuration on change |
| `cma.connection_inbox_account` | source_account_id, name, label, is_counted, market, status | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog (channel-accounts) → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_accounts(); label, counted and market set on Configuration → Sources → cma.set_inbox_account() (a name holding an @ gives way to the id: no address stored) | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |
| `cma.connection_inbox_channel` | source_channel_id, is_counted | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_channels(); counted on Configuration → Sources | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |
| `cma.integration_connection` | settings (email_inbox_copy_origins, email_automated_origins, email_origin_property) | CMA | the Workspace's own write path / runbook: cma.set_connection_settings() (decisions.md 18 Oct 2026: email_origin_property = hs_engagement_source, email_inbox_copy_origins = CONVERSATIONS for Pulse4all, set by the runbook) | on configuration |
| `cma.crm_contact` | source_id, country | HubSpot | contact read after the first email or thread that points to it (ingest-poll-email), property webhooks → ingest service → cma.ingest_upsert_contacts(), nightly reconcile | every minute (poll) and on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.form_submission` | contact_source_id, source_form_id, submitted_at, contact_resolution | HubSpot forms | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-forms → cma.ingest_upsert_form_submissions() (the market chain's form step) | counted forms every minute, polled-only every forms_poll_interval_minutes (default 5; docs/ingest/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, source_id, market | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks → ingest service → cma.upsert_crm_record(); the market chain's record step (ticket, then deal) | on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.crm_association` | from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, removed_at | HubSpot | ingest-poll-email reads an engagement's associations with each change (v4 batch read) → cma.ingest_upsert_associations() | every minute with the email poll; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | tenant configuration (Configuration → Markets) | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS on tenant_id plus cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.email_report_page(); the *_of definitions take the explicit tenant
- not deleted: email_message.source_deleted_at is null
- inbox message counts only on a counted inbox, mailbox and channel (connection_inbox / connection_inbox_account / connection_inbox_channel is_counted; one the catalog has not brought yet counts) and when its conversation is not spam (email_thread.is_spam)
- engagement (crm_email) counts only when its origin is none of the connection's email_inbox_copy_origins (an inbox copy is left out of every figure; decisions.md 18 Oct 2026)
- period on the business date in the email's market zone (email.market_order chain: contact, form, record, inbox — the inbox step reads the mailbox's market first, then the inbox's)
- page filters: market (two-letter code or 'unknown'), inbox and mailbox as connection id ':' source id (cma.email_filters_check, CMA04; the web drops an invalid one with a notice); an engagement has no inbox or mailbox, so either filter leaves engagements out

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

**Previous period** Previous equal-length period immediately before (cma.forms_previous_of, 0008p): a period that reaches today compares the same elapsed dates, the last cut at now's time of day in each row's own zone (like for like); 'No history to compare yet' (history's first date in the title) when the previous span starts before cma.email_history_start() — the business date of the tenant's earliest counted email — or that is null (callsChange in src/lib/reports.ts).

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `email.market_order` | contact,form,record,inbox (0008m) | contact,form,record,inbox (seed 02 sets none) |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component, one cma.email_report_page() call; no polling, frame links never prefetch since 18 Oct 2026). Sources: ingest-poll-email every minute; a close or reassignment that brings no new message arrives with the open check (connection setting email_open_check_minutes, default 15) or the nightly reconcile; mailbox/inbox catalogs at most hourly. No 'Updated … ago' line on the page.

**Computed in** `cma.email_report_page` (0008x); `cma.email_report_from` (0008x); `cma.email_figures_from` (0008x); `cma.email_facts_of` (0008x); `cma.email_of` (0008x); `cma.email_threads_counted_of` (0008x); `cma.forms_previous_of` (0008p); `getEmailReport` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `EmailPage` in src/app/reports/email/page.tsx; `EmailFiguresTable` in src/components/EmailParts.tsx; `seriesColumns` in src/lib/email.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with e as ( select em.*, c.settings as conn, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_message em join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and c.id = em.connection_id join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = em.tenant_id left join cma.email_thread th on em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and th.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and th.connection_id = em.connection_id and th.source_id = em.thread_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = em.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = em.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = em.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = coalesce(em.account_ref, th.account_ref) left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = em.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = em.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, em.connection_id, em.source_kind, em.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where em.tenant_id = :tenant_id and em.source_deleted_at is null and case when em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' then coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) and not coalesce(th.is_spam, false) else not exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_inbox_copy_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(em.origin, ''))) end ) select count(*) from e where (e.occurred_at at time zone e.zone)::date between :from and :to and e.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and e.direction in ('in', 'forwarded')
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- kpis.md §11: the conversations' channel accounts named in HubSpot (an address-name shows its id until labelled on Sources) and which inboxes, channels and mailboxes count (Arno and Kira)
- contacts' country for the market chain's contact step (0008m fallback slots) (data quality check `contact_country_fallback`)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Email and Email per agent (night run N19-A, 18–19 Oct 2026); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/email; data-model/0008.md, Data model: email reports (0008t); data-model/0008.md, Data model: report speed (0008x); decisions.md, 18 October 2026 (mailboxes, inbox-copy origins, reports.per_person); kpis.md §11, email per mailbox prerequisites

**Notes**

Tile with delta (volume, neutral colour) and detail '{logged} logged replies counted apart'. The two charts stack the top series (up to 6 shown; above 6 the top 5 plus Other in Muted — src/lib/email.ts seriesColumns) per date up to min(to, today in the viewer's zone): a market whose business date is ahead of the viewer's today would be counted in the tile but not drawn as a column (edge case, noted). Chart buckets 'none' read 'Not in an inbox' / 'No mailbox'. A message without a mailbox of its own counts under its conversation's (messages stored before 0008t have none). Zero state: tile shows 0; the charts show 'No email in this period'; a tenant with no inbox and no stored email sees 'No email connected' instead of the whole report (readHasEmail, postgres.ts:307). cma.email_market_of in verify_sql is an independent check: the page's one-pass read (0008x) inlines the chain, and 83_verify proves the two agree.

#### `email.logged_replies`

**Logged replies** on /reports/email · Logged replies (Gelogde antwoorden)

Incoming or forwarded email engagements logged in the CRM (replies to logged emails, BCC logs) that are not inbox-copy origins. Kept in a column of their own and never added to Received, because HubSpot can hold one email both ways (decisions.md 15 Oct 2026).

**Formula as computed**

```
logged_replies = count(email_message where source_kind = 'crm_email' and direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and source_deleted_at is null and origin not in the connection's email_inbox_copy_origins), on the business date in the email's market zone.
```

#### `email.sent_agent`

**Sent by agents** on /reports/email · Sent by agents (Verstuurd door agents)

Emails sent in the period that are not automated: outgoing, status sent, from an inbox or logged in the CRM (when not an inbox copy). Automations, bounced and failed count apart.

**Formula as computed**

```
sent_agent = count(counted emails where direction = 'out' and status = 'sent' and not automated); automated = engagement whose origin is in the connection's email_automated_origins, or inbox message whose actor_kind in ('bot', 'ai', 'system', 'integration'). Note: an outgoing inbox message with actor 'unknown' or 'customer' therefore counts as an agent send (the residual class).
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_day, per_iso_week, per_mailbox, per_category, per_market · **Status** ambiguous

| `cma.connection_inbox_account` | source_account_id, name, label, is_counted, market, status | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog (channel-accounts) → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_accounts(); label, counted and market set on Configuration → Sources → cma.set_inbox_account() (a name holding an @ gives way to the id: no address stored) | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |
| `cma.connection_inbox_channel` | source_channel_id, is_counted | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_channels(); counted on Configuration → Sources | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |
| `cma.integration_connection` | settings (email_inbox_copy_origins, email_automated_origins, email_origin_property) | CMA | the Workspace's own write path / runbook: cma.set_connection_settings() (decisions.md 18 Oct 2026: email_origin_property = hs_engagement_source, email_inbox_copy_origins = CONVERSATIONS for Pulse4all, set by the runbook) | on configuration |
| `cma.crm_contact` | source_id, country | HubSpot | contact read after the first email or thread that points to it (ingest-poll-email), property webhooks → ingest service → cma.ingest_upsert_contacts(), nightly reconcile | every minute (poll) and on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.form_submission` | contact_source_id, source_form_id, submitted_at, contact_resolution | HubSpot forms | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-forms → cma.ingest_upsert_form_submissions() (the market chain's form step) | counted forms every minute, polled-only every forms_poll_interval_minutes (default 5; docs/ingest/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, source_id, market | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks → ingest service → cma.upsert_crm_record(); the market chain's record step (ticket, then deal) | on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.crm_association` | from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, removed_at | HubSpot | ingest-poll-email reads an engagement's associations with each change (v4 batch read) → cma.ingest_upsert_associations() | every minute with the email poll; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | tenant configuration (Configuration → Markets) | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS on tenant_id plus cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.email_report_page(); the *_of definitions take the explicit tenant
- not deleted: email_message.source_deleted_at is null
- inbox message counts only on a counted inbox, mailbox and channel (connection_inbox / connection_inbox_account / connection_inbox_channel is_counted; one the catalog has not brought yet counts) and when its conversation is not spam (email_thread.is_spam)
- engagement (crm_email) counts only when its origin is none of the connection's email_inbox_copy_origins (an inbox copy is left out of every figure; decisions.md 18 Oct 2026)
- period on the business date in the email's market zone (email.market_order chain: contact, form, record, inbox — the inbox step reads the mailbox's market first, then the inbox's)
- page filters: market (two-letter code or 'unknown'), inbox and mailbox as connection id ':' source id (cma.email_filters_check, CMA04; the web drops an invalid one with a notice); an engagement has no inbox or mailbox, so either filter leaves engagements out

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

**Previous period** Previous equal-length period immediately before (cma.forms_previous_of, 0008p): a period that reaches today compares the same elapsed dates, the last cut at now's time of day in each row's own zone (like for like); 'No history to compare yet' (history's first date in the title) when the previous span starts before cma.email_history_start() — the business date of the tenant's earliest counted email — or that is null (callsChange in src/lib/reports.ts).

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component, one cma.email_report_page() call; no polling, frame links never prefetch since 18 Oct 2026). Sources: ingest-poll-email every minute; a close or reassignment that brings no new message arrives with the open check (connection setting email_open_check_minutes, default 15) or the nightly reconcile; mailbox/inbox catalogs at most hourly. No 'Updated … ago' line on the page.

**Computed in** `cma.email_report_page` (0008x); `cma.email_report_from` (0008x); `cma.email_figures_from` (0008x); `cma.email_facts_of` (0008x); `cma.email_of` (0008x); `cma.email_threads_counted_of` (0008x); `cma.forms_previous_of` (0008p); `getEmailReport` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `EmailPage` in src/app/reports/email/page.tsx; `EmailFiguresTable` in src/components/EmailParts.tsx; `SentColumns` in src/components/EmailParts.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with e as ( select em.*, c.settings as conn, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_message em join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and c.id = em.connection_id join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = em.tenant_id left join cma.email_thread th on em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and th.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and th.connection_id = em.connection_id and th.source_id = em.thread_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = em.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = em.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = em.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = coalesce(em.account_ref, th.account_ref) left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = em.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = em.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, em.connection_id, em.source_kind, em.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where em.tenant_id = :tenant_id and em.source_deleted_at is null and case when em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' then coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) and not coalesce(th.is_spam, false) else not exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_inbox_copy_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(em.origin, ''))) end ) select count(*) from e where (e.occurred_at at time zone e.zone)::date between :from and :to and e.direction = 'out' and e.status = 'sent' and not (case when e.source_kind = 'crm_email' then exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(e.conn ->> 'email_automated_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(e.origin, ''))) else e.actor_kind in ('bot', 'ai', 'system', 'integration') end)
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- kpis.md §11: the conversations' channel accounts named in HubSpot (an address-name shows its id until labelled on Sources) and which inboxes, channels and mailboxes count (Arno and Kira)
- contacts' country for the market chain's contact step (0008m fallback slots) (data quality check `contact_country_fallback`)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Email and Email per agent (night run N19-A, 18–19 Oct 2026); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/email; data-model/0008.md, Data model: email reports (0008t); data-model/0008.md, Data model: report speed (0008x); decisions.md, 18 October 2026 (mailboxes, inbox-copy origins, reports.per_person); kpis.md §11, email per mailbox prerequisites

**Notes**

Tile with delta and detail '{automated} automated, {failed} bounced or failed'; the 'Sent by agents and automated' chart stacks agent sends (Deep Blue) and automated (Leaf Green) per day or week; columns in the per-mailbox, per-category and per-market tables. Ambiguity flagged as a finding: the label says 'by agents' but the definition is 'not automated', so an outgoing inbox message of an unknown actor counts here (and lands in Email per agent's not-linked row when it has no owner). Docs (0008.md definitions) state exactly this, so code and docs agree; the label is the only looseness.

#### `email.sent_automated`

**Automated** on /reports/email · Automated (Geautomatiseerd)

Emails an automation sent in the period: an engagement whose origin is one of the connection's automated origins (sequences, workflows), or an inbox message sent by a bot, an AI, the system or an integration.

**Formula as computed**

```
sent_automated = count(counted emails where direction = 'out' and status = 'sent' and automated); automated as email.sent_agent defines it.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_day, per_iso_week, per_mailbox · **Status** verified

#### `email.conversations_opened`

**Conversations opened** on /reports/email · Conversations opened (Gesprekken geopend)

Inbox conversations that started in the period, plus conversations reopened after a close. A conversation that shows as reopened at the moment it starts is not counted twice (Open decisions: reopens at a thread's creation).

**Formula as computed**

```
threads_opened = count(openings): a counted, non-spam conversation's source_created_at in the period, union reopened events whose latest status event before them is a close (a reopen with no close before it is no opening), on the opening's business date in the thread's market zone.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_inbox, per_mailbox, per_category, per_market · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS on tenant_id plus cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.email_report_page(); the *_of definitions take the explicit tenant
- counted conversations only: counted inbox, mailbox and channel, not spam (cma.email_threads_counted_of); engagements never open a conversation
- period on the opening's business date in the thread's market zone
- page filters market/inbox/mailbox apply on the thread's market, inbox and starting mailbox

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

**Previous period** Previous equal-length period immediately before (cma.forms_previous_of, 0008p): a period that reaches today compares the same elapsed dates, the last cut at now's time of day in each row's own zone (like for like); 'No history to compare yet' (history's first date in the title) when the previous span starts before cma.email_history_start() — the business date of the tenant's earliest counted email — or that is null (callsChange in src/lib/reports.ts).

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component, one cma.email_report_page() call; no polling, frame links never prefetch since 18 Oct 2026). Sources: ingest-poll-email every minute; a close or reassignment that brings no new message arrives with the open check (connection setting email_open_check_minutes, default 15) or the nightly reconcile; mailbox/inbox catalogs at most hourly. No 'Updated … ago' line on the page.

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with op as ( select th.id, th.source_created_at as open_at from cma.email_thread th where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id union all select th.id, ev.occurred_at from cma.email_thread_event ev join cma.email_thread th on th.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and th.connection_id = ev.connection_id and th.source_id = ev.thread_source_id cross join lateral ( select max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'closed') as cl, max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'reopened') as re from cma.email_thread_event c where c.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and c.connection_id = ev.connection_id and c.thread_source_id = ev.thread_source_id and c.kind in ('closed', 'reopened') and c.occurred_at < ev.occurred_at ) pc where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.kind = 'reopened' and pc.cl is not null and pc.cl >= coalesce(pc.re, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_thread th join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = th.tenant_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ) select count(*) from op join t on t.id = op.id where (op.open_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to
```

- kpis.md §11: the conversations' channel accounts named in HubSpot (an address-name shows its id until labelled on Sources) and which inboxes, channels and mailboxes count (Arno and Kira)
- contacts' country for the market chain's contact step (0008m fallback slots) (data quality check `contact_country_fallback`)
- closes and reopens that bring no new message reach the CMA through the open check (email_open_check_minutes, default 15) and the nightly reconcile, so a reopen can appear up to that late

Tile with delta and detail '{closed} closed in the period'; 'Opened' column in the per-inbox, per-mailbox, per-category and per-market tables. The counted/spam state is the thread's state at read time, not at the opening (a conversation marked spam later disappears from history).

#### `email.conversations_closed`

**Closed** on /reports/email · Closed (Gesloten)

Close events of counted, non-spam conversations in the period, by anyone — agents, the system or an automation alike (a close by someone who is not an agent is in this team figure only, never credited per person).

**Formula as computed**

```
threads_closed = count(email_thread_event where kind = 'closed' and occurred_at in the period) over counted, non-spam conversations, on the close's business date in the thread's market zone. One row per close event: a conversation closed, reopened and closed again counts twice.
```

#### `email.first_reply_median_business`

**First reply** on /reports/email · First reply (Eerste antwoord)

The typical (median) time from the customer's first message to the first reply by an agent, in business minutes of the conversation's market: half of the replies were faster, half slower. Only conversations that got an agent reply count; a conversation whose market is unknown has no business hours and is counted apart.

**Formula as computed**

```
Per opening: first_in = first incoming inbox message after the close the opening follows (any for a creation), up to the opening's own close; first_reply = first outgoing inbox message with actor_kind 'agent', status <> 'failed', strictly after first_in, up to that close. reply_business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, thread market, first_in, first_reply) — the market's own hours else the '*' schedule, holidays excluded; null for an unknown market. Median = percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by reply_business_seconds) over replied openings with business seconds known, rounded to 0.1 s; null without values (dash).
```

**Unit** median · **Grain** period, per_inbox, per_mailbox, per_category, per_market · **Status** verified

**Notes**

Tile value (fmtTalk of the business median; dash when null) with detail '{pct} within {target} business minutes', or 'No replies in this period' (replied = 0), or 'No business hours for {n} replies' (targetKnown = 0). Also 'First reply' column of all four tables. True median (percentile_cont 0.5), never an average. The elapsed median is returned too and shown as the per-inbox 'Elapsed' column (email.first_reply_median_elapsed). The figure is uncensored: openings never replied to are excluded, so a backlog of unanswered conversations does not worsen it — Replied and Opened beside it carry that. Openings are dated by opening time: a reply after the period's end still counts to this period. No delta on this tile (comparison null); the API returns the previous medians. verify_sql uses cma.business_seconds_of and cma.email_market_of as helpers: the page's 0008x function computes both inline, and 83/91 verify they agree, so this is the closest independent check.

#### `email.first_reply_median_elapsed`

**Elapsed** on /reports/email · Elapsed (Verstreken)

The same median first reply in elapsed time, evenings and weekends included — shown beside the business median so a quiet weekend conversation is not hidden.

**Formula as computed**

```
reply_seconds = extract(epoch from first_reply - first_in); median = percentile_cont(0.5) over ALL replied openings (business hours known or not), rounded to 0.1 s.
```

**Unit** median · **Grain** period, per_inbox · **Status** verified

#### `email.first_reply_within_target_share`

**Within target** on /reports/email · Within target (Binnen doel)

The share of first replies within the tenant's reply target, of the replies whose market has business hours.

**Formula as computed**

```
within_target = count(replied openings where reply_business_seconds <= greatest(1, email.reply_target_minutes) * 60); target_known = count(replied openings where reply_business_seconds is not null); share = within_target / target_known, null (dash / 'No business hours for {n} replies') when target_known = 0. Replies of an unknown market (no business hours) are excluded from both sides and counted as No business hours.
```

**Unit** share · **Grain** period, per_inbox, per_mailbox · **Status** verified

#### `email.first_reply_replied`

**Replied** on /reports/email · Replied (Beantwoord)

Openings of the period that got a first reply from an agent (at any time up to the opening's close).

**Formula as computed**

```
replied = count(openings where first_reply_at is not null), the opening in the period on its business date.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_inbox, per_mailbox · **Status** verified

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id(); the *_of definitions take the explicit tenant

- the first incoming message and the first agent reply are inbox messages, not deleted; the reply has direction 'out', actor_kind 'agent' and status <> 'failed'
- period on the opening's business date in the thread's market zone; page filters market/inbox/mailbox on the thread's

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

```sql
with op as ( select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, 'created'::text as kind, th.source_created_at as open_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz as span_from from cma.email_thread th where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id union all select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, 'reopened', ev.occurred_at, pc.cl from cma.email_thread_event ev join cma.email_thread th on th.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and th.connection_id = ev.connection_id and th.source_id = ev.thread_source_id cross join lateral ( select max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'closed') as cl, max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'reopened') as re from cma.email_thread_event c where c.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and c.connection_id = ev.connection_id and c.thread_source_id = ev.thread_source_id and c.kind in ('closed', 'reopened') and c.occurred_at < ev.occurred_at ) pc where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.kind = 'reopened' and pc.cl is not null and pc.cl >= coalesce(pc.re, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_thread th join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = th.tenant_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ), r as ( select op.*, t.mkt, t.zone, cl.at as closed_at, fi.at as first_in, ( select min(m.occurred_at) from cma.email_message m where fi.at is not null and m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction = 'out' and m.actor_kind = 'agent' and m.status <> 'failed' and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > fi.at and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) as reply_at from op join t on t.id = op.id left join lateral ( select min(ev.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_thread_event ev where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.connection_id = op.connection_id and ev.thread_source_id = op.source_id and ev.kind = 'closed' and ev.occurred_at >= op.open_at ) cl on true left join lateral ( select min(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > op.span_from and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) fi on true where (op.open_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to ) select count(*) from r where r.reply_at is not null
```

#### `email.first_reply_no_hours`

**No business hours** on /reports/email · No business hours (Geen kantooruren)

First replies in conversations of an unknown market: no business hours apply, so they are in no business median and not in the within-target share.

**Formula as computed**

```
no_hours = count(replied openings where reply_business_seconds is null), i.e. cma.business_seconds_of returned null because the thread's market is 'unknown' (not in cma.market).
```

#### `email.time_to_close_median_business`

**Time to close** on /reports/email · Time to close (Tijd tot sluiten)

The typical (median) time from a conversation's opening to its close, in business minutes of the conversation's market.

**Formula as computed**

```
Per opening: closed_at = first close event at or after the opening; close_business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, thread market, opened_at, closed_at), null for an unknown market. Median = percentile_cont(0.5) over openings of the period that closed and whose business seconds are known; openings never closed are excluded.
```

**Unit** median · **Grain** period, per_inbox · **Status** verified

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id(); the *_of definitions take the explicit tenant
- counted, non-spam conversations only (cma.email_threads_counted_of); openings and replies exist only for inbox conversations, never engagements
- the first incoming message and the first agent reply are inbox messages, not deleted; the reply has direction 'out', actor_kind 'agent' and status <> 'failed'
- period on the opening's business date in the thread's market zone; page filters market/inbox/mailbox on the thread's

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

```sql
with op as ( select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, 'created'::text as kind, th.source_created_at as open_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz as span_from from cma.email_thread th where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id union all select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, 'reopened', ev.occurred_at, pc.cl from cma.email_thread_event ev join cma.email_thread th on th.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and th.connection_id = ev.connection_id and th.source_id = ev.thread_source_id cross join lateral ( select max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'closed') as cl, max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'reopened') as re from cma.email_thread_event c where c.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and c.connection_id = ev.connection_id and c.thread_source_id = ev.thread_source_id and c.kind in ('closed', 'reopened') and c.occurred_at < ev.occurred_at ) pc where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.kind = 'reopened' and pc.cl is not null and pc.cl >= coalesce(pc.re, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_thread th join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = th.tenant_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ), r as ( select op.*, t.mkt, t.zone, cl.at as closed_at, fi.at as first_in, ( select min(m.occurred_at) from cma.email_message m where fi.at is not null and m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction = 'out' and m.actor_kind = 'agent' and m.status <> 'failed' and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > fi.at and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) as reply_at from op join t on t.id = op.id left join lateral ( select min(ev.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_thread_event ev where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.connection_id = op.connection_id and ev.thread_source_id = op.source_id and ev.kind = 'closed' and ev.occurred_at >= op.open_at ) cl on true left join lateral ( select min(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > op.span_from and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) fi on true where (op.open_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to ) select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, r.mkt, r.open_at, r.closed_at))::numeric, 1) from r where r.closed_at is not null and cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, r.mkt, r.open_at, r.closed_at) is not null
```

Tile value (dash when null) with detail '{elapsed} including evenings and weekends' (email.time_to_close_median_elapsed); 'Time to close' column of the per-inbox table shows this business median. Dated by the opening, so a close after the period still counts to this period's opening; the Closed count beside it is dated by the close instead — the two deliberately measure different events (notes for the reviewer). No delta.

#### `email.time_to_close_median_elapsed`

/reports/email, returned with the data and not shown on a page · Time to close, elapsed (Tijd tot sluiten, verstreken)

The median time from opening to close in elapsed time, evenings and weekends included — the Time to close tile's detail line.

**Formula as computed**

```
close_seconds = extract(epoch from closed_at - opened_at); median = percentile_cont(0.5) over all closed openings of the period (unknown markets included), rounded to 0.1 s.
```

**Unit** median · **Grain** period · **Status** verified

#### `email.history_start`

/reports/email, returned with the data and not shown on a page · The email history starts on {date} (De e-mailgeschiedenis begint op {date})

The business date of the tenant's earliest counted email: before it no change against a previous period is shown ('No history to compare yet', the date in the hover title).

**Formula as computed**

```
cma.email_history_start_of(tenant): min(business_date) over cma.email_of from the earliest stored email, read in 7-day windows; the earliest date among the counted emails up to 2 days after the first one found (zones differ by at most 26 hours). Tenant-wide: the page filters never narrow it. Null when no counted email exists.
```

**Unit** date · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

#### `email.waiting.waiting_since`

**Waiting since** on /reports/email · Waiting since (Wacht sinds)

When the customer started waiting: their first message after the agent's last reply (or the conversation's first message ever when no agent has replied).

**Formula as computed**

```
waiting_since = min(incoming inbox message occurred_at > latest agent out) per open, counted, non-spam conversation whose latest incoming is later than its latest agent out. Shown as date and time in the viewer's zone; rows ordered by it, longest waiting first.
```

**Unit** date · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.email_thread` | source_id, status, source_created_at, closed_at, is_spam, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, contact_source_id, ticket_source_id, category | HubSpot conversations | ingest-poll-email → cma.ingest_upsert_threads(); status-only changes via the open check (cursor email:open-check) and the nightly reconcile | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); the open check every email_open_check_minutes (connection setting, default 15; ingest/src/adapters/hubspot/usage.mjs) |
| `cma.email_message` | source_kind, direction, status, occurred_at, actor_kind, owner_ref, origin, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, thread_source_id, category, source_deleted_at | HubSpot conversations | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-email (docs/ingest/deploy.sh) → GET /conversations/v3/conversations/threads?latestMessageTimestampAfter and threads/{id}/messages → cma.ingest_upsert_emails(); engagements via POST /crm/v3/objects/emails/search → the same function; nightly reconcile and backfill too | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh schedules ingest-poll-email '* * * * *'); the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |
| `cma.connection_inbox` | source_inbox_id, name, is_counted, market | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog of ingest-poll-email (cursor email:catalogs) → cma.ingest_upsert_inboxes(); counted and market set on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_inbox) | catalogs at most hourly per connection (ingest/src/adapters/hubspot/conversations.mjs); configuration on change |
| `cma.connection_inbox_account` | source_account_id, name, label, is_counted, market, status | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog (channel-accounts) → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_accounts(); label, counted and market set on Configuration → Sources → cma.set_inbox_account() (a name holding an @ gives way to the id: no address stored) | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |
| `cma.connection_inbox_channel` | source_channel_id, is_counted | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_channels(); counted on Configuration → Sources | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |
| `cma.crm_contact` | source_id, country | HubSpot | contact read after the first email or thread that points to it (ingest-poll-email), property webhooks → ingest service → cma.ingest_upsert_contacts(), nightly reconcile | every minute (poll) and on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.form_submission` | contact_source_id, source_form_id, submitted_at, contact_resolution | HubSpot forms | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-forms → cma.ingest_upsert_form_submissions() (the market chain's form step) | counted forms every minute, polled-only every forms_poll_interval_minutes (default 5; docs/ingest/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, source_id, market | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks → ingest service → cma.upsert_crm_record(); the market chain's record step (ticket, then deal) | on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.crm_association` | from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, removed_at | HubSpot | ingest-poll-email reads an engagement's associations with each change (v4 batch read) → cma.ingest_upsert_associations() | every minute with the email poll; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | tenant configuration (Configuration → Markets) | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- open, counted, non-spam conversations only (email_thread.status = 'open', cma.email_threads_counted_of)
- waiting = the latest incoming inbox message (in/forwarded, not deleted) is later than the latest agent message out (direction 'out', actor 'agent', status <> 'failed', not deleted)
- page filters market, inbox and mailbox apply on the thread's market, inbox and starting mailbox
- no period: a 'now' list

**Time** Now = now() at the read; the timestamp is shown in the viewer's time zone (fmtDateTimeShort with me.timeZone), not the market's.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `follow_up.list_rows` | 100 (0008s; 1 to 500) | 100 (seed 02 sets none) |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** On page load (server component; cma.email_waiting() / cma.email_not_responding() computed live at read time, p_now = now(); no polling and no 'Updated' line). Sources: ingest-poll-email every minute; a close or reassignment without a new message arrives with the open check (email_open_check_minutes, default 15) or the nightly reconcile.

**Computed in** `cma.email_waiting` (0008t); `cma.email_waiting_of` (0008t); `cma.email_threads_counted_of` (0008x); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `cma.record_url` (0007d); `getEmailReport` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `WaitingTable` in src/components/EmailParts.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with w as ( select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, lo.at as last_out, fi.at as waiting_since from cma.email_thread th left join lateral ( select max(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = th.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = th.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction = 'out' and m.actor_kind = 'agent' and m.status <> 'failed' and m.source_deleted_at is null ) lo on true cross join lateral ( select min(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = th.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = th.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > coalesce(lo.at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ) fi where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and th.status = 'open' and not th.is_spam and fi.at is not null ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt from cma.email_thread th left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ) select w.source_id, w.waiting_since from w join t on t.id = w.id order by w.waiting_since, w.source_id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- kpis.md §11: the conversations' channel accounts named in HubSpot (an address-name shows its id until labelled on Sources) and which inboxes, channels and mailboxes count (Arno and Kira)
- contacts' country for the market chain's contact step (0008m fallback slots) (data quality check `contact_country_fallback`)
- an agent reply or close that brings no new message is seen by the open check (default 15 min): a conversation can show as waiting up to that long after it was answered elsewhere

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Email and Email per agent (night run N19-A, 18–19 Oct 2026); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/email; data-model/0008.md, Data model: email reports (0008t); data-model/0008.md, Data model: report speed (0008x); decisions.md, 18 October 2026 (mailboxes, inbox-copy origins, reports.per_person); kpis.md §11, email per mailbox prerequisites

**Notes**

Column of the Waiting now table; the row also carries the conversation id (link via the connection's record_url_thread template, else record_url_ticket), inbox, mailbox and market — identity columns, no entries of their own. Empty state 'Nobody is waiting for a reply'. No customer data: ids, names of inboxes/mailboxes (never addresses), ages.

#### `email.waiting.total`

**Showing {shown} of {total}** on /reports/email · Showing {shown} of {total} ({shown} van {total} getoond)

How many conversations are waiting after the filters, against how many rows the list shows (capped by the tenant's list size).

**Formula as computed**

```
total_rows = count(*) over () after the market/inbox/mailbox filters; the list shows the first least(500, greatest(1, follow_up.list_rows)) rows, longest waiting first.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |

| `cma.email_message` | source_kind, direction, status, occurred_at, actor_kind, owner_ref, origin, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, thread_source_id, category, source_deleted_at | HubSpot conversations | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-email (docs/ingest/deploy.sh) → GET /conversations/v3/conversations/threads?latestMessageTimestampAfter and threads/{id}/messages → cma.ingest_upsert_emails(); engagements via POST /crm/v3/objects/emails/search → the same function; nightly reconcile and backfill too | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh schedules ingest-poll-email '* * * * *'); the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |

| `cma.connection_inbox_account` | source_account_id, name, label, is_counted, market, status | HubSpot conversations | hourly catalog (channel-accounts) → cma.ingest_upsert_inbox_accounts(); label, counted and market set on Configuration → Sources → cma.set_inbox_account() (a name holding an @ gives way to the id: no address stored) | catalogs at most hourly per connection; configuration on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- open, counted, non-spam conversations only (email_thread.status = 'open', cma.email_threads_counted_of)
- waiting = the latest incoming inbox message (in/forwarded, not deleted) is later than the latest agent message out (direction 'out', actor 'agent', status <> 'failed', not deleted)
- page filters market, inbox and mailbox apply on the thread's market, inbox and starting mailbox
- no period: a 'now' list

**Time** Now = now() at the read.

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|

Sources: ingest-poll-email every minute; a close or reassignment without a new message arrives with the open check (email_open_check_minutes, default 15) or the nightly reconcile.

**Computed in** `cma.email_waiting` (0008t); `cma.email_waiting_of` (0008t); `cma.email_threads_counted_of` (0008x); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `cma.record_url` (0007d); `getEmailReport` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `WaitingTable` in src/components/EmailParts.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with w as ( select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, lo.at as last_out, fi.at as waiting_since from cma.email_thread th left join lateral ( select max(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = th.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = th.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction = 'out' and m.actor_kind = 'agent' and m.status <> 'failed' and m.source_deleted_at is null ) lo on true cross join lateral ( select min(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = th.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = th.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > coalesce(lo.at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ) fi where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and th.status = 'open' and not th.is_spam and fi.at is not null ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt from cma.email_thread th left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ) select count(*) from w join t on t.id = w.id
```

#### `email.not_responding.last_email`

**Last email** on /reports/email · Last email (Laatste e-mail)

When an agent last emailed the open lead deal's contacts — the email nothing has answered since.

**Formula as computed**

```
last_email_at = max(occurred_at) of sent outgoing emails to the deal's contacts (engagement: not an inbox-copy and not an automated origin; inbox message: actor 'agent', non-spam thread); shown as a date in the viewer's zone.
```

**Unit** date · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** discrepancy

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- population: cma.lead_deals_of(tenant) — open deals of counted lead pipelines, created on or after intake.start_date, not deleted, not closed — with at least one contact

- at least email.no_response_days days old (elapsed days, not business days)
- page filter: market only (the deal's market); the inbox and mailbox filters do not apply to deals

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as ( select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'email.no_response_days')::integer as days, greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cm, greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vm ), d as ( select l.* from cma.lead_deals_of(:tenant_id, null, null) l where not l.is_closed and cardinality(l.contacts) > 0 ), lo as ( select d.deal_id, max(m.occurred_at) as at from d join cma.email_message m on m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = d.connection_id and m.contact_source_id = any (d.contacts) join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and c.id = m.connection_id left join cma.email_thread th on m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and th.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and th.connection_id = m.connection_id and th.source_id = m.thread_source_id where m.direction = 'out' and m.status = 'sent' and m.source_deleted_at is null and case when m.source_kind = 'crm_email' then not exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_inbox_copy_origins', '') || ',' || coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_automated_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(m.origin, ''))) else m.actor_kind = 'agent' and not coalesce(th.is_spam, false) end group by d.deal_id ) select d.source_id, lo.at, floor(extract(epoch from now() - lo.at) / 86400)::integer as days_since from d join lo on lo.deal_id = d.deal_id cross join s where lo.at <= now() - make_interval(days => s.days) and not exists ( select 1 from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = d.connection_id and m.contact_source_id = any (d.contacts) and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > lo.at ) and not exists ( select 1 from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cc.connection_id = a.connection_id and cc.source_id = a.from_id join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cc.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.removed_at is null and ((a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts)) or (a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)) and cc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.answered_at is not null and ((tc.direction = 'outbound' and (s.cm = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm)) or tc.direction = 'inbound') and tc.talk_seconds >= s.vm and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) and tc.started_at > lo.at ) order by lo.at, d.source_id
```

**Data prerequisites**

- kpis.md §11: the conversations' channel accounts named in HubSpot (an address-name shows its id until labelled on Sources) and which inboxes, channels and mailboxes count (Arno and Kira)
- contacts' country for the market chain's contact step (0008m fallback slots) (data quality check `contact_country_fallback`)
- counted lead pipelines configured (Sources); deals' contacts associated in HubSpot

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Email and Email per agent (night run N19-A, 18–19 Oct 2026); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/email; data-model/0008.md, Data model: email reports (0008t); data-model/0008.md, Data model: report speed (0008x); decisions.md, 18 October 2026 (mailboxes, inbox-copy origins, reports.per_person); kpis.md §11, email per mailbox prerequisites; features.md §5 (replaces HubSpot's 'Contacts with deals who aren't responding to emails')

**Notes**

The discrepancy (filed as a finding): 82:1728's comment says agent emails count 'as cma.email_of counts them', but the code never checks the counted flags of an inbox message's inbox, mailbox or channel — a send on an uncounted mailbox still counts as the last agent email, and the 'nothing back since' check counts ANY incoming email_message of the contacts (spam threads and uncounted inboxes included). The deal population is cma.lead_deals_of (0007d), reused in verify_sql because reimplementing it belongs to the Speed-to-lead/Follow-up entries; this check verifies the email logic independently. Market column = the DEAL's market (own, else contact's country), not the email's market chain. Owner column is a person's name or 'Not linked' — no owner id ever shown.

```sql
with s as ( select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'email.no_response_days')::integer as days, greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cm, greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vm ), d as ( select l.* from cma.lead_deals_of(:tenant_id, null, null) l where not l.is_closed and cardinality(l.contacts) > 0 ), lo as ( select d.deal_id, max(m.occurred_at) as at from d join cma.email_message m on m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = d.connection_id and m.contact_source_id = any (d.contacts) join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and c.id = m.connection_id left join cma.email_thread th on m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and th.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and th.connection_id = m.connection_id and th.source_id = m.thread_source_id where m.direction = 'out' and m.status = 'sent' and m.source_deleted_at is null and case when m.source_kind = 'crm_email' then not exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_inbox_copy_origins', '') || ',' || coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_automated_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(m.origin, ''))) else m.actor_kind = 'agent' and not coalesce(th.is_spam, false) end group by d.deal_id ) select d.source_id, lo.at, floor(extract(epoch from now() - lo.at) / 86400)::integer as days_since from d join lo on lo.deal_id = d.deal_id cross join s where lo.at <= now() - make_interval(days => s.days) and not exists ( select 1 from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = d.connection_id and m.contact_source_id = any (d.contacts) and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > lo.at ) and not exists ( select 1 from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cc.connection_id = a.connection_id and cc.source_id = a.from_id join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cc.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.removed_at is null and ((a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts)) or (a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)) and cc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.answered_at is not null and ((tc.direction = 'outbound' and (s.cm = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= s.cm)) or tc.direction = 'inbound') and tc.talk_seconds >= s.vm and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) and tc.started_at > lo.at ) order by lo.at, d.source_id
```

- contacts' country for the market chain's contact step (0008m fallback slots) (data quality check `contact_country_fallback`)

Sorted oldest email first. The intro fills the threshold: 'at least {days} days ago'. The hint (emailNrDays) matches the code: plain days.

#### `email.not_responding.owner`

**Owner** on /reports/email · Owner (Eigenaar)

The deal's owner as a person of the Workspace, or 'Not linked' when the owner id maps to nobody.

**Formula as computed**

```
owner_user_id = app_user_external_id(system = source_system || '_owner', external_id = deal.owner_ref).user_id; the page joins app_user for the display name; null → 'Not linked' in Muted text. The owner id itself is never shown.
```

**Unit** text · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, source_id, market, owner_ref, source_created_at, source_deleted_at | HubSpot | HubSpot webhook deal events → ingest service → cma.upsert_crm_record(); the open-lead population of 0007d (cma.lead_deals_of) | on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.app_user_external_id` | system, external_id, user_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: People → linked accounts (<adapter>_owner, 0008e) | on configuration |
| `cma.call_link` | crm_call_id, telephony_call_id, unlinked_at | CMA | Cloud Run job ingest-sweep, link_calls: Aircall call matched to its HubSpot call over the last 2 hours | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh: ingest-sweep, link_calls over the last 2 hours) |
| `cma.telephony_call_tag` | call_source_id, tag_ref, untagged_at | Aircall | with the call's own write (the call's whole current tag set, closed/opened by difference at versionAt): webhook read-back, reconcile and backfill via cma.ingest_upsert_telephony_calls() | event-driven; the webhook subscription is configured outside the repo: the Aircall dashboard (ingest-reconcile checks it each run), to confirm; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam with a 26 h look-back (docs/ingest/deploy.sh, default '30 3 * * *') |
| `cma.telephony_tag` | tag_ref, name, is_counted, meaning | Aircall | GET /v1/tags via ingest-sweep at most hourly per connection; a tag first seen on a call joins the catalog at the call write (counted by default); is_counted and meaning (cma.set_telephony_tag_meaning, 0008zc; configuration only, the ingest never writes it) set on Configuration → Sources, Tags | at most hourly per connection inside ingest-sweep (every minute, docs/ingest/deploy.sh); the meaning on change |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | telephony.connected_min_seconds, calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds | CMA | seed 02 and db/100 (0008zc), then the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports, Other settings (cma.set_tenant_setting) | on change |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- population: cma.lead_deals_of(tenant) — open deals of counted lead pipelines, created on or after intake.start_date, not deleted, not closed — with at least one contact
- last agent email: a sent outgoing email to one of the deal's contacts, not deleted; an engagement must be neither an inbox-copy origin nor an automated origin; an inbox message must have actor 'agent' and a non-spam thread (NOTE: counted inbox/mailbox/channel flags are NOT applied here — finding)
- no response since: no incoming or forwarded email_message of those contacts after it (any kind; no spam/counted/origin narrowing), and no conversation on the deal or its contacts after it (cma.crm_call_conversation_of, 0008zc: a CRM call whose linked telephony call is a Conversation, at that call's start; a CRM call without a current link never counts)
- at least email.no_response_days days old (elapsed days, not business days)
- page filter: market only (the deal's market); the inbox and mailbox filters do not apply to deals

**Time** Now = now() at the read.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |
| `calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds` | 30 | 30 (db/100 carries the tenant's earlier attempts threshold over, addition 0008zc) |

### /reports/email-per-agent

#### `email_per_agent.sent`

**Sent** on /reports/email-per-agent · Sent (Verstuurd)

Emails this person sent in the period, from an inbox or logged in the CRM; automations and inbox copies left out.

**Formula as computed**

```
sent = count(counted agent sends — email.sent_agent's definition — grouped by the person holding '<adapter>_owner' with the sender's owner_ref). A send whose owner_ref is null, or whose owner id nobody holds, lands in the not-linked row.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.email_message` | source_kind, direction, status, occurred_at, actor_kind, owner_ref, origin, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, thread_source_id, category, source_deleted_at | HubSpot conversations | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-email (docs/ingest/deploy.sh) → GET /conversations/v3/conversations/threads?latestMessageTimestampAfter and threads/{id}/messages → cma.ingest_upsert_emails(); engagements via POST /crm/v3/objects/emails/search → the same function; nightly reconcile and backfill too | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh schedules ingest-poll-email '* * * * *'); the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |
| `cma.integration_connection` | settings (email_inbox_copy_origins, email_automated_origins, email_origin_property) | CMA | the Workspace's own write path / runbook: cma.set_connection_settings() (decisions.md 18 Oct 2026: email_origin_property = hs_engagement_source, email_inbox_copy_origins = CONVERSATIONS for Pulse4all, set by the runbook) | on configuration |
| `cma.app_user_external_id` | system, external_id, user_id | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: People → linked accounts, system '<adapter>_owner' (0008e) | on configuration |
| `cma.app_user` | id, display_name | CMA | People (cma.add_person, invitations) | on configuration |
| `cma.crm_contact` | source_id, country | HubSpot | contact read after the first email or thread that points to it (ingest-poll-email), property webhooks → ingest service → cma.ingest_upsert_contacts(), nightly reconcile | every minute (poll) and on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.form_submission` | contact_source_id, source_form_id, submitted_at, contact_resolution | HubSpot forms | Cloud Run job ingest-poll-forms → cma.ingest_upsert_form_submissions() (the market chain's form step) | counted forms every minute, polled-only every forms_poll_interval_minutes (default 5; docs/ingest/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, source_id, market | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks → ingest service → cma.upsert_crm_record(); the market chain's record step (ticket, then deal) | on webhook; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.crm_association` | from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, removed_at | HubSpot | ingest-poll-email reads an engagement's associations with each change (v4 batch read) → cma.ingest_upsert_associations() | every minute with the email poll; reconcile nightly |
| `cma.market` | code, time_zone | CMA | tenant configuration (Configuration → Markets) | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.email_per_person_page()
- gate: cma.assert_per_person('email') — performance.team AND the tenant's reports.per_person holding 'email' (CMA06 otherwise; the route 404s first in the web)
- counted emails / counted, non-spam conversations only, exactly as the Email report (cma.email_of and peers)
- period on the business date in the email's (opening's, close's) market zone
- page filters market, inbox, mailbox as the Email report's
- credits: a send by the sender's owner_ref, a first reply by the replying agent's, a close only when the close event's actor_kind = 'agent', by the closer's owner_ref; matched to the person holding '<adapter>_owner' = source_system || '_owner' (0008e)

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

```sql
with e as ( select em.*, c.settings as conn, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_message em join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and c.id = em.connection_id join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = em.tenant_id left join cma.email_thread th on em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and th.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and th.connection_id = em.connection_id and th.source_id = em.thread_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = em.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = em.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = em.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = coalesce(em.account_ref, th.account_ref) left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = em.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = em.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, em.connection_id, em.source_kind, em.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where em.tenant_id = :tenant_id and em.source_deleted_at is null and em.direction = 'out' and em.status = 'sent' and case when em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' then coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) and not coalesce(th.is_spam, false) and em.actor_kind not in ('bot', 'ai', 'system', 'integration') else not exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_inbox_copy_origins', '') || ',' || coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_automated_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(em.origin, ''))) end ), p as ( select e.*, u.id as uid, u.display_name from e left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = e.source_system || '_owner' and xi.external_id = e.owner_ref left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id where (e.occurred_at at time zone e.zone)::date between :from and :to ) select coalesce(p.display_name, 'not linked'), count(*) from p group by 1 order by 1
```
