#### `email_per_agent.first_replies`

**First replies** on /reports/email-per-agent · First replies (Eerste antwoorden)

Conversations this person replied to first in the period: the openings whose first agent reply was theirs.

**Formula as computed**

```
replies = count(openings of the period with first_reply_at not null, credited to the replying agent's owner_ref — the owner on the first outgoing agent message after the opening's first incoming one).
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified

select th.id, th.connection_id, th.source_id, ev.occurred_at, pc.cl from cma.email_thread_event ev join cma.email_thread th on th.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and th.connection_id = ev.connection_id and th.source_id = ev.thread_source_id cross join lateral ( select max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'closed') as cl, max(c.occurred_at) filter (where c.kind = 'reopened') as re from cma.email_thread_event c where c.tenant_id = ev.tenant_id and c.connection_id = ev.connection_id and c.thread_source_id = ev.thread_source_id and c.kind in ('closed', 'reopened') and c.occurred_at < ev.occurred_at ) pc where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.kind = 'reopened' and pc.cl is not null and pc.cl >= coalesce(pc.re, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone, th.source_system from cma.email_thread th join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = th.tenant_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ), r as ( select op.*, t.mkt, t.zone, t.source_system, cl.at as closed_at, fi.at as first_in, fr.owner_ref as reply_owner, fr.at as reply_at from op join t on t.id = op.id left join lateral ( select min(ev.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_thread_event ev where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.connection_id = op.connection_id and ev.thread_source_id = op.source_id and ev.kind = 'closed' and ev.occurred_at >= op.open_at ) cl on true left join lateral ( select min(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > op.span_from and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) fi on true left join lateral ( select m.occurred_at as at, m.owner_ref from cma.email_message m where fi.at is not null and m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = order by m.occurred_at, m.source_id limit 1 ) fr on true where (op.open_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to and fr.at is not null ) select coalesce(u.display_name, 'not linked'), count(*) from r left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = r.source_system || '_owner' and xi.external_id = r.reply_owner left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id group by 1 order by 1

#### `email_per_agent.median_first_reply`

**First reply** on /reports/email-per-agent · First reply (Eerste antwoord)

The person's typical (median) first reply time in business minutes, over the conversations they replied to first.

**Formula as computed**

```
percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by reply_business_seconds) over the person's replies whose business seconds are known, rounded to 0.1 s; dash without values. Same opening/first-in/reply rule as the Email report's first reply.
```

**Unit** median · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified

m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > op.span_from and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) fi on true left join lateral ( select m.occurred_at as at, m.owner_ref from cma.email_message m where fi.at is not null and m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction = 'out' and m.actor_kind = 'agent' and m.status <> 'failed' and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > fi.at and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) order by m.occurred_at, m.source_id limit 1 ) fr on true where (op.open_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to and fr.at is not null ) select coalesce(u.display_name, 'not linked'), round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, r.mkt, r.first_in, r.reply_at))::numeric, 1) from r left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = r.source_system || '_owner' and xi.external_id = r.reply_owner left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id where **Data prerequisites**

- office hours per market, else replies fall out of the business median (no_hours)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Email and Email per agent; api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/email-per-agent; data-model/0008.md, Data model: email reports (0008t); data-model/0008.md, Data model: report speed (0008x); decisions.md, 18 October 2026 (reports.per_person; Yordi's agreement to per-person email figures); kpis.md §7 (productivity per agent) and §11

**Notes**

True median per person; the API also returns the elapsed median (replyMedianSeconds), which the table does not show — catalogued as email_per_agent.median_first_reply_elapsed (surface api). The total row's median is recomputed over everyone's replies (grouping sets), never an average of the rows. Cross-page: the same formula as Reports → Email's first reply (audit rule 11, consistent). verify_sql is written as a delta on email_per_agent.first_replies' standalone query to stay readable; the consolidator can splice it.

#### `email_per_agent.within_target_share`

**Within target** on /reports/email-per-agent · Within target (Binnen doel)

The share of the person's first replies within the tenant's reply target, of their replies whose market has business hours.

**Formula as computed**

```
within_target = count(their replies with reply_within_target true, i.e. business seconds <= greatest(1, email.reply_target_minutes) * 60); target_known = count(their replies with business seconds known); share = within_target / target_known, dash when 0.
```

**Unit** share · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.email_thread` | source_id, status, source_created_at, closed_at, is_spam, inbox_source_id, account_ref, channel_source_id, contact_source_id, ticket_source_id, category | HubSpot conversations | ingest-poll-email → cma.ingest_upsert_threads(); status-only changes via the open check (cursor email:open-check) and the nightly reconcile | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); the open check every email_open_check_minutes (connection setting, default 15; ingest/src/adapters/hubspot/usage.mjs) |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.email_per_person_page()
- gate: cma.assert_per_person('email') — performance.team AND the tenant's reports.per_person holding 'email' (CMA06 otherwise; the route 404s first in the web)
- counted emails / counted, non-spam conversations only, exactly as the Email report (cma.email_of and peers)
- period on the business date in the email's (opening's, close's) market zone
- page filters market, inbox, mailbox as the Email report's
- credits: a send by the sender's owner_ref, a first reply by the replying agent's, a close only when the close event's actor_kind = 'agent', by the closer's owner_ref; matched to the person holding '<adapter>_owner' = source_system || '_owner' (0008e)

**Time** Business date, ISO week (date_trunc('week'), Monday) and hour of an email, opening or close in its market's zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; the period is business dates [from,to] inclusive, read with a day's buffer per side so a market in another zone keeps whole dates; now = now() at read time; a running period's previous span cuts its last date at now's time of day in each row's own zone (cma.forms_previous_of until).

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `reports.per_person` | '' (0008t: empty, no per-person page) | email (seed 02, Pulse4all Subscriptions only; Yordi agreed 18 Oct 2026; dev seed 03: email,orders,attempts,deals) |
| `email.reply_target_minutes` | 240 (0008m; business minutes, 1 to 10080) | 240 (seed 02 sets no email value) |

ev.occurred_at ) pc where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.kind = 'reopened' and pc.cl is not null and pc.cl >= coalesce(pc.re, '-infinity'::timestamptz) ), t as ( select th.id, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone, th.source_system from cma.email_thread th join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = th.tenant_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = th.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = th.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = th.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = th.account_ref left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = th.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = th.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, th.connection_id, 'inbox_thread', th.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = th.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where th.tenant_id = :tenant_id and not th.is_spam and coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) ), r as ( select op.*, t.mkt, t.zone, t.source_system, cl.at as closed_at, fi.at as first_in, fr.owner_ref as reply_owner, fr.at as reply_at from op join t on t.id = op.id left join lateral ( select min(ev.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_thread_event ev where ev.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ev.connection_id = op.connection_id and ev.thread_source_id = op.source_id and ev.kind = 'closed' and ev.occurred_at >= op.open_at ) cl on true left join lateral ( select min(m.occurred_at) as at from cma.email_message m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction in ('in', 'forwarded') and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > op.span_from and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) ) fi on true left join lateral ( select m.occurred_at as at, m.owner_ref from cma.email_message m where fi.at is not null and m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.connection_id = op.connection_id and m.thread_source_id = op.source_id and m.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and m.direction = 'out' and m.actor_kind = 'agent' and m.status <> 'failed' and m.source_deleted_at is null and m.occurred_at > fi.at and (cl.at is null or m.occurred_at <= cl.at) order by m.occurred_at, m.source_id limit 1 ) fr on true where (op.open_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to and fr.at is not null ) select coalesce(u.display_name, 'not linked'), (count(*) filter (where cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, r.mkt, r.first_in, r.reply_at) <= greatest(1, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'email.reply_target_minutes')::integer) * 60))::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, r.mkt, r.first_in, r.reply_at) is not null), 0) from r left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = r.source_system || '_owner' and xi.external_id = r.reply_owner left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id group by 1 order by 1

#### `email_per_agent.closed`

**Closed** on /reports/email-per-agent · Closed (Gesloten)

Conversations this person closed in the period. Only closes by an agent are credited; a close by the system or an automation is in the team figure (Reports → Email) only.

**Formula as computed**

```
threads_closed = count(close events of counted, non-spam conversations in the period where actor_kind = 'agent', grouped by the closing agent's owner_ref through '<adapter>_owner').
```

#### `email_per_agent.sent_by_hour`

**Emails sent per hour of the day** on /reports/email-per-agent · Emails sent per hour of the day (Verstuurde e-mails per uur van de dag)

The drill-down a row opens (Enter or a click): the person's agent sends over the period as 24 small columns, one per hour of the day.

**Formula as computed**

```
sent_by_hour[h] = count(the person's agent sends where extract(hour from occurred_at at time zone the email's market zone) = h), h = 0..23; the bars scale to the person's own largest hour.
```

- credits: a send by the sender's owner_ref, a first reply by the replying agent's, a close only when the close event's actor_kind = 'agent', by the closer's owner_ref; matched to the person holding '<adapter>_owner' = source_system || '_owner' (0008e)

**Time** The hour is the send's local hour in ITS market's zone (local_hour), not the viewer's or the tenant's: emails of different markets land on their own local clocks.

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with e as ( select em.*, c.settings as conn, mk.code as mkt, coalesce(mm.time_zone, tn.timezone) as zone from cma.email_message em join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and c.id = em.connection_id join cma.tenant tn on tn.id = em.tenant_id left join cma.email_thread th on em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' and th.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and th.connection_id = em.connection_id and th.source_id = em.thread_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox ib on ib.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ib.connection_id = em.connection_id and ib.source_inbox_id = em.inbox_source_id left join cma.connection_inbox_account ac on ac.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ac.connection_id = em.connection_id and ac.source_account_id = coalesce(em.account_ref, th.account_ref) left join cma.connection_inbox_channel ch on ch.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and ch.connection_id = em.connection_id and ch.source_channel_id = em.channel_source_id cross join lateral cma.email_market_of(:tenant_id, em.connection_id, em.source_kind, em.source_id) mk left join cma.market mm on mm.tenant_id = em.tenant_id and mm.code = mk.code where em.tenant_id = :tenant_id and em.source_deleted_at is null and em.direction = 'out' and em.status = 'sent' and case when em.source_kind = 'inbox_message' then coalesce(ib.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ac.is_counted, true) and coalesce(ch.is_counted, true) and not coalesce(th.is_spam, false) and em.actor_kind not in ('bot', 'ai', 'system', 'integration') else not exists (select 1 from unnest(string_to_array(coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_inbox_copy_origins', '') || ',' || coalesce(c.settings ->> 'email_automated_origins', ''), ',')) x where btrim(x) <> '' and lower(btrim(x)) = lower(coalesce(em.origin, ''))) end ), p as ( select e.*, u.id as uid, u.display_name from e left join cma.app_user_external_id xi on xi.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xi.system = e.source_system || '_owner' and xi.external_id = e.owner_ref left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xi.user_id where (e.occurred_at at time zone e.zone)::date between :from and :to ) select coalesce(p.display_name, 'not linked'), extract(hour from p.occurred_at at time zone p.zone)::integer as h, count(*) from p group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2
```

Empty state 'Nothing sent in this period' when the person sent 0. Hover title '{hour}:00: n'. Yordi's 18 Oct 2026 agreement explicitly covered the per-hour view. #### `email_per_agent.not_linked`

**Not linked ({n} owners)** on /reports/email-per-agent · Not linked ({n} owners) (Niet gekoppeld ({n} eigenaren))

One row for every action whose owner id no person holds, and every send without an owner: how many distinct owner ids that is — never which.

**Formula as computed**

```
unlinked_owners = count(distinct owner_ref) over the not-linked actions (a null owner_ref joins the row but adds no owner to the count); the row's sent/replies/closed/medians aggregate all not-linked actions together.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period · **Status** verified

### /reports/follow-up

#### `follow_up.leads_open_not_called`

**Leads not called** on /reports/follow-up · Leads not called (Leads niet gebeld)

How many new lead deals are open right now with no outbound call yet: the backlog an agent can still act on.

**Formula as computed**

```
count of open lead deals not called = deals of counted lead pipelines (connection_pipeline.is_counted AND is_lead, both default true when the pipeline is not in the catalog), record_type='deal', source_deleted_at null, source_created_at >= intake.start_date (tenant zone), not coalesce(is_closed,false), with NO outbound CRM call whose effective start (linked telephony call's started_at while the link is current, else crm_call.occurred_at) >= deal created_at - speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes, associated with the deal or any of its contacts (cma.speed_to_lead_of status='not_called_open'). The tile reads the snapshot summary's leads_open_not_called = count(follow_up_item where kind='lead').
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | kind, state, row | CMA | Cloud Run job cma-refresh-follow-up (jobs/refresh-follow-up.mjs, web image) → cma.refresh_follow_up() as the tenant's Scheduler user → cma.refresh_follow_up_of() evaluating cma.open_leads_of once | every minute (docs/scheduler/deploy-follow-up.sh, '* * * * *' UTC; the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo); computed once on demand when the tenant has none |
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, pipeline_id, source_created_at, is_closed, owner_ref, market, contact_source_id, source_deleted_at | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks (deal creation/propertyChange/deletion) → ingest service POST /hubspot/<key> → read-back → cma.ingest_upsert_records(); nightly ingest-reconcile and ingest-backfill through the same upsert | webhook read-back within seconds (subscriptions in hubspot/ project template; the installed app is outside the repo, to confirm); reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam (docs/ingest/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.crm_call` | direction, occurred_at, source_id, source_deleted_at | HubSpot | HubSpot call engagement webhooks/reconcile → cma.ingest_upsert_* ; linked to telephony calls by cma.link_calls() every minute (ingest-sweep) | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam |
| `cma.telephony_call` | started_at, source_deleted_at | Aircall | Aircall webhook POST /aircall/<key> → read-back GET /v1/calls/{id} → telephony tables; cma.call_link joins it to the CRM call | webhook read-back within seconds; the live webhook subscription sits in Aircall (created by docs/ingest scripts), outside the repo, to confirm |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS on tenant_id plus the transaction's app.tenant_id (cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.follow_up_page)
- counted lead pipelines only (connection_pipeline.is_counted AND is_lead; a pipeline not in the catalog counts)
- deals created at or after intake.start_date, in the tenant's zone
- source-deleted deals and calls excluded (source_deleted_at is null)
- a call in the pre-window (speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes before creation) counts as the deal's call
- the page's market/person/state filters narrow the LISTS only; the tiles always count everything

**Time** No period: the open set right now; now = the snapshot's computed_at (the refresh transaction's now()). Business time plays no role in this count itself.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes` | 0 | 0 |
| `intake.start_date` | 2026-10-01 | 2026-10-01 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot, computed once a minute per tenant; the page re-reads it every 10 s while the tab is visible (LiveRefresh); 'Updated … ago' under the title says the snapshot's age

**Computed in** `cma.follow_up_page` (0008s); `cma.refresh_follow_up_of` (0008s); `cma.open_leads_of` (0008o); `cma.speed_to_lead_of` (0007d); `cma.lead_deals_of` (0007d); `cma.lead_calls_of` (0008zc); `summarise` in src/lib/follow-up.ts; `default` in src/app/reports/follow-up/page.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre, t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as start from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), d as (select r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.contact_source_id, r.source_created_at from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(r.is_closed, false) and r.source_created_at >= (s.start::timestamp at time zone s.zone)) select count(*) from d cross join s where not exists (select 1 from cma.crm_call c left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre) and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and (a.to_id = d.contact_source_id or a.to_id in (select a2.to_id from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = d.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = d.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null))))))
```

**Fixture check** Ran against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and matched the page's own function for the last 30 days (101).

**Data prerequisites**

- Every call linked to a contact and a deal (kpis.md §11) (data quality check `telephony_call_unlinked`)
- CRM calls associated with a contact (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)
- No test deals in the live pipeline (kpis.md §11; pipelines unticked on Sources)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Follow-up; kpis.md §9 (new leads not called); data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o) and follow-up snapshot (0008s); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/follow-up/leads; decisions.md 18 Oct 2026 (snapshot)

**Notes**

verify_sql reads the live tables; the page reads the snapshot (up to ~1 min apart). An inbound call does NOT take a lead off this list (only an outbound call does, speed_to_lead_of fo = direction 'outbound'). Zero shows as 0 with the leads list saying 'Every new lead has been called' — also for a tenant with no CRM connection (see finding). Same figure on the Live board strip (live.follow_up_now.leads_open_not_called) and as the leads list's unfiltered count; the API list /api/v1/reports/follow-up/leads returns every row uncapped.

#### `follow_up.leads_past_target`

**Past the target** on /reports/follow-up · Past the target (Over de doeltijd)

Of the leads not called, how many have already waited longer than the speed-to-lead target.

**Formula as computed**

```
count of the not-called open set (see follow_up.leads_open_not_called) where past_target is true: cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, market, created_at, now()) > speed_to_lead.target_minutes * 60, business seconds in the deal's market's office hours. A deal whose market is not in the catalog ('unknown') has null business time and is NEITHER past nor within (state no_hours), so it is excluded from this count. Snapshot: count(follow_up_item kind='lead' and state='past_target').
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | kind, state | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.refresh_follow_up_of() → cma.open_leads_of() | every minute (docs/scheduler/deploy-follow-up.sh); on demand when none |
| `cma.crm_record` | source_created_at, market, contact_source_id | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks → ingest → cma.ingest_upsert_records() | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam |
| `cma.business_hours` | market, weekday, start_time, end_time | CMA | tenant configuration (seed 02 / Configuration) | on configuration |
| `cma.business_holiday` | market, day | CMA | tenant configuration | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- the not-called open lead set (counted lead pipelines, not deleted, not closed, created >= intake.start_date)
- leads without business hours (market 'unknown') excluded from this count (state no_hours, not past_target)
- the page filters narrow the lists only; the tile counts everything

**Time** Business seconds in the deal's market's office hours (the market's own cma.business_hours rows, else the '*' schedule, minus cma.business_holiday of the market or '*'); now = the snapshot's computed_at; strictly greater than the target.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `speed_to_lead.target_minutes` | 60 | 60 |
| `speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes` | 0 | 0 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot, computed once a minute per tenant; the page re-reads it every 10 s while the tab is visible

**Computed in** `cma.follow_up_page` (0008s); `cma.open_leads_of` (0008o); `cma.speed_to_lead_of` (0007d); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `summarise` in src/lib/follow-up.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.target_minutes')::integer * 60 as target_s, t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as start from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), d as (select r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.contact_source_id, r.source_created_at, rm.code as market from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(r.tenant_id, r.connection_id, r.market, r.contact_source_id) rm where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(r.is_closed, false) and r.source_created_at >= (s.start::timestamp at time zone s.zone)) select count(*) from d cross join s where cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market,'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) > s.target_s and not exists (select 1 from cma.crm_call c left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre) and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and (a.to_id = d.contact_source_id or a.to_id in (select a2.to_id from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = d.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = d.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null))))))
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Market on every deal or its contact's country (business hours need a market) (data quality check `market_not_in_catalog`)
- Every call linked (an unlinked call leaves a lead 'not called') (data quality check `telephony_call_unlinked`)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Follow-up; kpis.md §9 (new leads not called after 1 hour); data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o)

**Notes**

Helper cma.business_seconds_of and cma.record_market_of are used in verify_sql; they sit in the figure's chain but the figure is not those helpers themselves (brief's rule). The target is the one speed-to-lead target (never a second one: 72_follow_up.sql header). Same count feeds Welcome's Needs attention line and the Live strip; cross-page consistent (all read the snapshot summary's leads_past_target).

#### `follow_up.tickets_at_risk`

**Tickets at risk** on /reports/follow-up · Tickets at risk (Tickets in gevaar)

Open tickets that have used at least the warning share of their response time but are not over it yet.

**Formula as computed**

```
count of open tickets (record_type='ticket', source_deleted_at null, not coalesce(is_closed,false), pipeline coalesce(is_counted,true)) where open_s is not null AND open_s*100 >= sla*60*warn_pct AND open_s < sla*60; open_s = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, ticket's market, source_created_at, now()); sla = connection_pipeline.sla_minutes else tenant tickets.sla_minutes (greatest(1,..)); warn_pct = tickets.sla_warning_pct bounded 0..100; ticket's market = cma.record_market_of (the ticket's own market, else its contact's country). Snapshot: count(follow_up_item kind='ticket' state='at_risk').
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | kind, state | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.refresh_follow_up_of() → cma.open_tickets_of() | every minute (docs/scheduler/deploy-follow-up.sh); on demand when none |
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, pipeline_id, stage_id, source_created_at, is_closed, owner_ref, market, contact_source_id | HubSpot | HubSpot webhooks (ticket events) → ingest → cma.ingest_upsert_records(); reconcile/backfill | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam |
| `cma.connection_pipeline` | is_counted, sla_minutes | CMA | catalog refreshed from the source; sla_minutes set on Configuration → Sources via cma.set_pipeline_sla() (tenant.configure) | on configuration |
| `cma.business_hours` | market, weekday | CMA | tenant configuration | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- counted ticket pipelines only (connection_pipeline.is_counted; a pipeline not in the catalog counts)
- not closed by their stage (crm_record.is_closed), not deleted at the source
- tickets without business hours (unknown market) are state no_hours, never at_risk
- the page filters narrow the lists only; the tile counts everything

**Time** Business seconds open in the ticket's market's office hours since source_created_at; now = the snapshot's computed_at. At-or-past the warning share (>=), strictly under the SLA.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `tickets.sla_minutes` | 240 | 240 |
| `tickets.sla_warning_pct` | 75 | 75 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot, computed once a minute per tenant; the page re-reads it every 10 s while the tab is visible

**Computed in** `cma.follow_up_page` (0008s); `cma.open_tickets_of` (0008o); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `cma.record_market_of` (0007d); `summarise` in src/lib/follow-up.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select greatest(1, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tickets.sla_minutes')::integer) as sla_default, least(100, greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tickets.sla_warning_pct')::integer)) as warn), t as (select coalesce(p.sla_minutes, s.sla_default) as sla, s.warn, cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(rm.code,'unknown'), r.source_created_at, now()) as open_s from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(r.tenant_id, r.connection_id, r.market, r.contact_source_id) rm where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'ticket' and r.source_deleted_at is null and not coalesce(r.is_closed, false) and coalesce(p.is_counted, true)) select count(*) from t where t.open_s is not null and t.open_s < t.sla * 60 and t.open_s * 100 >= t.sla * 60 * t.warn
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Country (market) on every ticket (kpis.md §11) (data quality check `ticket_no_market`)
- Owner on every ticket (kpis.md §11) (data quality check `ticket_no_owner`)
- SLAs set up: whether HubSpot's SLA properties should feed connection_pipeline.sla_minutes is open (kpis.md §11)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Follow-up; kpis.md §9 (tickets about to breach the 4-hour SLA); data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o)

**Notes**

At exactly the warning share a ticket is at risk (>=); at exactly the SLA it is breached, not at risk (open_s < sla*60 strict). No ticket created-date lower bound: every open ticket counts, however old. Welcome's Needs attention shows at_risk+breached as one line; this tile is at_risk alone (labels differ, no conflation). verify_sql reads live tables while the page reads the snapshot.

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id()
- tasks not deleted at the source; status not done by the catalog (unknown status = open); type counted (unknown type = counted)
- due_state judged against the TENANT's business date (tenant.timezone), not a market's
- the page filters narrow the lists only; the tile counts everything

**Time** Calendar comparison in the tenant's zone: due local date < today's local date at the refresh's now(). No business hours involved; no period, no lookback bound.

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot, computed once a minute per tenant; the page re-reads it every 10 s while the tab is visible

**Computed in** `cma.follow_up_page` (0008s); `cma.open_tasks_of` (0008o); `summarise` in src/lib/follow-up.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id) select count(*) from cma.crm_task k cross join s left join cma.connection_task_status st on st.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and st.connection_id = k.connection_id and st.status_ref = k.status_ref left join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and not coalesce(st.is_done, false) and coalesce(y.is_counted, true) and k.due_at is not null and (k.due_at at time zone s.zone)::date < s.today
```

**Fixture check** Ran against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and matched the page's own function for the last 30 days (892).

**Data prerequisites**

- Task webhooks installed (open-decisions.md: until CMA-067 closes, a task change appears the next morning and a deleted task keeps counting)
- Task owners linked to people (for the per-person figures) (data quality check `crm_task_owner_unlinked`)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Follow-up; data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o) and CRM tasks (0008n); decisions.md 18 Oct 2026 (no lookback bound); open-decisions.md, task webhooks (CMA-067)

**Notes**

Freshness caveat accepted in writing (open-decisions.md): until the task subscriptions are installed, this count moves once a day (03:30 reconcile) even though the page says the figures are a minute old, and a task deleted in HubSpot stays counted. The tenant-zone rule means a task due 'today' in another market's zone can read overdue/later; documented in the hint ('in the organisation's time zone').

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |

**Computed in** `cma.open_leads_of` (0008o); `cma.speed_to_lead_of` (0007d); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `LeadsTable` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx; `fmtBusinessMinutes` in src/lib/reports.ts

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as start from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id) select r.source_id, floor(cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(rm.code,'unknown'), r.source_created_at, now()) / 60.0) as waiting_min from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(r.tenant_id, r.connection_id, r.market, r.contact_source_id) rm where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null and coalesce(p.is_counted,true) and coalesce(p.is_lead,true) and not coalesce(r.is_closed,false) and r.source_created_at >= (s.start::timestamp at time zone s.zone) order by 2 desc nulls last
```

#### `follow_up.leads.age_bucket_business_days`

**Age** on /reports/follow-up · Age (Leeftijd)

The lead's age in working days of its market, shown as one of the organisation's age groups ('0–1', '2–5', '5+ days').

**Formula as computed**

```
age_business_days = cma.business_days_of(tenant, market, created_at, now()): the count of dates strictly AFTER the creation's local date up to now's local date that have office hours (market's schedule else '*') and are no holiday; 0 when now is on the creation date; null for an unknown market (Muted dash, 'No business hours' on hover). Bucket: cma.age_bucket_of(days, leads.age_buckets_business_days): from the previous edge (0 first) to the first edge >= days, inclusive at the upper edge; above the last edge the open bucket 'edge+'. Label '{from}–{to} days' or '{last}+ days' (bucketLabel).
```

**Unit** business_days · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | row | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.open_leads_of() | every minute; on demand when none |
| `cma.business_hours` | market, weekday | CMA | tenant configuration | on configuration |
| `cma.business_holiday` | market, day | CMA | tenant configuration | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- the not-called open lead set

**Time** Local dates in the market's zone (cma.market.time_zone); a day counts when the market's schedule has that ISO weekday and no holiday of the market or '*' falls on it; the creation day itself never counts.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `leads.age_buckets_business_days` | 1,2,5 | 1,2,5 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot once a minute; the page re-reads every 10 s

**Computed in** `cma.open_leads_of` (0008o); `cma.business_days_of` (0008o); `cma.age_bucket_of` (0008o); `bucketLabel` in src/lib/follow-up.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select m.code, m.time_zone, case when exists (select 1 from cma.business_hours h where h.tenant_id = :tenant_id and h.market = m.code) then m.code else '*' end as sched from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id) select i.item_id, (i.row->>'created_at')::timestamptz as created, (select count(*) from generate_series(((i.row->>'created_at')::timestamptz at time zone s.time_zone)::date + 1, (now() at time zone s.time_zone)::date, interval '1 day') g(d) where exists (select 1 from cma.business_hours h where h.tenant_id = :tenant_id and h.market = s.sched and h.weekday = extract(isodow from g.d::date)) and not exists (select 1 from cma.business_holiday b where b.tenant_id = :tenant_id and b.market in (i.market, '*') and b.day = g.d::date)) as age_days, i.row->>'age_business_days' as page_value from cma.follow_up_item i join s on s.code = i.market where i.tenant_id = :tenant_id and i.kind = 'lead' and i.market <> 'unknown'
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 68 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Market on the deal or its contact's country (data quality check `market_not_in_catalog`)

**Documented in** features.md §4 (open leads with their age), §5, Reports → Follow-up; data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o); copy.ts hints.fuAge

**Notes**

A lead created this morning has age 0 ('0–1 days'): the creation day never counts, so the first bucket reads low on purpose. Buckets inclusive at their upper edge (days <= edge). The bucket edges come from the setting, never code (checked: no hardcoded list). The snapshot comparison in verify_sql is against the stored row; for a fully live check combine with the uncalled-set query of follow_up.leads_open_not_called.

#### `follow_up.leads.target_state`

**Target** on /reports/follow-up · Target (Doel)

Whether the speed-to-lead target has passed for this lead without a call.

**Formula as computed**

```
Badge from open_lead_row.past_target: true → 'Past target' (error tone), false → 'Within target' (success), null → 'No business hours' (neutral). past_target = (speed_to_lead_of.within_target is false), i.e. business seconds waited > speed_to_lead.target_minutes*60; false while under it; null when the market is unknown (no business time).
```

**Unit** flag · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | state, row | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.open_leads_of() (state past_target/within_target/no_hours) | every minute; on demand when none |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- the not-called open lead set

**Time** Business seconds in the market's office hours against the target, at the snapshot's computed_at; strictly greater than the target means past.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `speed_to_lead.target_minutes` | 60 | 60 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot once a minute; the page re-reads every 10 s

**Computed in** `cma.open_leads_of` (0008o); `cma.speed_to_lead_of` (0007d); `LeadsTable` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.target_minutes')::integer * 60 as target_s) select i.item_id, i.state, case when cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(i.market,'unknown'), (i.row->>'created_at')::timestamptz, now()) > s.target_s then 'past_target' when cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(i.market,'unknown'), (i.row->>'created_at')::timestamptz, now()) is null then 'no_hours' else 'within_target' end as recomputed from cma.follow_up_item i cross join s where i.tenant_id = :tenant_id and i.kind = 'lead'
```

#### `follow_up.leads.last_call_days`

**Last call** on /reports/follow-up · Last call (Laatste gesprek)

When anyone last spoke with (or called) this lead, in whole days: 'None' when nobody has.

**Formula as computed**

```
last_call_at = max(effective start) over the deal's linked CRM calls in EITHER direction (cma.lead_calls_of over the deal and its contacts, from created_at - pre_window); last_call_days = floor(epoch(now() - last_call_at)/86400), wall-clock days, not business days. Shown as 'None' (Muted) when null, 'Today' at 0, '1 day ago', '{n} days ago'.
```

**Unit** days · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | row | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.open_leads_of() | every minute; on demand when none |
| `cma.crm_call` | occurred_at, direction, source_id | HubSpot | HubSpot call webhooks/reconcile → ingest | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 |
| `cma.telephony_call` | started_at | Aircall | Aircall webhook → read-back; cma.link_calls() every minute | webhook; subscription outside the repo, to confirm |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- calls associated with the deal or its contacts, not deleted, effective start >= created_at - pre_window; any direction (an inbound call shows here although it does not 'call' the lead)

**Time** Wall-clock days since the call's effective start (linked telephony start, else CRM time) at the snapshot's computed_at; not business days.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes` | 0 | 0 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot once a minute; the page re-reads every 10 s

**Computed in** `cma.open_leads_of` (0008o); `cma.lead_calls_of` (0008zc); `LeadsTable` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select i.item_id, i.row->>'last_call_at' as page_last_call, (select max(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) from cma.crm_call c left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = (i.row->>'connection_id')::uuid and c.source_deleted_at is null and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = i.row->>'deal_source_id') or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id in (select a2.to_id from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = c.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = i.row->>'deal_source_id' and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null))))) as recomputed from cma.follow_up_item i where i.tenant_id = :tenant_id and i.kind = 'lead'
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 101 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every call linked to a contact and a deal (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)

**Documented in** features.md §4, §5; copy.ts hints.fuLastCall; data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o)

**Notes**

Either direction on purpose (hint says so): a lead can show a recent 'last call' (inbound) and still be 'not called' (which needs an OUTBOUND call). The verify query approximates lead_calls_of's pre-window bound by omitting it (a call before creation-pre_window would differ); the deal's own contact_source_id is reached through the association subquery.

#### `follow_up.tickets.open_business_minutes`

**Open for** on /reports/follow-up · Open for (Open sinds)

How long the ticket has been open, counted only inside the office hours of its market.

**Formula as computed**

```
floor(open_business_seconds/60) via fmtBusinessMinutes; open_business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, ticket's market, source_created_at, now()); null (unknown market) shows a dash. Ticket's market = its own market field, else its contact's country (cma.record_market_of).
```

**Unit** business_minutes · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | row | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.open_tickets_of() | every minute; on demand when none |
| `cma.crm_record` | source_created_at, market, contact_source_id | HubSpot | HubSpot ticket webhooks → ingest | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 |
| `cma.business_hours` | market, weekday | CMA | tenant configuration | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- the open counted ticket set

**Time** Business seconds in the ticket's market's office hours since creation, at the snapshot's computed_at.

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot once a minute; the page re-reads every 10 s

**Computed in** `cma.open_tickets_of` (0008o); `cma.business_seconds_of` (0007d); `TicketsTable` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select r.source_id, floor(cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(rm.code,'unknown'), r.source_created_at, now()) / 60.0) as open_min from cma.crm_record r left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(r.tenant_id, r.connection_id, r.market, r.contact_source_id) rm where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'ticket' and r.source_deleted_at is null and not coalesce(r.is_closed,false) and coalesce(p.is_counted,true)
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 901 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Country (market) on every ticket (data quality check `ticket_no_market`)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Reports → Follow-up; copy.ts hints.fuOpenFor

**Notes**

Shared unchanged by /me/follow-up. Business time of the TICKET's market; a market-less ticket shows the No business hours state instead.

#### `follow_up.tickets.sla_state`

**State** on /reports/follow-up · State (Status)

Where the ticket stands against its response time: On time, At risk, Over time, or No business hours when its market is unknown.

**Formula as computed**

```
sla_state: 'no_hours' when open_business_seconds is null; 'breached' when open_s >= sla*60; 'at_risk' when open_s*100 >= sla*60*warn_pct (and under the SLA); else 'ok'. Badges: ok→'On time' (success), at_risk→'At risk' (warning), breached→'Over time' (error), no_hours→'No business hours' (neutral).
```

**Unit** flag · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | state, row | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.open_tickets_of() | every minute; on demand when none |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- the open counted ticket set

**Time** Business seconds against the SLA at the snapshot's computed_at; at-or-past boundaries (>=) for both at_risk and breached.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `tickets.sla_minutes` | 240 | 240 |
| `tickets.sla_warning_pct` | 75 | 75 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot once a minute; the page re-reads every 10 s

**Computed in** `cma.open_tickets_of` (0008o); `slaBadge` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx; `TicketsTable` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select greatest(1, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tickets.sla_minutes')::integer) as sla_default, least(100, greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tickets.sla_warning_pct')::integer)) as warn) select r.source_id, case when o.open_s is null then 'no_hours' when o.open_s >= coalesce(p.sla_minutes, s.sla_default)*60 then 'breached' when o.open_s*100 >= coalesce(p.sla_minutes, s.sla_default)*60*s.warn then 'at_risk' else 'ok' end as state from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(r.tenant_id, r.connection_id, r.market, r.contact_source_id) rm cross join lateral (select cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(rm.code,'unknown'), r.source_created_at, now()) as open_s) o where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'ticket' and r.source_deleted_at is null and not coalesce(r.is_closed,false) and coalesce(p.is_counted,true)
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 901 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Country (market) on every ticket (data quality check `ticket_no_market`)

**Documented in** features.md §5 (On time, At risk, Over time, No business hours); copy.ts followUp.stateOk/stateAtRisk/stateBreached/stateNoHours

**Notes**

The attention filter counts at_risk and breached. The hint says 'past {warning} %' while the code is at-or-past (>=): a one-boundary wording nuance, not a discrepancy worth a decision.

#### `follow_up.tickets.minutes_to_breach`

**Time left** on /reports/follow-up · Time left (Tijd over)

Business minutes left until the ticket's response time passes, or how far over it the ticket already is.

with s as (select greatest(1, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tickets.sla_minutes')::integer) as sla_default) select r.source_id, coalesce(p.sla_minutes, s.sla_default) - floor(cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(rm.code,'unknown'), r.source_created_at, now()) / 60.0)::integer as minutes_to_breach from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(r.tenant_id, r.connection_id, r.market, r.contact_source_id) rm where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'ticket' and r.source_deleted_at is null and not coalesce(r.is_closed,false) and coalesce(p.is_counted,true)

#### `follow_up.tasks.due_state`

**When** on /reports/follow-up · When (Wanneer)

Whether the task is overdue, due today, due later, or has no due time.

**Formula as computed**

```
due_state against the TENANT's business date: 'none' when due_at null, 'overdue' when its local date (tenant zone) < today, 'today' when equal, else 'later'. Badges: overdue→error, today→warning, later/none→neutral. The tasks list is sorted due_at asc nulls last, then created, id.
```

**Unit** flag · **Grain** now, per_record · **Status** verified, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.follow_up_item` | state, row | CMA | cma-refresh-follow-up → cma.open_tasks_of() | every minute; on demand when none |
| `cma.crm_task` | due_at | HubSpot | task webhooks (not installed, CMA-067) / reconcile 03:30 | configured outside the repo, to confirm; until then daily |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- the open counted task set

**Time** Calendar dates in the tenant's zone at the refresh's now() — NOT the market's zone (the task's market column is informational only here).

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team` or `monitoring.live`

**Refresh** follow-up snapshot once a minute; the page re-reads every 10 s

**Computed in** `cma.open_tasks_of` (0008o); `dueBadge` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx; `TasksTable` in src/components/FollowUpTables.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id) select k.source_id, case when k.due_at is null then 'none' when (k.due_at at time zone s.zone)::date < s.today then 'overdue' when (k.due_at at time zone s.zone)::date = s.today then 'today' else 'later' end as due_state from cma.crm_task k cross join s left join cma.connection_task_status st on st.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and st.connection_id = k.connection_id and st.status_ref = k.status_ref left join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and not coalesce(st.is_done,false) and coalesce(y.is_counted,true)
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 2000 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Task webhooks installed (CMA-067)

**Documented in** features.md §5 (Overdue, Today, Later or No due time); copy.ts hints.fuWhen; data-model/0008.md, follow-up (0008o)

**Notes**

The Due column next to it shows due_at in the VIEWER's zone (hint fuDue: 'in your own time zone') while the state is judged in the TENANT's zone: around midnight the badge and the shown date can look inconsistent for a viewer in another zone; by design, documented in the two hints.

#### `callbacks.week.callbacks`

**Callbacks** on /reports/follow-up · Callbacks (Terugbelafspraken)

Per ISO week: the callback tasks due in that week that can be judged — they have a contact and a due time.

**Formula as computed**

```
callbacks = kept + not_kept + pending: tasks of a counted callback type (connection_task_type.is_callback AND is_counted), not deleted, open or done alike, with due_at in the week AND a contact_source_id (cma.callbacks_kept_of state in ('kept','not_kept','pending')). The week = date_trunc('week', due time in the tenant's zone) (Monday, ISO). The page shows the current ISO week and the seven before it (CALLBACK_WEEKS=8, a screen span, not a business rule), newest first, a week without callbacks as zeros, plus a Total row over the span [Monday 7 weeks back .. today].
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** per_iso_week · **Status** ambiguous, cadence_unconfirmed

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.crm_task` | due_at, source_created_at, contact_source_id, type_ref, owner_ref, source_deleted_at | HubSpot | HubSpot task subscriptions (hubspot/ template, NOT yet installed: CMA-067) → cma.ingest_upsert_tasks(); until installed: ingest-reconcile 03:30 and ingest-backfill --object task | configured outside the repo: task subscriptions deferred, to confirm; until then daily (reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam) |
| `cma.connection_task_type` | is_callback, is_counted | CMA | Configuration → Sources (cma.set_task_type) | on configuration |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id() (cma.callbacks_kept_report)
- counted callback types only (is_callback AND is_counted both required — unlike open tasks, an un-catalogued type is NOT a callback)
- not deleted at the source; open or done alike (completion does not remove a callback)
- due in [from, to) tenant-zone; a task without a due time placed by its creation (counted apart as no_due)
- at most 92 days (cma.report_range)

**Time** Business date and ISO week from the due time (else creation) in the TENANT's zone; date_trunc('week') = Monday start; the page span is callbackWeeksRange(today in the viewer's zone): Monday 7 weeks before this week's Monday up to today; now = query time (pending windows judged against it).

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `tasks.callback_window_minutes` | 240 | 240 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** computed live on each page load and each 10 s poll (not from the follow-up snapshot)

**Computed in** `cma.callbacks_kept_report` (0008w); `cma.callbacks_kept_figures_of` (0008w); `cma.callbacks_kept_of` (0008w); `CallbackWeeksTable` in src/components/CallbacksTables.tsx; `callbackWeeksRange` in src/lib/callbacks.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tasks.callback_window_minutes')::integer) as win from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id), k as (select k.connection_id, k.source_id, k.contact_source_id, k.due_at, coalesce(k.due_at, k.source_created_at) as placed_at from cma.crm_task k join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref and y.is_callback and y.is_counted cross join s where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and ((k.due_at >= (:from::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.due_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)) or (k.due_at is null and k.source_created_at >= (:from::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.source_created_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)))), c as (select k.*, case when k.due_at is not null and k.contact_source_id is not null then (select min(coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at)) from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cl on cl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cl.connection_id = a.connection_id and cl.source_id = a.from_id and cl.source_deleted_at is null left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cl.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = k.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = k.contact_source_id and a.removed_at is null and coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at) between k.due_at - s.win and k.due_at + s.win) end as call_at from k cross join s) select date_trunc('week', (c.placed_at at time zone s.zone)::date)::date as week_start, count(*) filter (where c.due_at is not null and c.contact_source_id is not null) as callbacks, count(*) filter (where c.call_at is not null) as kept, count(*) filter (where c.due_at is not null and c.contact_source_id is not null and c.call_at is null and c.due_at + s.win <= now()) as not_kept, count(*) filter (where c.due_at is not null and c.contact_source_id is not null and c.call_at is null and c.due_at + s.win > now()) as pending, count(*) filter (where c.due_at is not null and c.contact_source_id is null) as no_contact, count(*) filter (where c.due_at is null) as no_due from c cross join s group by 1 order by 1
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every callback task typed as a callback in HubSpot, the type marked on Sources, with a due time and the contact associated (kpis.md §11)
- Task webhooks installed (CMA-067): until then a new or changed callback appears the next morning
- Every call linked to a contact (the kept lookup walks crm_association crm_call→contact) (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)

**Documented in** features.md §5, Callbacks kept (0008w); kpis.md §5 (Callbacks kept) and business case row 5; data-model/0008.md, callbacks kept (0008w); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/callbacks-kept; decisions.md 18 Oct 2026 (definition as Open decisions proposed)

**Notes**

'ambiguous' because the definition is still for Kira to confirm (open-decisions.md, Callbacks kept). This section reads live tables, NOT the follow-up snapshot (no 'Updated' line of its own). A tenant with no counted callback type sees 'No callback type set' in words, never 0 (cma.callbacks_kept_connected). Empty span shows 'No callbacks due in these weeks'. The one verify query answers all seven weekly columns.

#### `callbacks.week.kept`

**Kept** on /reports/follow-up · Kept (Nagekomen)

Per ISO week: callbacks where someone actually spoke with (or called) the contact around the promised time.

**Formula as computed**

```
kept = callbacks with a due time and a contact for which at least one call with the task's contact exists, in EITHER direction: a crm_call associated to the contact (crm_association crm_call→contact, removed_at null, same connection), not deleted, whose start — the linked telephony call's started_at while the link is current and the call not deleted, else crm_call.occurred_at — lies within [due_at - window, due_at + window], both edges included; window = tasks.callback_window_minutes, WALL-CLOCK minutes, not business minutes. The call recorded is the earliest such one; minutes_from_due = round((call_at - due_at)/60).
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** per_iso_week · **Status** ambiguous

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.crm_task` | due_at, contact_source_id | HubSpot | task webhooks (not installed, CMA-067) / reconcile 03:30 | configured outside the repo, to confirm; until then daily |
| `cma.crm_call` | occurred_at, source_id, source_deleted_at | HubSpot | HubSpot call webhooks/reconcile → ingest | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 |
| `cma.telephony_call` | started_at, source_deleted_at | Aircall | Aircall webhook → read-back; cma.link_calls() every minute | webhook; subscription outside the repo, to confirm |
| `cma.crm_association` | from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, removed_at | HubSpot | association webhooks / reconcile | webhook read-back within seconds; reconcile 03:30 |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- counted callback types; not deleted; due in the period
- the call must be with the TASK's contact on the same connection; any direction; answered or not (no connected threshold)

**Time** Wall-clock window around the due time, both edges included; week from the due time in the tenant's zone.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `tasks.callback_window_minutes` | 240 | 240 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** computed live on each page load / 10 s poll

**Computed in** `cma.callbacks_kept_of` (0008w); `cma.callbacks_kept_figures_of` (0008w); `callbackRecords` in src/lib/callbacks.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tasks.callback_window_minutes')::integer) as win from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id) select date_trunc('week', (k.due_at at time zone s.zone)::date)::date as week_start, count(*) as kept from cma.crm_task k join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref and y.is_callback and y.is_counted cross join s where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and k.due_at >= (:from::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.due_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.contact_source_id is not null and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cl on cl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cl.connection_id = a.connection_id and cl.source_id = a.from_id and cl.source_deleted_at is null left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cl.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = k.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = k.contact_source_id and a.removed_at is null and coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at) between k.due_at - s.win and k.due_at + s.win) group by 1 order by 1
```

**Fixture check** Ran against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and matched the page's own function for the last 30 days (0; the fixture holds no callback tasks, so the match is empty-against-empty).

**Data prerequisites**

- Due time and contact on every callback task
- Every call linked to a contact (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)

**Documented in** data-model/0008.md, callbacks kept (0008w): Definition; kpis.md §5; copy.ts hints.cbKept; decisions.md 18 Oct 2026

**Notes**

Either direction and the symmetric window are the proposed definition Kira still confirms. The call need not be answered or connected: any call event with the contact in the window keeps the callback — a nuance against business-case KPI 5's 'attempted within the promised window', which this matches, and against 'callbacks within 4 hours' of KPIs §8. Note the kept lookup uses the task's PRIMARY contact (contact_source_id), not every associated contact of the task.

#### `callbacks.week.not_kept`

**Not kept** on /reports/follow-up · Not kept (Niet nagekomen)

Per ISO week: callbacks whose window closed without any call with the contact — a task completed without a call counts as not kept too.

**Formula as computed**

```
not_kept = callbacks with a due time and a contact, no call in the window, and due_at + window <= now() (the window closed). Task status plays no role: completing the task in HubSpot without a call does not make it kept.
```

- counted callback types; due in the period; contact present

**Computed in** `cma.callbacks_kept_of` (0008w); `callbackRecords` in src/lib/callbacks.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tasks.callback_window_minutes')::integer) as win from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id) select date_trunc('week', (k.due_at at time zone s.zone)::date)::date as week_start, count(*) as not_kept from cma.crm_task k join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref and y.is_callback and y.is_counted cross join s where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and k.due_at >= (:from::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.due_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.contact_source_id is not null and k.due_at + s.win <= now() and not exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cl on cl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cl.connection_id = a.connection_id and cl.source_id = a.from_id and cl.source_deleted_at is null left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cl.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = k.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = k.contact_source_id and a.removed_at is null and coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at) between k.due_at - s.win and k.due_at + s.win) group by 1 order by 1
```

- Due time and contact on every callback task

**Documented in** data-model/0008.md, callbacks kept (0008w); copy.ts hints.cbNotKept

**Notes**

Mirrors the SQL exactly ('pending' is due_at + win > now, so not_kept is <=). Weeks in the past can still gain kept/lose not_kept if a backdated call arrives later.

**Computed in** `cma.callbacks_kept_of` (0008w); `callbackRecords` in src/lib/callbacks.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tasks.callback_window_minutes')::integer) as win from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id) select date_trunc('week', (k.due_at at time zone s.zone)::date)::date as week_start, count(*) as pending from cma.crm_task k join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref and y.is_callback and y.is_counted cross join s where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and k.due_at >= (:from::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.due_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.contact_source_id is not null and k.due_at + s.win > now() and not exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cl on cl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cl.connection_id = a.connection_id and cl.source_id = a.from_id and cl.source_deleted_at is null left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cl.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = k.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = k.contact_source_id and a.removed_at is null and coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at) between k.due_at - s.win and k.due_at + s.win) group by 1 order by 1
```

- Due time and contact on every callback task

**Documented in** data-model/0008.md, callbacks kept (0008w); copy.ts hints.cbPending

**Notes**

A callback due up to window minutes in the FUTURE is already listed as pending when its due time falls in the span (the span ends today).

#### `callbacks.week.kept_share`

**Kept share** on /reports/follow-up · Kept share (Aandeel nagekomen)

Per ISO week: kept as a share of the callbacks already decided.

**Formula as computed**

```
kept / (kept + not_kept); 'decided' = kept + not_kept, so pending, no_contact and no_due never enter the denominator. Null (shown as a dash '–') when nothing is decided (keptShare returns null at decided 0; fmtPercent formats whole percents, '< 1%' under 0.5%).
```

**Unit** share · **Grain** per_iso_week · **Status** ambiguous

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.crm_task` | due_at, contact_source_id | HubSpot | task webhooks (not installed) / reconcile 03:30 | configured outside the repo, to confirm; until then daily |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS
- decided callbacks only in the denominator

**Time** As the week's kept and not kept.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `tasks.callback_window_minutes` | 240 | 240 |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** computed live on each page load / 10 s poll; the share itself is computed in the web from the counts

**Computed in** `cma.callbacks_kept_figures_of` (0008w); `keptShare` in src/lib/callbacks.ts; `CallbackWeeksTable` in src/components/CallbacksTables.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select timezone as zone, make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'tasks.callback_window_minutes')::integer) as win from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id), c as (select k.due_at, (exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a join cma.crm_call cl on cl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cl.connection_id = a.connection_id and cl.source_id = a.from_id and cl.source_deleted_at is null left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cl.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = k.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = k.contact_source_id and a.removed_at is null and coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at) between k.due_at - s.win and k.due_at + s.win)) as kept, (k.due_at + s.win <= now()) as closed from cma.crm_task k join cma.connection_task_type y on y.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref and y.is_callback and y.is_counted cross join s where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null and k.contact_source_id is not null and k.due_at >= (:from::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and k.due_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)) select count(*) filter (where kept)::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where kept or closed), 0) as kept_share from c
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Due time and contact on every callback task

**Documented in** data-model/0008.md, callbacks kept (0008w): kept share; copy.ts hints.cbShare; kpis.md business case row 5 (> 95 %)

**Notes**

The division happens in the web (keptShare), null-safe; the SQL answers counts only — no divide-by-zero. The Dashboard's Callbacks kept tile (agent intake-speed) shows the same share over the dashboard's period with '{kept} of {decided} kept · {pending} still open'; definitions identical (same keptShare helper).
