**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select count(*) from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'no_contact'
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant in every cma.*_of read
- deals only: record_type 'deal', not deleted, pipeline is_order AND is_counted, stage outcome 'won'
- period on the business date in the deal's market zone
- linked store order: not a test, not cancelled, not deleted, of a customer matched to the deal's contact (0008h), nearest within attribution.order_match_minutes of T
- market filter: a code or 'unknown'; level filter keeps first orders of that level only (the kinds counted apart show 0 with it); invalid values dropped with a notice

**Time** Business date = the deal's source_created_at (T) in its market's zone (cma.record_market_of → cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's; ISO week = its Monday; now = now() at read time; a day's read margin each side

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select coalesce(coalesce(k.linked_currency, k.deal_currency), 'none'), count(*) from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'first' group by 1 order by 1
```

#### `first_orders.amounts.amount`

**Amount** on /reports/first-orders · Amount per currency (Bedrag)

The first orders' total per currency: the linked store order's total, else the deal's own amount — never added across currencies.

**Formula as computed**

```
per currency c: sum(amount) over first orders with that currency; amount = the linked order's total_amount, else the deal's amount; 'No amount' row (currency 'none') shows a dash; sum ignores null amounts, so a currency row can show orders with a null amount
```

```sql
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select coalesce(case when k.linked_kind is not null then k.linked_currency else k.deal_currency end, 'none') as currency, sum(case when k.linked_kind is not null then k.linked_amount else k.deal_amount end) from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'first' group by 1 order by 1
```

Audit rule 10 holds: SQL groups by currency (first_orders_amounts_from), the web renders per currency (Intl currency format, code shown) and the per-market column lists one line per currency — nowhere a cross-currency sum. Currencies come from the store/deal, never from code.

#### `first_orders.amounts.call_center_amount`

**Call center** on /reports/first-orders · Call center amount per currency (Callcenter)

The part of each currency's amount from first orders attributed to call center.

**Formula as computed**

```
per currency c: coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where attribution = 'call_center'), 0); attribution as first_orders.call_center; the two parts sum to the Amount column (up to null amounts)
```

**Unit** currency · **Grain** period, per_currency · **Status** ambiguous

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant in every cma.*_of read
- deals only: record_type 'deal', not deleted, pipeline is_order AND is_counted, stage outcome 'won'
- period on the business date in the deal's market zone
- linked store order: not a test, not cancelled, not deleted, of a customer matched to the deal's contact (0008h), nearest within attribution.order_match_minutes of T
- market filter: a code or 'unknown'; level filter keeps first orders of that level only (the kinds counted apart show 0 with it); invalid values dropped with a notice
- first orders only (kind = 'first'); amounts in different currencies are NEVER added together — one row per currency

**Time** Business date = the deal's source_created_at (T) in its market's zone (cma.record_market_of → cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's; ISO week = its Monday; now = now() at read time; a day's read margin each side

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `attribution.window_days` | 90 | 90 (seed 02 sets none; catalog default, 84_first_orders.sql) |
| `attribution.level_order` | lead_deal,conversation,email,phone_match,attempt,known_contact | the default (seed 02 sets none) |
| `attribution.assisted_levels` | lead_deal,conversation,email,phone_match | the default (seed 02 sets none) |
| `attribution.known_contact_minutes` | 60 | 60 (default) |
| `attribution.order_match_minutes` | 1440 | 1440 (default) |
| `telephony.connected_min_seconds` | 0 | 0 (seed 02 and db/100, addition 0008zc) |
| `calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds` | 30 | 30 (db/100 carries the tenant's earlier attempts threshold over, addition 0008zc) |

- linked store order: not a test, not cancelled, not deleted, of a customer matched to the deal's contact (0008h), nearest within attribution.order_match_minutes of T
- market filter: a code or 'unknown'; level filter keeps first orders of that level only (the kinds counted apart show 0 with it); invalid values dropped with a notice
- first orders only (kind = 'first'), newest first (created_at desc, then deal id), the first follow_up.list_rows rows (default 100, 1 to 500)

#### `first_orders.list.evidence`

**Evidence** on /reports/first-orders · Evidence badges (Bewijs)

Every piece of evidence found in the window, as small badges in the tenant's level order (Lead, Call, Email, Phone, Attempt, Known); 'None' without any.

#### `first_orders.list.days`

**Days** on /reports/first-orders · Days from the first touch (Dagen)

Days from the order's first touch in the window to the order; a dash without a touch.

**Formula as computed**

```
round((T − first_touch_at) / 86400 s, 2); first_touch_at = min over the evidence touches in the window (known_contact is no touch)
```

**Unit** days · **Grain** period, per_record · **Status** ambiguous

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the explicit tenant in every cma.*_of read
- deals only: record_type 'deal', not deleted, pipeline is_order AND is_counted, stage outcome 'won'
- period on the business date in the deal's market zone
- linked store order: not a test, not cancelled, not deleted, of a customer matched to the deal's contact (0008h), nearest within attribution.order_match_minutes of T
- market filter: a code or 'unknown'; level filter keeps first orders of that level only (the kinds counted apart show 0 with it); invalid values dropped with a notice
- first orders only (kind = 'first'), newest first (created_at desc, then deal id), the first follow_up.list_rows rows (default 100, 1 to 500)

**Time** Business date = the deal's source_created_at (T) in its market's zone (cma.record_market_of → cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's; ISO week = its Monday; now = now() at read time; a day's read margin each side

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `attribution.window_days` | 90 | 90 (seed 02 sets none; catalog default, 84_first_orders.sql) |
| `attribution.level_order` | lead_deal,conversation,email,phone_match,attempt,known_contact | the default (seed 02 sets none) |
| `attribution.assisted_levels` | lead_deal,conversation,email,phone_match | the default (seed 02 sets none) |
| `attribution.known_contact_minutes` | 60 | 60 (default) |
| `attribution.order_match_minutes` | 1440 | 1440 (default) |
| `follow_up.list_rows` | 100 | 100 (seed 02 sets none) |

#### `first_orders.list.amount`

**Amount** on /reports/first-orders · Amount (list row) (Bedrag)

The first order's amount in its own currency: the linked store order's total, else the deal's amount; a dash without a currency.

**Formula as computed**

```
amount = linked order total_amount when a linked order exists, else deal.amount; currency likewise; rendered per currency, never summed
```

**Computed in** `cma.first_orders_page` (0008x); `cma.first_orders_of` (0008zc); `cma.first_orders_list_from` (0008x); `getFirstOrders` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `FirstOrderListTable` in src/components/FirstOrderParts.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select k.id, case when k.linked_kind is not null then k.linked_currency else k.deal_currency end, case when k.linked_kind is not null then k.linked_amount else k.deal_amount end from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'first' order by k.t desc
```

- the shop's customers linked to CRM contacts (0008h) for the linked order, its amount and the phone hashes (data quality check `commerce_unmatched / commerce_ambiguous`)

```sql
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select count(*) from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'first'
```

#### `first_orders.history_start`

**History from {date}** on /reports/first-orders · First-orders history start (Geschiedenis vanaf {date})

The first date the report can honestly cover: before it a first order's evidence window would reach back past the stored data.

**Formula as computed**

```
greatest(intake.start_date + attribution.window_days, the earliest stored won order deal's business date in the tenant's zone); null without an order deal (then no 'History from' line and every delta says 'No history')
```

**Unit** date · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

| `cma.connection_pipeline` | is_order, is_counted, is_lead, source_pipeline_id, label | CMA | pipeline catalog hourly (cma.ingest_upsert_pipelines()); is_order via Configuration → Sources (cma.set_pipeline_order(), 0008u) | catalog at most hourly; configuration on change |
| `cma.connection_stage` | outcome, outcome_source, source_stage_id, is_closed | CMA | pipeline catalog hourly: the source's outcome from the stage's probability (1.0 won, 0.0 and closed lost; adapter map.mjs), unless a person set it (cma.set_stage_outcome(), kept over every later read) | catalog at most hourly; a person's choice on change |

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as tz, cma.setting_of(t.id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start, cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.window_days')::integer as win from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id) select case when min(r.source_created_at) is not null then greatest(s.start + s.win, (min(r.source_created_at) at time zone s.tz)::date) end from s, cma.crm_record r join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won' where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null group by s.start, s.win, s.tz
```

### /reports/orders-per-person

#### `orders_per_person.orders`

**Credited orders** on /reports/orders-per-person · Credited orders (Toegekende bestellingen)

Per person, the first orders via the call center credited to them: the person behind the latest assisted touch before the order, through the linked accounts.

**Formula as computed**

```
credited person of a first order = the owner of the latest touch whose kind is in attribution.assisted_levels before T (order by touch time desc, then kind, then owner ref; a lead deal's owner_ref via '<adapter>_owner', a CRM call's owner likewise, a telephony call's user via '<adapter>_user', an email's sender owner_ref), resolved to a person through cma.app_user_external_id; orders = count per credited person; an inline Deep Blue bar scales each row to the column's largest value
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_person · **Status** ambiguous, prerequisite_missing

### /reports/data-quality

#### `data_quality.deal_without_contact`

**Lead deals without a contact** on /reports/data-quality · Lead deals without a contact (Leaddeals zonder contact)

Lead deals (counted lead pipelines, since intake.start_date) with no contact at all: no primary contact and no current deal-to-contact association. Calls to a contact can never count for them.

**Formula as computed**

```
count of cma.lead_deals_of(tenant, null, null) rows where cardinality(contacts) = 0; contacts = primary contact plus current associations.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now, per_check · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.crm_record` | record_type, source_deleted_at, source_created_at, pipeline_id, market, owner_ref, contact_source_id | HubSpot | HubSpot webhook -> ingest POST /hubspot/<key> -> read-back -> cma.ingest_upsert_crm_records() | webhook read-back within seconds; sweep every minute, reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); Cloud Scheduler itself is outside the repo |
| `cma.crm_association` | from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, removed_at | HubSpot | HubSpot webhook association changes -> ingest read-back | webhook read-back within seconds; sweep every minute, reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); Cloud Scheduler itself is outside the repo |
| `cma.connection_pipeline` | is_counted, is_lead, status, id | CMA | pipeline catalog by the source's refresh; flags by a person on Configuration -> Sources | catalog with each read-back; configuration on demand |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() passed explicitly to cma.data_quality_of under RLS; cma.data_quality checks reports.view or tenant.configure (CMA06)

**Time** counts are as of the query's now(); where a check limits itself to recent data it uses intake.start_date (tenant zone) on the record's own instant; the page's period bar does not exist here (no :from/:to)

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `intake.start_date` | 2026-10-01 | 2026-10-01 (catalog default; seed 02 sets none) |

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** on page load (server component); counts are recomputed live from the base tables on every read, no snapshot

**Computed in** `cma.data_quality` (0008p); `cma.data_quality_of` (0008zc); `orderChecks` in src/lib/reports.ts; `getDataQuality` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.contact_source_id,
         exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                 where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                   and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                   and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) as has_assoc
  from cma.crm_record d cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone))
select count(*) from d where d.contact_source_id is null and not d.has_assoc
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Data prerequisites**

- Every call linked to a contact and a deal (data quality check `crm_call_without_contact`)

**Documented in** docs/night-2026-10-10/DESIGN.md paragraph 4.4 (data-quality checks); kpis.md paragraph 11 (Data first); api.md, GET /api/v1/reports/data-quality; features.md paragraph 5 (Data -> Data quality)

**Notes**

db/74:1443-1446 (sort 10). The page shows the copy label and fix line; links nowhere. Muted at 0.

```sql
                 where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                   and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                   and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) as has_assoc
  from cma.crm_record d cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone))
select count(*) from cma.crm_contact k
where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null
  and (k.country is null or k.language is null)
  and exists (select 1 from d where d.connection_id = k.connection_id and d.contact_source_id = k.source_id)
```

```sql
with s as (select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id)
select count(*) from cma.telephony_call tc
join cma.integration_connection ic on ic.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ic.id = tc.connection_id
cross join s
where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  and tc.started_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone) and tc.started_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
  and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_call c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.source_deleted_at is null)
  and not exists (select 1 from cma.call_link l where l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.telephony_call_id = tc.id and l.unlinked_at is null)
  and not (coalesce(ic.settings ->> 'dq_unlinked_skip', case when ic.kind = 'telephony' then 'outbound_unanswered_untagged' end) = 'outbound_unanswered_untagged'
           and tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is null
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag g
```

```sql
select count(*) from cma.crm_record cr
left join cma.connection_pipeline p
```

```
one finding per (submission, field): form_submission.kept_values <> '{}' joined to a form with fields_refreshed_at not null, where the field is unknown, not a choice kind, or holds a value not in options || retired_options (strings and arrays both checked).
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now, per_check · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.form_submission` | kept_values, source_id, connection_id, source_form_id | HubSpot forms | ingest-poll-forms -> cma.ingest_upsert_form_submissions() | every minute (counted forms), every forms_poll_interval_minutes (polled-only; default 5) |
| `cma.connection_form` | status, is_counted, market, source_form_id, fields_refreshed_at, kept_fields | CMA | form catalog by ingest-poll-forms (hourly); configuration on Sources | catalog hourly; configuration on demand |
| `cma.connection_form_field` | name, kind, options, retired_options, status | HubSpot forms | each form's fields read by the forms poll with the catalog (0008p) | hourly with the form catalog |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() passed explicitly to cma.data_quality_of under RLS; cma.data_quality checks reports.view or tenant.configure (CMA06)

**Time** counts are as of the query's now(); where a check limits itself to recent data it uses intake.start_date (tenant zone) on the record's own instant; the page's period bar does not exist here (no :from/:to)

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** on page load (server component); counts are recomputed live from the base tables on every read, no snapshot

**Computed in** `cma.data_quality` (0008p); `cma.data_quality_of` (0008zc); `cma.data_quality_forms_checks` (0008p); `orderChecks` in src/lib/reports.ts; `getDataQuality` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select count(*) from cma.form_submission fs
join cma.connection_form f
  on f.tenant_id = :tenant_id and f.connection_id = fs.connection_id and f.source_form_id = fs.source_form_id
 and f.fields_refreshed_at is not null
cross join lateral jsonb_each(fs.kept_values) e
left join cma.connection_form_field ff
  on ff.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ff.connection_id = fs.connection_id and ff.source_form_id = fs.source_form_id and ff.name = e.key
where fs.tenant_id = :tenant_id and fs.kept_values <> '{}'::jsonb
  and (ff.name is null or not cma.form_choice_kind(ff.kind)
       or exists (select 1 from (select e.value #>> '{}' as v where jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'string'
                                 union all
                                 select x from jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'array' then e.value else '[]'::jsonb end) x) a
                  where not (a.v = any (ff.options || ff.retired_options))))
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

#### `data_quality.outbox_pending`

**Contact updates not sent** on /reports/data-quality · Contact updates not sent (Contactupdates die niet verstuurd zijn)

The outbox guard (TypeScript, not a database check): outbox actions of active connections still waiting 10 minutes after they fell due - the ingest-outbox job has no schedule or is not running. Shown only while the count is above 0.

**Formula as computed**

```
count(outbox_action) joined to its active integration_connection where status in ('pending','failed','in_flight') and next_attempt_at < now() - OUTBOX_LATE_MINUTES (10, a TS constant mirroring the sweep's OUTBOX_LATE); appended AFTER the database's checks by withOutboxPending, and only when > 0.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** now, per_check · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.outbox_action` | status, connection_id, next_attempt_at | CMA | the write-back layer (0007c) queues CRM contact updates; ingest-outbox delivers them (unscheduled since 0008h: it has nothing to deliver) | ingest-outbox has no schedule (docs/ingest/deploy.sh pauses any old one) |
| `cma.integration_connection` | status, kind, settings | CMA | connection configuration (cma.upsert_connection, Sources) | on demand (configuration) |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() passed explicitly to cma.data_quality_of under RLS; cma.data_quality checks reports.view or tenant.configure (CMA06)

**Time** counts are as of the query's now(); where a check limits itself to recent data it uses intake.start_date (tenant zone) on the record's own instant; the page's period bar does not exist here (no :from/:to)

**Who may see it** `reports.view` or `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** on page load (server component); counts are recomputed live from the base tables on every read, no snapshot

**Computed in** `cma.data_quality` (0008p); `cma.data_quality_of` (0008zc); `orderChecks` in src/lib/reports.ts; `getDataQuality` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select count(*) from cma.outbox_action o
join cma.integration_connection c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.id = o.connection_id and c.status = 'active'
where o.tenant_id = :tenant_id and o.status in ('pending', 'failed', 'in_flight')
  and o.next_attempt_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Notes**

src/lib/reports.ts:230-247 (OUTBOX_PENDING_CHECK, OUTBOX_LATE_MINUTES = 10), postgres.ts:2533-2542; brief A5 / FIND-05 (13 Oct 2026). Not in cma.data_quality() (no migration); the API route returns it too, after the DB rows. The 10 minutes is a hardcoded product constant (not a tenant setting) and also written literally into the copy's fix line in both languages - flagged low (audit rule 14 is about tenant values; this is cross-tenant product behaviour, but the copy would silently drift if the constant changed). The row's description text comes from the TS constant, in English only; copy.ts does carry check_/fix_ labels for it, which the page prefers.

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
with t as (select (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
d as (select dv.id, dv.market, dv.model_key, dv.end_of_life_on, coalesce(dv.last_shipped_on, dv.first_shipped_on) as anchor
      from cma.device dv join cma.device_status st on st.tenant_id = dv.tenant_id and st.key = dv.device_status_key and st.is_tracked
      where dv.tenant_id = :tenant_id and dv.source_deleted_at is null),
i as (select d.id, k.key as component, coalesce(c.expires_on, (a.anchor + make_interval(months => r.interval_months))::date) - coalesce(r.lead_days, 0) as action_on
      from d join cma.device_component_kind k on k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.status = 'active'
      left join cma.device_component c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.device_id = d.id and c.component_key = k.key and c.replaced_at is null
      left join cma.maintenance_rule r on r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.model_key = d.model_key and r.component_key = k.key
      cross join lateral (select case when c.id is not null and exists (select 1 from cma.device_component p where p.tenant_id = :tenant_id
                                       and p.device_id = d.id and p.component_key = k.key and p.replaced_at is not null)
                                      then (c.first_seen_at at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id))::date
                                      else d.anchor end as anchor) a
      where c.id is not null or r.id is not null or d.model_key is null
      union all select d.id, 'device', d.end_of_life_on from d where d.end_of_life_on is not null)
select count(*) from i where i.action_on is null and i.component <> 'device'
```

### /messages/send

#### `messages.sent.recipients`

**Recipients** on /messages/send · Recipients (Ontvangers)

How many people a sent message or alert reached: the delivery rows resolved when the message was written. Frozen history: team or skill changes afterwards never move it.

**Formula as computed**

```
cma.message_stats(from, to): per message created in the business-date range (tenant zone), count(d.user_id) over its cma.message_delivery rows. The page reads the last 30 days (SENT_DAYS), newest first.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_message · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.message_delivery` | message_id, user_id | CMA | cma.deliver_message() inside cma.send_message() (the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/messages) and the ingest service's alert calls (cma.ingest_record_alerts / ingest_assignment_alerts / ingest_send_message) | written once at send time; the page reads on load |
| `cma.message` | id, created_at, kind, urgency, title, rule_id, withdrawn_at | CMA | the same writes | on page load |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus the function's tenant filter
- messages created in [from, to] as business dates in the TENANT's zone (created_at >= from::timestamp at the tenant zone, < to+1)
- range at most 92 days (CMA04)
- no counted/uncounted filter: every message of the tenant, alerts included; a message nobody received shows 0 recipients (written on purpose so the stats show it)

**Time** period boundary in the tenant's zone; the page passes today-30..today computed in the VIEWER's zone (see finding)

**Who may see it** `messages.send` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** on page load (no poll); the list is server-rendered, withdraw updates it client-side

**Computed in** `cma.message_stats` (0008z); `SentMessages` in src/components/SentMessages.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select m.id, m.title, count(d.user_id) as recipients from cma.message m left join cma.message_delivery d on d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.message_id = m.id where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.created_at >= (:from::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) and m.created_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) group by m.id, m.title order by m.created_at, m.id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Messages (B12): GET /api/v1/messages/stats; data-model/0008.md, Messaging core (0008), cma.message_stats; features.md §7 (group targets resolved at send time, so the read count always has a denominator); DESIGN.md §4.5

**Notes**

The page gates on messages.send (redirect without it) although the function also accepts performance.team — a performance.team-only person could read the API but has no screen. 0008z re-created the function with withdrawn_at/withdrawn_by appended; the counting is unchanged, so a withdrawn message keeps the counts it had (deliveries can no longer change: read/ack refuse withdrawn messages).

#### `messages.sent.read`

**Read** on /messages/send · Read (Gelezen)

Of a message's recipients, how many have read it (opened its record link, pressed Open/Acknowledge, or Mark all read).

**Formula as computed**

```
count(d.read_at) per message. read_at is set once by cma.mark_messages_read()/cma.acknowledge_message() (acknowledging also reads), never moves back (trigger), and can no longer be set after a withdrawal.
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** period, per_message · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.message_delivery` | message_id, read_at | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/me/messages/read → cma.mark_messages_read(); POST /api/v1/me/messages/{id}/ack → cma.acknowledge_message() | event-driven; the page reads on load |

**Filters**

- tenant and period as messages.sent.recipients
- own-delivery writes only: nobody can read a message for someone else

**Time** as messages.sent.recipients

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.message_stats` (0008z); `SentMessages` in src/components/SentMessages.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select m.id, count(d.read_at) as read from cma.message m left join cma.message_delivery d on d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.message_id = m.id where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.created_at >= (:from::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) and m.created_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) group by m.id order by m.created_at, m.id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

read_at implies delivered_at (check constraint) so Read <= Delivered <= Recipients always holds in the data.

#### `messages.sent.median_time_to_read`

**Median time to read** on /messages/send · Median time to read (Mediane leestijd)

The median time from a message's creation to its being read, over the recipients who have read it; a dash while nobody has.

**Formula as computed**

```
round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from d.read_at - m.created_at)))::integer per message — a TRUE median (rows with read_at null are ignored by the ordered-set aggregate, so the denominator is the readers, not the recipients). Shown as m:ss (fmtSeconds); null or negative shows '–'.
```

**Unit** median · **Grain** period, per_message · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.message_delivery` | message_id, read_at | CMA | cma.mark_messages_read()/cma.acknowledge_message() | event-driven; the page reads on load |
| `cma.message` | created_at | CMA | cma.send_message() / the ingest alert calls | on page load |

**Filters**

- tenant and period as messages.sent.recipients
- read deliveries only enter the median (nulls ignored)

**Time** measured from created_at, not from delivered_at: time before the recipient's first poll (tab closed, not clocked in) counts as time-to-read — documented in 0008.md ('median seconds from creation to reading')

**Who may see it** `messages.send` or `performance.team`

**Refresh** on page load

**Computed in** `cma.message_stats` (0008z); `fmtSeconds` in src/lib/messages.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select m.id, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from d.read_at - m.created_at)))::int as median_seconds_to_read from cma.message m left join cma.message_delivery d on d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.message_id = m.id where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.created_at >= (:from::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) and m.created_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) group by m.id order by m.created_at, m.id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, Messages (B12); data-model/0008.md, Messaging core (0008); DESIGN.md §4.5; decisions.md 11 Oct 2026 (the poll sets delivered times, so message_stats measures how fast agents see a message)

**Notes**

Audit rule 6 satisfied: percentile_cont(0.5), a true median, rounded to whole seconds. The label says 'time to read' and the base is creation-to-read, which includes delivery wait; code and docs agree, so this is a definition note, not a discrepancy. fmtSeconds formats m:ss (e.g. 95 -> 1:35), with '–' for null.

#### `messages.sent.withdrawn_state`

**Deleted** on /messages/send · Deleted (Verwijderd)

The Deleted badge on a withdrawn message in the sent list: the message was deleted for everyone (addition 0008z) but stays listed, struck through, its counts frozen, because the audit keeps it.

**Formula as computed**

```
withdrawnAt != null from cma.message_stats (m.withdrawn_at). Withdrawing (cma.withdraw_message, messages.withdraw) sets withdrawn_at/withdrawn_by once; a second call changes nothing and answers the first time. Recipients no longer see the message (my_messages, my_unread_count, mark_messages_read, acknowledge_message all exclude it), so its read/acknowledged counts can never grow after the withdrawal; a delivery not yet made never happens (the poll is the delivery).
```

**Unit** flag · **Grain** period, per_message · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.message` | withdrawn_at, withdrawn_by | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: POST /api/v1/messages/{id}/withdraw → cma.withdraw_message() (0008z); the only change a message ever takes (trigger cma.check_message_change) | event-driven; the list updates client-side on a successful withdraw |

#### `messages.compose.sent_to`

**Sent to {n} people** on /messages/send · Sent to {n} people (Verstuurd aan {n} personen)

The confirmation after sending: how many people the message reached, resolved by the database at send time.

**Formula as computed**

```
POST /api/v1/messages answers { id, recipients }: cma.send_message() resolves the target (everyone | teams | language at a minimum level | named users, optionally onlyClockedIn via cma.is_clocked_in = an open, started workday, pauses included) to active persons NOW and writes one delivery row each; a target that reaches nobody is refused (CMA04, 400, 'Nobody matches this target right now'). recipients is read back from cma.message_stats in the same transaction (postgres.ts:1833).
```

**Unit** count · **Grain** per_message · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.message_delivery` | message_id, user_id | CMA | cma.deliver_message() inside cma.send_message() | written once at send |
| `cma.team_member` | user_id, team_id, valid_from, valid_to | CMA | People screen (0004); current membership at send time | at send |
| `cma.user_skill` | user_id, skill_id, level, valid_from, valid_to | CMA | People screen; cma.has_skill at the minimum level | at send |
| `cma.workday` | user_id, status, started_at | CMA | the clock writes; cma.is_clocked_in for onlyClockedIn | at send |

- tenant: RLS plus the function's checks
- active persons only (kind = 'person', status = 'active')
- exactly one target group, validated in src/lib/messages.ts parseSendInput before the database (400 with a code) and again by cma.send_message (CMA04/CMA02)
- onlyClockedIn: an open workday that has started, pauses included; a forgotten day past its end is closed by the scheduler

**Time** resolved at the send instant; history stays exact when teams or skills change later

**Who may see it** `messages.send`

**Refresh** answered once per send

**Computed in** `cma.send_message` (0008); `cma.deliver_message` (0008); `cma.is_clocked_in` (0008); `cma.has_skill` (0008); `parseSendInput` in src/lib/messages.ts; `MessageComposer` in src/components/MessageComposer.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select d.message_id, count(*) as recipients from cma.message_delivery d join cma.message m on m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.id = d.message_id and m.kind = 'announcement' where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.created_at >= (:from::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) and m.created_at < ((:to::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id)) group by d.message_id order by 1
```

## Configuration

### /configuration/health

#### `health.app.probe_round_trip_ms`

**Storage round trip** on /configuration/health · Storage round trip (Opslag heen en terug)

How long one trivial database read takes from the application, as a liveness and latency signal for the storage; shown as a Fast/Slow/No answer badge with the milliseconds next to it.

**Formula as computed**

```
roundTripMs = round(performance.now() after - before) around one whole transaction: pool checkout, begin, set tenant context, select cma.assert_permission('tenant.configure'), select 1, commit (postgres.ts probeDatabase, line 2821). State: fast when roundTripMs <= 200, slow when > 200, down when the transaction failed (roundTripMs null; a CMA06/CMA01 permission error is rethrown, never shown as down) (lib/health.ts probeState, line 132).
```

**Unit** milliseconds · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.permission` | key | CMA | No data table is read: the probe is the transaction itself (assert_permission then select 1), timed by the application including the pool's checkout | on page load |

**Filters**

- tenant: the probe runs under the request's tenant context (app.tenant_id via set_config)
- permission: cma.assert_permission('tenant.configure') inside the timed transaction

**Time** Wall clock only: timed by performance.now() in the web process at render; no business date, no zone.

**Who may see it** `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** On page load; the Refresh button re-renders the page (router.refresh()); no poll. 'As of {time}' names the render instant.

**Computed in** `probeDatabase` in src/lib/data/postgres.ts; `probeState` in src/lib/health.ts

**Verification query** none is faithful for this figure; the notes name the closest check

**Fixture check** No independent query runs here (the notes say why and name the closest check); Martin checks it in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, System health (17 October 2026, addition 0008r); data-model/0008.md, Data model: System health (addition 0008r)

**Notes**

verify_sql null: the figure is a timing measured by the application, not derivable from any table. Unit: the schema's enum has no milliseconds; recorded as seconds with the value displayed in ms. The 200 ms fast/slow threshold is hardcoded in lib/health.ts (and named in the hint copy probeHint), not a tenant setting; see finding on hardcoded thresholds. Down shows the badge 'No answer' with no number. The timing includes the pool checkout, so a cold pool reads slower than the database alone.

#### `health.heartbeat.age`

**Ingest heartbeat** on /configuration/health · Ingest heartbeat (Hartslag van de inlezing)

How long ago the ingest sweep last ran for this tenant (the sweep leaves one link_calls run per tenant per minute), as the one signal that the ingest jobs run at all: Fresh, Late, Silent or No run yet, with 'Last run {age} ago'.

**Formula as computed**

```
age = max(0, floor((now_ms - parse(lastStartedAt of the newest sync_run row with job = 'link_calls' among the cma.system_health_runs() rows)) / 1000)) (lib/health.ts heartbeatRun + ageSeconds). State: none when no link_calls row in the 30-day window; fresh when age < health.heartbeat_fresh_seconds; silent when age >= health.heartbeat_late_seconds; late in between (heartbeatState). The thresholds line fills 'Fresh under {fresh}, silent from {late}' from the two settings.
```

**Unit** seconds · **Grain** now · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.sync_run` | job, started_at, tenant_id | CMA | Cloud Run job ingest-sweep (ingest/src/jobs/sweep.mjs) per tenant per minute → cma.ingest_sync_run_start()/cma.ingest_sync_run_finish() (0007), job 'link_calls' | every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh: Cloud Scheduler ingest-sweep '* * * * *' Europe/Amsterdam); the live schedule is Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |
| `cma.tenant_setting` | key, value | CMA | the Workspace's own write path: Configuration → Exports → PUT /api/v1/configuration/settings → cma.set_tenant_setting(); catalog defaults seeded by 0008r | on page load (cma.tenant_settings() via listSettings) |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.system_health_runs() reads cma.sync_run where tenant_id = cma.current_tenant_id(), plus RLS
- window: runs started in the last 30 days only (the function's range scan)
- job = 'link_calls' only (lib/health.ts HEARTBEAT_JOB)

**Time** Wall clock: age from the render instant (now = new Date().toISOString() when the cards stream) against last_started_at; the SQL window is now() − 30 days; no business dates.

**Settings**

| Setting | Default | Pulse4all |
|---|---|---|
| `health.heartbeat_fresh_seconds` | 120 | 120 |
| `health.heartbeat_late_seconds` | 900 | 900 |

**Who may see it** `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** On page load; the Refresh button re-renders (router.refresh()); no poll.

**Computed in** `cma.system_health_runs` (0008r); `heartbeatRun` in src/lib/health.ts; `heartbeatState` in src/lib/health.ts; `heartbeatThresholds` in src/lib/health.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select extract(epoch from (now() - max(r.started_at)))::integer as age_seconds, (select ts.value from cma.tenant_setting ts where ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = 'health.heartbeat_fresh_seconds') as fresh_override, (select ts.value from cma.tenant_setting ts where ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = 'health.heartbeat_late_seconds') as late_override from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.job = 'link_calls' and r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days'
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 1 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, System health (17 October 2026, addition 0008r); data-model/0008.md, Data model: System health (addition 0008r); docs/ingest/README.md, jobs table (ingest-sweep)

**Notes**

Thresholds come from the tenant's settings via listSettings (effective values), with the 0008r defaults 120/900 as a code fallback only when a key is missing or not a positive integer (heartbeatThresholds). The trigger cma.check_tenant_setting() keeps fresh (10..3600) below late (60..86400). Edge: a tenant whose sweep stopped more than 30 days ago falls out of the system_health_runs() window and shows 'No run yet' (none, neutral badge) rather than Silent (error badge) — see finding. Age uses last_started_at, so a run that started and hangs still counts as a beat. Empty state: no run → 'No run yet', no age line.

#### `health.sources.state`

**State** on /configuration/health · Connection state (Toestand)

A derived health state per connection — Working, Needs attention, Failing or Switched off — from what its jobs and events left behind; nothing pings a vendor.

**Formula as computed**

```
off when the connection is not active (integration_connection.status via cma.sources()); failing when any of its sync_run rows' jobState is failed or stuck, or a row has last_succeeded_at null while not running (ran in 30 days, never succeeded); attention when eventsParked (ingest_event status needs_review) > 0, or any row's failed_24h > 0, or lastEventAt is older than 24 h (only for a connection that has had events); ok otherwise (lib/health.ts connectionState, line 119). Rows filtered to the connection's own runs (connectionId === source.id).
```

**Unit** text · **Grain** now, per_source · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.integration_connection` | id, name, status, adapter | CMA | the runbook creates a connection (cma.upsert_connection, by hand in Studio); status switched on Configuration → Sources (cma.set_connection_status) | on page load (cma.sources()) |
| `cma.ingest_event` | connection_id, status, recorded_at | CMA | vendor webhook or poll → ingest service /<adapter>/<connection key> → one cma.ingest_event row on receipt; its status moves as the read-back processes it | as events arrive: HubSpot/Aircall/Shopify webhooks within seconds (subscriptions: hubspot/template in repo, Aircall and Shopify outside, see cadences_to_confirm); polls every minute (docs/ingest/deploy.sh) |
| `cma.sync_run` | job, connection_id, status, started_at, finished_at, error | CMA | each ingest job's own cma.ingest_sync_run_start()/finish() (0007) | sweep/forms poll/email poll every minute, reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); live schedules in Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |

**Filters**

- tenant: RLS plus cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.sources() and cma.system_health_runs()
- runs window: last 30 days (system_health_runs)
- failed_24h window: runs started in the last 24 hours
- no counted/uncounted filter: every connection of the tenant is listed, switched-off ones as Switched off

**Time** Wall clock: now is the render instant; 24 h and 30 d windows against now(); no business dates.

**Who may see it** `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** On page load; the Refresh button re-renders (router.refresh()); no poll.

**Computed in** `cma.sources` (0008e); `cma.system_health_runs` (0008r); `connectionState` in src/lib/health.ts; `jobState` in src/lib/health.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select c.id, c.name, c.status as active, (select count(*) from cma.ingest_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.connection_id = c.id and e.status = 'needs_review') as parked, (select max(e.recorded_at) from cma.ingest_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.connection_id = c.id) as last_event_at, (select count(*) from (select distinct on (r.job) r.status from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.connection_id = c.id and r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days' order by r.job, r.started_at desc, r.id desc) x where x.status = 'failed') as jobs_last_failed, (select count(*) from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.connection_id = c.id and r.started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and r.status = 'failed') as failed_24h from cma.integration_connection c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 4 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, System health (17 October 2026, addition 0008r); data-model/0008.md, Data model: System health (addition 0008r)

**Notes**

The derivation runs in TypeScript, so verify_sql reproduces the inputs, not the final label (stuck needs a now comparison). Copy precision: the on-screen hint (configHealth.stateHint) says 'Failing: a job's last run failed or never succeeded' and omits the stuck case, which the code also turns into failing — see finding. Zero/new-connection state: a connection with no events and no runs reads Working (ok), not an explicit 'nothing yet' state; a connection that had events and then went quiet for 24 h reads Needs attention. eventsWaiting never affects the state, only the display. No vendor or customer data: id, stored name and adapter string only.

#### `health.sources.events_parked`

How many of the connection's ingest events are parked for a person's review (status needs_review): events that failed past their retries and need a decision.

- status = 'needs_review' only
- no time window

#### `health.sources.last_read_back`

**Last successful read-back** on /configuration/health · Last successful read-back (Laatste geslaagde teruglezing)

When the connection's jobs last finished successfully: the newest last_succeeded_at across all of the connection's job rows in the 30-day window; a dash when none.

**Formula as computed**

```
lastOk = max over the connection's cma.system_health_runs() rows of last_succeeded_at (per job: max(finished_at) of succeeded runs in 30 days); the component sorts the ISO strings and takes the last (SystemHealth.tsx line 138). '–' when every row's last_succeeded_at is null or there is no row.
```

**Unit** date · **Grain** now, per_source · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.sync_run` | connection_id, job, status, finished_at | CMA | each ingest job's own cma.ingest_sync_run_start()/finish() (0007) | sweep/forms poll/email poll every minute, reconcile 03:30 Europe/Amsterdam (docs/ingest/deploy.sh); live schedules in Cloud Scheduler, outside the repo |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() in cma.system_health_runs(), plus RLS
- window: runs started in the last 30 days
- succeeded runs only for the max

**Time** An instant, shown compact date + time in the viewer's zone; 30-day wall-clock window.

**Who may see it** `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** On page load; the Refresh button re-renders; no poll.

**Computed in** `cma.system_health_runs` (0008r); `SystemHealth` in src/components/configuration/SystemHealth.tsx

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select r.connection_id, max(r.finished_at) as last_read_back from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.connection_id is not null and r.status = 'succeeded' and r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days' group by r.connection_id
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, System health (17 October 2026, addition 0008r); data-model/0008.md, Data model: System health (addition 0008r)

**Notes**

'Read-back' here means any succeeded run of any of the connection's jobs (sweep, polls, reconcile, backfill), not only the webhook read-back. The ISO-string sort is a correct instant order (UTC Z timestamps). Empty state: '–'.

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select distinct on (r.connection_id) r.connection_id, r.finished_at as last_failed_at, r.job, r.error from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.connection_id is not null and r.status = 'failed' and r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days' order by r.connection_id, r.finished_at desc, r.id desc
```

The error is the job's stored code (left(error, 200) at write), e.g. rate_limited, token_unavailable, http_403 — codes, never customer data. The component picks the row with the newest last_failed_at across jobs via a string compare on ISO instants (correct for UTC). Empty state: '–'.

#### `health.jobs.duration`

**Took** on /configuration/health · Took (Duurde)

How long the job's last run took, in milliseconds under a second and in whole units above; a dash while it still runs.

**Formula as computed**

```
took = max(0, parse(last_finished_at) − parse(last_started_at)) in ms (lib/health.ts runDurationMs); null (dash) while last_finished_at is null; shown as '{n} ms' under 1000, else fmtAge(round(took/1000)) with one unit (s/min/h/d, floor).
```

**Unit** seconds · **Grain** now, per_source · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.sync_run` | started_at, finished_at | CMA | each job's own start/finish functions (0007, 0008r, 0008s); finish writes clock_timestamp() | with each job run (see health.jobs.last_run) |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() plus RLS
- the last run per (job, connection) in 30 days only

**Time** A duration between two stored instants; no zones involved.

**Who may see it** `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** On page load; the Refresh button re-renders; no poll.

**Computed in** `cma.system_health_runs` (0008r); `runDurationMs` in src/lib/health.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select distinct on (r.job, r.connection_id) r.job, r.connection_id, round(extract(epoch from (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) * 1000)::bigint as took_ms from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days' order by r.job, r.connection_id, r.started_at desc, r.id desc
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, System health (17 October 2026, addition 0008r)

**Notes**

Unit recorded as seconds; the display switches between ms and the one-unit age format. Negative durations are clamped to 0. Empty state: '–' for a running row.

#### `health.jobs.outcome`

**Outcome** on /configuration/health · Outcome (Uitkomst)

The state of the job's last run: Succeeded, Failed (with its error code), Running, Stuck (still running past 15 minutes) or Never ran.

**Formula as computed**

```
jobState(run, now): never without a row; running while last_status = 'running' and age(last_started_at) <= 900 s; stuck while running and age > RUNNING_TOO_LONG_SECONDS (15*60, Cloud Run's job task timeout is 10 minutes); failed when last_status = 'failed'; ok otherwise (lib/health.ts jobState, line 103). last_error shown muted next to the badge when present.
```

**Unit** text · **Grain** now, per_source · **Status** verified

**Sources**

| Table | Columns | Owner | Fed by | Cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cma.sync_run` | status, started_at, error | CMA | each job's own start/finish functions (0007, 0008r, 0008s) | with each job run (see health.jobs.last_run) |

**Filters**

- tenant: cma.current_tenant_id() plus RLS
- the last run per (job, connection) in 30 days

**Time** Stuck compares the run's start against the render instant (wall clock).

**Who may see it** `tenant.configure`

**Refresh** On page load; the Refresh button re-renders; no poll.

**Computed in** `cma.system_health_runs` (0008r); `jobState` in src/lib/health.ts

**Verification query** (Studio, with the tenant id and the period's business dates filled in)

```sql
select distinct on (r.job, r.connection_id) r.job, r.connection_id, case when r.status = 'running' and r.started_at < now() - interval '15 minutes' then 'stuck' when r.status = 'running' then 'running' when r.status = 'failed' then 'failed' else 'ok' end as state, r.error from cma.sync_run r where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.started_at > now() - interval '30 days' order by r.job, r.connection_id, r.started_at desc, r.id desc
```

**Fixture check** The query runs against the local fixture database (migrations 00 to 99, the dev seed and web/verify's reports and follow-up volume fixtures, 23 October 2026) and returns 0 row(s); Martin compares the value with the page in Studio.

**Documented in** api.md, System health (17 October 2026, addition 0008r); data-model/0008.md, Data model: System health (addition 0008r)

**Notes**

The 15-minute stuck threshold is hardcoded (lib/health.ts RUNNING_TOO_LONG_SECONDS) and named in the jobs hint copy — see the hardcoded-thresholds finding. A stuck or failed job also turns its connection's state to Failing. 'Never ran' can only appear for a job key the page would list without a row, which the current rendering never produces (rows come only from existing runs), so Never is effectively unreachable on screen — the empty card text 'No run in the last 30 days' covers the no-rows case.
